197.de: Two middle-aged men sitting at a round table in the centre foreground. A chessboard on the table. A bookcase in the background on the right. (Unfinished work).

480.d: Pastelse mõjuga rohelistes toonides antud looritatud, otsekui nägemuslik maastik. Esiplaanil kaks põõsast ja jõgi. Tagaplaanil eri puuliikidest mets, ülal kaks pilve, mille vahel helesinine taevalõik.
480.de: A veiled, almost visionary landscape rendered in pastel-toned greens. In the foreground two bushes and a river. In the background a forest of various tree species, above two clouds with a strip of pale blue sky between them.

481.d: Keskel järvesopp, mida ümbritsevad rohekashallides, sinistes ja roosades toonides lopsakad puud ja põõsad. Teispool järve erkroheline niit, silmapiiril tumesinine metsaviirg. Ülal sinine, silmapiiriga kokkupuutumise kohal valge ja roosakas taevas.
481.de: In the centre a bay of a lake, surrounded by lush trees and bushes in greenish-grey, blue and pink tones. Beyond the lake a bright green meadow, on the horizon a dark blue strip of forest. Above, a blue sky, white and pinkish near the horizon.

482.d: Vaade ülalt järvele, liivasele kaldale esiplaanil ning järve ümbritsevatele puudele ja põõsastele. Paremal keskel sügavalt järve ulatuv põõsastega kaetud saar või maanina.
482.de: A view from above of a lake, of a sandy shore in the foreground and of the trees and bushes surrounding the lake. In the centre right, an island or headland covered with bushes reaching deep into the lake.

774.dm: laius: 38.5 cm (läbi klaasi); kõrgus: 50.0 cm (läbi klaasi)
774.d: Akna all ümara laua serv, millel vaas rikkaliku, üksteise kõrval asetsevaist erinevaist õitest buketiga. Üksik lill laual vasakul. Paremas ülanurgas aknast paistmas kollakas täiskuu. Ruumis lummav sinkjas valgus. Lillakassinised, rohekad mürgised toonid. Vaas lilledega aluspapile kleebitud, sellele omakorda kleebitud õisi.
774.de: Below the window, the edge of a round table on which stands a vase with a rich bouquet of various flowers placed side by side. A single flower on the table to the left. In the upper right corner, a yellowish full moon showing through the window. A captivating bluish light in the room. Purplish-blue, greenish poisonous tones. The vase with flowers is glued onto the backing paper, with flowers glued on top of it in turn.

1134.de: Television set "Avangard" in a cabinet, behind the glass geometric shapes that move, forming a composition that rotates on its axis; a knob on the television allows adjustment of the sound background and light

1182.d: Esiplaanil klaasuks, millest läbi astumas rohelise inimfiguurid. Ülaosas sinised ja valged pastoossed värvilaigud figuuride vahel. All vasakul pruuni riietatud mehe torso.
1182.de: In the foreground a glass door, through which green human figures are stepping. At the top, blue and white pastose patches of colour between the figures. At the bottom left, the torso of a man dressed in brown.

1183.d: Vaade linnulennult üle maastiku: paremal servas all vahutavate laineharjadega sügavsinine meri mitmete lahesoppidega ülaservas. Vasakul all ja keskel teede ja tikukarbi suuruste majakestega kollastes ja pruunides toonides maastik, mille kohal hõljub valge lennuk. Vasakus ülanurgas roheline metsatukk. Valge ja kollasega on väga pastoosselt maalitud.
1183.de: A bird's-eye view over a landscape: at the lower right edge a deep blue sea with foaming wave crests, with several bay inlets at the upper edge. At the lower left and centre, a landscape in yellow and brown tones with roads and matchbox-sized little houses, above which a white aeroplane hovers. In the upper left corner a green patch of forest. The white and yellow are painted very impastoly.

1184.d: Pildi ülaosas sinise taeva foonil rauast ja betoonist (hallid, valged, punased) diagonaalselt üksteisesse lõikuvad sillakonstruktsioonid. All paremas nurgas pruun sillakaar. Vasakul jõgi, mille kohal kulgeva raudteesilla hallidele betoonsammastele on ülal kinnitatud ažuursed metallpiirded. Taamal, väga madalal asuval silmapiiril heledates toonides linn. Keskel, punaseks värvitud metallsõrestiku käänukohas kollas ja punase värvi pritsmed.
1184.de: In the upper part of the picture, against a blue sky background, diagonally intersecting bridge structures made of iron and concrete (gray, white, red). In the lower right corner a brown bridge arch. On the left a river, above which airy metal railings are attached to the gray concrete pillars of a railway bridge running above. In the distance, on a very low horizon, a city in light tones. In the middle, at the bend of the metal lattice painted red, splashes of yellow and red paint.

1201.d: Tumerohelisel foonil, töö paremas servas elusuuruses noore naise põlvportree. Heledate poolpikkade juuste ja sirge ninaga naisel seljas pruunist karusnahast poolkasukas, mille kaelusest paistab kollane pluus. Seelikul suured värvilised puuviljad: kaks kollast sidrunit, kaks rohelist jõmmelgat ja kaks punast õuna ühes kolme kahvatu talvise maikellukesega. Foonil, otsekui sügavikus hõljumas kaks punast ja üks beež kruus, millest ühel on portreeritava pulmapilt, teisel perekonnapilt pojaga.
1201.de: Against a dark green background, on the right edge of the work, a life-size knee-length portrait of a young woman. The woman, with light-coloured medium-length hair and a straight nose, is wearing a half-length coat of brown fur, from the collar of which a yellow blouse can be seen. On the skirt large colourful fruits: two yellow lemons, two green greengages and two red apples together with three pale winter lilies of the valley. In the background, as if floating in the depths, two red mugs and one beige mug, on one of which is the sitter's wedding photo, on another a family photo with her son.

1203.d: Mustjasrohelisel foonil, keskjoonest pisut allpool paikneb juurviljade ja okstel rippuvate õunte jada. Selle taga vasakul paljastatud õlgadega noor naine poolpöördes vasakule. Naisel kastanpruunid poolpikad juuksed, paokil suu, pärani silmad. Paremal ülemisel neljandikus puude vahel talu sinise taeva ja ererohelise maa vahel, eespool mees koeraga.
1203.de: On a blackish-green background, slightly below the centre line, there is a row of vegetables and apples hanging on branches. Behind it on the left, a young woman with bared shoulders in a half-turn to the left. The woman has chestnut-brown shoulder-length hair, a slightly open mouth, wide-open eyes. In the upper right quarter, between trees, a farmhouse between the blue sky and bright green ground, in front a man with a dog.

1204.d: Ühtlasel mustal taustal digonaalselt paigutatud hulk vilju: viinamarjakobarad, maasikad, ploomid, õunad, sidrun, hernekaun, punane roosiõis nende vahel. Vasakus alumises nurgas läbib vilju sinine kaldjoon.
1204.de: On an even black background, a number of fruits arranged diagonally: bunches of grapes, strawberries, plums, apples, a lemon, a pea pod, a red rose blossom among them. In the lower left corner a blue diagonal line runs through the fruits.

1225.dm: laius: 100.0 cm (+ väljaulatuvad naelad 2,5 cm); kõrgus: 108.0 cm
1225.d: Sinisel foonil korrapäraselt, tihedalt, horisontaalsetest, valgetest joontest, kaarjate otstega pinnad; vertikaalselt vertikaalsete, valgete joontega neli tulpa. Ülevalpool keskjoont lai, allpool kitsam, must, horisontaalne triip, nende vahel sinine triip. Teose servadel 2,5 cm väljaulatuvad, värvitud naelad korrapäraste vahedega.
1225.de: On a blue background, evenly and densely arranged horizontal white lines with curved ends form surfaces; vertically, four columns with vertical white lines. Above the centre line a broad black horizontal stripe, below it a narrower one, with a blue stripe between them. Along the edges of the work, painted nails protrude at regular intervals by 2.5 cm.

1226.dm: laius: 100.0 cm (+ väljaulatuvad naelad 2,5 cm); kõrgus: 108.0 cm
1226.d: Kogu kujutise pind kaetud tihedalt kaheksa horisontaalse reaga valgetest vertikaaljoontega postidest kaarjate ülemiste otstega - igas reas kümme posti. Kogu kujutis paremal poolel veidi tumenev. Teose servadel 2,5 cm väljaulatuvad, värvitud naelad korrapäraste vahedega.
1226.de: The entire surface of the image is densely covered with eight horizontal rows of white vertical-lined posts with arched upper ends - ten posts in each row. The entire image darkens slightly on the right half. On the edges of the work, painted nails protrude 2.5 cm at regular intervals.

1295.d: Romantiline, hallikassinistes, kollastes, roosades toonides laavamaastik: esiplaanil kivide ja kidurate rohututtidega kaetud platoo. Silmapiiril õhtupäikesest valgustatud, lumega kaetud madalad mäed. Mägede kohal on taevas kollane, kõrgemal raskelt tinahall.
1295.de: A romantic lava landscape in grayish-blue, yellow and pink tones: in the foreground a plateau covered with stones and stunted tufts of grass. On the horizon, low snow-covered mountains lit by the evening sun. Above the mountains the sky is yellow, higher up heavily leaden gray.

1296.d: Ülaltvaade avarale lauskjate nõlvade, veekogudega maastikule õhtuvalguses. All orus heledad hooneteblokid. Silmapiiril kolm lumist, pilvedesse tõusvat mäetippu. Kõrge sinine taevas, maa kohal lillakasoranž pilvede kiht õhtupäikese kumas.
1296.de: A view from above of an open landscape of flat slopes and bodies of water in evening light. Below, in the valley, light-coloured blocks of buildings. On the horizon three snowy mountain peaks rising into the clouds. A high blue sky, above the land a layer of purplish-orange clouds glowing in the evening sun.

1299.d: Seitsmeosaline heledavärviline dekoratiivne kompositsioon rakkude ühinemisest. I Hõbedasel pinnal paremal kaarjas erekollane pind. II Kuldsel taustal vasakul helesinine kaarjas pind. III Kollase ja helesinise kumera pinna lõikumine beežil foonil, lõikepind hele värvitriibuline. IV Kollane laevukese kujund helesinisel, vasakul kollasel sinine diagonaalne, lainelise joonega lõppev kujund. V Kollasel laevukesel ülal hõbedane viil kolme heledatriibulise kujundiga. VI Helesinisel taustal sinistes ja kollastes üleminekutoonides laevukese kujund. VII Türkiissinisel all triibuline kaarjas pind.
1299.de: A seven-part light-coloured decorative composition on the merging of cells. I On a silvery surface, a bright yellow arched surface on the right. II On a golden background, a light blue arched surface on the left. III The intersection of a yellow and a light blue convex surface on a beige background, the intersection surface with light-coloured stripes. IV A yellow boat-shaped figure on light blue, on the left on yellow a blue diagonal figure ending in a wavy line. V On a yellow boat shape, above, a silvery wedge with three light-striped figures. VI On a light blue background, a boat-shaped figure in transitional shades of blue and yellow. VII A turquoise-blue arched surface with stripes at the bottom.

1324.d: Hõõguvpunasel foonil kahe mehe figuurid: vasakul helepruunis sviitris, töökinnastes ja sepapõlles habemik mees, kel vasar paremas käes. Paremal ülestõstetud paremas käes vasarat ja vasakus käes tange hoidva tumedate juuste ja habemega mees. Allservas kahe figuuri vahel alasi.
1324.de: Against a glowing red background, figures of two men: on the left, a bearded man in a light brown sweater, work gloves and a blacksmith's apron, with a hammer in his right hand. On the right, a man with dark hair and beard, holding a hammer raised in his right hand and tongs in his left hand. At the bottom, between the two figures, an anvil.

1369.d: Ümmargune märklaud, millest ripub läbi paljasjalgne peata mehe keha, jalad läbivad märklauda ülal vasakult, parem käsi ripub taga alusel, vasak läbib kõverdatult rattakujulist tühimikku paremalt ülalt
1369.de: A round target, from which the headless body of a barefoot man hangs through it, his legs passing through the target at the upper left, his right arm hanging behind on a stand, his left arm, bent, passing through a wheel-shaped void from the upper right.

1370.de: A disc-shaped medal on a cuboid base; on the disc a female figure wearing a toga, in her right hand extended to the side is a wreath

1371.de: Two faces on a square plate, their union prevented by a vertical partition

1372.de: A man in a suit with glasses sits in a lantern-like armchair, a figure pierces a vertical architecton

1377.de: A generalized and fragmented depiction of a person sitting in a wheelchair, one hand dramatically stretched out

1389.d: Päikesepaistelistel, ilusa, puhta rohumaa keskel üksikuid kadakaid ja kadakate gruppe. Esiplaanil all mõned sinised ja valged meelespeaõied. Ülal helesinine taevas. Maalitud iga lehte ja rohukõrt rõhutades. Sügavroheline koloriit.
1389.de: In the middle of a sunny, beautiful, clean meadow, individual junipers and groups of junipers. In the foreground below a few blue and white forget-me-not flowers. Above, a light blue sky. Painted emphasizing every leaf and blade of grass. Deep green colouring.

1390.d: Esiplaanil, rohelise muru keskel hall urn, millest kasvab välja kressipuhmas. All paremas nurgas üks, puhmast vasakul ülal kolm kollase- ja punasetriibulist metalltoru. Tagaplaanil puud ja põõsad, vasakul ülal ribake taevast. Rohukõrred ja lehed hoolikalt välja maalitud, koloriidis kõikvõimalike roheliste toonide kooslus.
1390.de: In the foreground, amid green grass, a grey urn from which a cress bush grows. In the lower right corner one, and upper left of the bush three, yellow- and red-striped metal pipes. In the background trees and bushes, a strip of sky in the upper left. Blades of grass and leaves carefully painted in detail, the colour scheme a combination of all manner of green tones.

1392.d: Vaade alt järk-järgult tõusvale, samblaga tihedalt kaetud mäeveerule. Samblal siin-seal laiguti kanarbikupõõsaid. Mäe otsas ja taga männid. Ülal alt kollakas, ülalt kahvatusinine taevas.
1392.de: View from below of a gradually rising hillside densely covered with moss. Here and there patches of heather bushes on the moss. Pines on top of the hill and behind it. Above, the sky yellowish at the bottom, pale blue at the top.

1393.d: Kollases õhtuvalguses inimtühi maastikumotiiv: keskel mitme viiluga, pruuni katusega kollane maja, mis toetub paekivist laotud, paremalt kõrgele vundamendile. Vasakust alumisest nurgast keerab asfaldiga kaetud sõidu- ja kõnnitee pildi sügavusse. Tee ääres vasakul valge kupliga latern posti otsas, muru ja põõsad. Teest paremal esiplaanil suur mitmeharuline raagus puu, tagapool rohuga kaetud kraaviperv, liivane kallak ja männimets. Ülal kahvatusinine taevas.
1393.de: A deserted landscape motif in yellow evening light: in the centre a yellow house with several gables and a brown roof, resting on a high foundation built of limestone, higher on the right. From the lower left corner an asphalt-covered road and pavement curve into the depth of the picture. Along the road on the left a lantern with a white shade on a post, grass and bushes. To the right of the road in the foreground a large, multi-branched bare tree, further back a grassy ditch bank, a sandy slope and a pine forest. Above, a pale blue sky.

1394.d: Lummavas hajutatud valguses pargipilt: esiplaanis vasakul ja paremal kõrged kollased, nuppudega aiapostid sepistatud aiavõrega postide vahel. Aia taga lopsakas roheluses puud ja põõsad, kammitsetud valge kivipiirdega rohelistele saarekestele. Rohelusesaarekeste vahel hallid siledad pargiteed. Otse läbi avatud värava parki avaneva vaate suleb suur hall maja, millest näha üksnes osa seina, helevalge raamiga aken ja katuseviil. Keskel seisab pargiteel seljaga vaataja poole pööratud mees, käed taskus, ülal vasakul jupike sinist taevast.
1394.de: A captivating park view in diffused light: in the foreground on the left and right, tall yellow garden posts with knobs, with a forged garden fence between the posts. Behind the fence, lush greenery of trees and bushes, confined to green islands by white stone borders. Between the green islands, smooth grey park paths. Straight ahead, through the open gate, the view opening into the park is closed off by a large grey house, of which only a part of the wall, a bright white-framed window and a gable are visible. In the middle a man stands on the park path with his back to the viewer, hands in pockets, above at the upper left a patch of blue sky.

1395.d: Ees väikesel lagendikul kaks väravapostitaolist torni, dekorativselt sini-puna-valgeks värvitud. Nende vahel punase-kollase triibuline peen post, kahel pool käharad põõsad. Taustal sihvakad, taevani tõusvad püramiid-puud, puukroonide vahelt paistab kahvatu taevas. Detailitäpne maal, valdavalt sügavad sinakasrohelised toonid.
1395.de: In front, on a small clearing, two gate-post-like towers, decoratively painted blue-red-white. Between them a thin post striped red-yellow, on both sides curly bushes. In the background slender, pyramid-shaped trees rising to the sky, a pale sky visible between the treetops. A finely detailed painting, predominantly in deep bluish-green tones.

1396.d: Erkrohelisel nõlval vasakul osa silindrilisest, ümarate akende ja kaarniššidega ehitusest. Selle ees põõsapuhmaste juures kaks siga. Helenduva sinise taeva taustal tumedad, püramiidjate puude grupid. Paremal üksik lehtpuu.
1396.de: On a bright green slope, on the left, part of a cylindrical building with round windows and arched niches. In front of it, by shrub bushes, two pigs. Against the backdrop of a glowing blue sky, dark groups of pyramid-shaped trees. On the right a solitary deciduous tree.

1401.dm: kõrgus: 58.0 cm; sügavus: 37.0 cm; laius: 45.0 cm
1401.d: Abstrahheeritud naise ülakeha, käed ja pea puuduvad, üks koreda tekstiiliga kaetud rind, kaelast ja külgedelt eenduvad puust pulgad, Selja taha on koondatud kokkupressitud tekstiil
1401.de: Abstracted upper body of a woman, arms and head missing, one breast covered with coarse textile, wooden rods protruding from the neck and sides, behind is gathered compressed textile

1402.dm: kõrgus: 62.0 cm; sügavus: 38.0 cm; laius: 68.0 cm
1402.d: Roosa plastikuga kaetud naise torso on diagonaalselt paremalt vasakule küljelt lõigatud, ülalt on lõigatud ära rind, alt puusa osa; lõigatud küljele on kinnitatud puust raam. Torso ja raami külge on seotud plastikust valatud lapse käed ja tekstiilist elemente
1402.de: A woman's torso covered in pink plastic is cut diagonally from right to left side; the breast is cut off from above, part of the hip from below; a wooden frame is attached to the cut side. Plastic-cast children's hands and textile elements are tied to the torso and frame.

1403.dm: läbimõõt: 35.0 cm (aluskettal); sügavus: 50.0 cm; laius: 67.0 cm; kõrgus: 96.0 cm
1403.d: roosast plastikmaterjalist inimkeha meenutav objekt terastraadist võrgu fragmentidega
1403.de: an object resembling a human body made of pink plastic material with fragments of a steel wire mesh

1405.dm: kõrgus: 80.0 cm; sügavus: 53.0 cm; laius: 48.0 cm
1405.d: Plastist stiliseeritud mehe pea; roosa sile õmblustega ääristatud plast katab pead, lõuga, kaela ja nina; silmade ja suu piirkond kaetud metallvõrguga;  keset pealage metallvõrgust kolmnurkne lipp, kuklale kinnituvad  täidetud kotiriidest padjanditena suured pehmed moodustised
1405.de: A stylised plastic man's head; smooth pink plastic edged with seams covers the head, chin, neck and nose; the area of the eyes and mouth is covered with metal mesh; in the middle of the crown a triangular flag of metal mesh, at the back of the head large soft forms attached as stuffed sackcloth cushion-like shapes

1406.dm: kõrgus: 55.0 cm; sügavus: 60.0 cm; laius: 95.0 cm
1406.d: Terava tipuga kotiriidest objektile on asetatud plastikust mehe pea kuklapool, mille kaela hoiab labakäsi,
1406.de: Onto a sackcloth object with a pointed tip is placed the back of a plastic man's head, its neck held by a hand,

1407.dm: kõrgus: 39.0 cm; sügavus: 60.0 cm; laius: 106.0 cm
1407.d: Kaks topitud kotiriidest objekti kokku seotud jämeda nööriga, objekti on värvitud musta värviga
1407.de: Two stuffed burlap objects tied together with a thick cord, the object is painted with black paint

1440.d: Esiplaanil, sinakashallil, triikimisvoltides linaga kaetud laual üks väikese praoga ja teine purunenud koorega kanamuna, kollane sisu välja voolamas. Purunenud munast paremal punase-kollasetriibulise käepidemega terav pussnuga ning kõrge silindrikujuline klaas. Foon tume, sujuvate üleminekutega hallikassiniselt määrdunud pruunile toonile.
1440.de: In the foreground, on a table covered with a bluish-grey cloth with ironed folds, one egg with a small crack and another with a broken shell, the yellow contents flowing out. To the right of the broken egg a sharp knife with a red-and-yellow striped handle and a tall cylindrical glass. Background dark, with smooth transitions from a dirty greyish-blue to brown tone.

1441.d: Õhtune vaade Pirita uuele jahtklubihoonele mere poolt. Otse üle vee kaid ääristavad tribüünid lipuvarraste, tulekohaga. Tagapool püramiidi-taoline hoone, paremal kai ääres jahte, peegeldus vees. Silmapiiril ehapunas taeva taustal Tallinna vanalinna siluett. Esiplaanil vasakul osa jahi triibulisest spinnakerist numbriga SR-37.
1441.de: An evening view of the new yacht club building at Pirita, seen from the sea. Directly across the water, stands line the quay with flagpoles and a fire place. Behind them a pyramid-like building, on the right yachts moored by the quay, reflected in the water. On the horizon, the silhouette of Tallinn's Old Town against a sky glowing red with sunset. In the foreground on the left, part of a yacht's striped spinnaker with the number SR-37.

1452.d: REIN TAMMIK "MAASTIK TRIIPHOONEGA" (ÕLI, TEMPERA, LÕUEND) 1980.a. 120x100(eesti). Asukoht objektil: tagaküljel
1452.de: REIN TAMMIK "MAASTIK TRIIPHOONEGA" (ÕLI, TEMPERA, LÕUEND) 1980.a. 120x100. Location on object: on the verso

1454.d: "Fragment" õli,l. 1982. R. Tammik(eesti). Asukoht objektil: taga lõuendil
1454.de: "Fragment" oil on canvas. 1982. R. Tammik. Location on object: on the back on the canvas

1455.d: Saksa DV graafiku H. Hornungi portree Portret H. Hornunga iz GPR holst, moslo 82-83 Rein Tammik ESSR (vene tähed)(eesti). Asukoht objektil: lõuendil
1455.de: Portrait of the German GDR graphic artist H. Hornung Portret H. Hornunga iz GPR holst, moslo 82-83 Rein Tammik ESSR (Russian letters). Location on object: on canvas

1460.d: Ühtlase helekollase fooni keskel lilla-oranži-musta ruuduline nelinurkne pind kaetud spontaansete kollakasoranžide kaarjate pintslitõmmetega. Esiplaanil, maali alumistes nurkades sümmeetrilised pruuni lauaplaadi kujutised, kummalgi türkiissinine ülalt laienev, karikakujuline vaas teravaotsaliste, palmitaoliste taimedega. Lauaplaatide vahel tume liist, millel ripneb pael.
1460.de: In the center of a uniform light yellow background, a purple-orange-black checkered rectangular surface is covered with spontaneous yellowish-orange arching brushstrokes. In the foreground, in the lower corners of the painting, symmetrical depictions of a brown tabletop, each with a turquoise-blue upward-widening, goblet-shaped vase with sharp-tipped, palm-like plants. Between the tabletops, a dark ledge from which a ribbon hangs.

1461.d: Esiplaanil tumehallil rinnatisel punakaspruun seadeldis, mis koosneb üksteisele asetatud plaatidest ja risttahukast ning selles kõrguvast triibulisest vardast hallil foonil. Paremal ja vasakul servas värvilistest kujunditest abstraktne kompositsioon.
1461.de: In the foreground, on a dark grey parapet, a reddish-brown device consisting of plates placed one upon another and a rectangular block, with a striped rod rising from it, against a grey background. At the left and right edges an abstract composition of coloured shapes.

1464.d: Otsekui läbi udu antud vaksali perroon, millel neli inimest suunduvad pildi sügavusse, rongile vastu. Esiplaanil keskel seljaga vaataja poole seisva heledas särgis noore mehe figuur. All vasakus servas ja all paremal must triip, üle pildi pinna musta-punasekirju joon. Töö parempoolne ülemine neljandik lillades toonides, selle all värvilistest kaarjatest pintslitõmmetest kompositsioon.
1464.de: As if seen through fog, a station platform on which four people move into the depth of the picture, toward an arriving train. In the foreground, in the centre, the figure of a young man in a light-coloured shirt, standing with his back to the viewer. In the lower left corner and lower right a black stripe, across the picture surface a black-and-red patterned line. The upper right quarter of the work is in purple tones, below it a composition of colourful curved brushstrokes.

1465.d: Lilla laudpõrandaga ja tumehalli seinaga ruum, mille ülaosas aken. Akna ette on punaste nööridega riputatud lillelaud suure lillepotiga keskel ja kahe kaktusepotiga servades. All põrandal suur hüljes.
1465.de: A room with a purple plank floor and a dark grey wall, with a window in the upper part. In front of the window a flower shelf is hung with red cords, with a large flowerpot in the middle and two cactus pots at the edges. Below on the floor a large seal.

1466.d: Esiplaanil all hall laud kahe kõrge kitsa klaasvaasiga, milles roosad oksakesed valgel foonil. Horisontaalsest keskjoonest pisut kõrgemal punane triip ja helesinine taevas, mille keskel hall korsten.
1466.de: In the foreground below a grey table with two tall narrow glass vases holding pink twigs against a white background. Slightly above the horizontal centre line a red stripe and a light blue sky, with a grey chimney in the middle.

1467.d: Pruuni värvi laudadest põranda ja valgete seintega ruum, mille keskel tumepruun kolme jalaga taburet. Taburetil valge ümar vaas rukkilillede ja viljapeadega. Paremas alumises nurgas maalimispukk, millel rohelistes toonides kivide ja kadakatega maastikupilt. Molberti taga suurem suvemaastik, millest paistab peamiselt taeva osa. Vasakul toetub seinale maastik, millelt paistab äikese-eelne taevas, roheline heinamaa ja kollane viljapõld ning osa punaseks värvitud niidumasinast. Ruumi tagaseinas maastik põldudega esiplaanil. Põldude taga valge katusega puudesse uppuv talumaja, taamal metsaviirg ning kollakas taevas.
1467.de: A room with a floor of brown-coloured planks and white walls, in the middle of which stands a dark brown three-legged stool. On the stool a white round vase with cornflowers and ears of grain. In the lower right corner an easel, on which stands a landscape painting in green tones with rocks and junipers. Behind the easel a larger summer landscape, from which mainly the sky portion is visible. On the left, leaning against the wall, a landscape showing a pre-thunderstorm sky, green meadow and yellow grain field, and part of a mowing machine painted red. On the back wall of the room a landscape with fields in the foreground. Behind the fields a farmhouse with a white roof sinking into the trees, in the distance a strip of forest and a yellowish sky.

1468.d: Beežikaspruuni, marmortahvleid imiteerivat tausta läbib ülalt alla selgelt piiritletud alumiiniumplaate meenutav pind. Sellel, ülal keskel, punane kummuli poolkuu kiiremotiividega. Alumises neljandikus Tallinna siluett. Allääres tume lauaplaat koobaltsinise tahvliga, millel lebab kala, meretaimi, punane nöörijupp ja kuul.
1468.de: A clearly delineated surface resembling aluminium plates runs from top to bottom through a beige-brown background imitating marble slabs. On it, at the top centre, a red upside-down half-moon with ray motifs. In the lower quarter, the Tallinn skyline. Along the bottom edge, a dark tabletop with a cobalt-blue slab, on which lie a fish, sea plants, a red piece of cord and a bullet.

1469.d: 3/4 maali vasakpoolsest osast kujutab ühtlaselt valget peente punaste horisontaaltriipudega pinda, mis liitub paremal aimatava tähistaevaga. Selle foonil ülal paremal hõbedase sputniku kujutis, allääres, toekal lauaplaadil makett talumajast roheluses ja kolmnurkse alusega mürkroheline laualamp.
1469.de: 3/4 of the left part of the painting depicts a uniformly white surface with fine red horizontal stripes, which merges on the right with an implied starry sky. Against this background, upper right, the image of a silvery sputnik, at the bottom edge, on a sturdy tabletop a model of a farmhouse amid greenery and a poison-green table lamp with a triangular base.

1470.d: Lõuendi vasakus servas tumedal, mürkrohelise linikuga kaetud laual, punakaspruunis lillepotis toalill - havisaba. Poti ees valkjasrohelised, hapraid taimi meenutavad kujundid. Poti ja laua taga midagi Erkoranži. Poti fooniks ilusatest mustadest peentest raudvarbadest aed, selle taga muruplats ja põõsastik. Ülal kollakashall taevas. 4/5 pildi pinnast põimuvad teineteisesse metalli ja marmorit imiteerivad kujundid.
1470.de: On the left edge of the canvas, on a dark table covered with a poisonous-green cloth, in a reddish-brown flowerpot, a houseplant - horsetail. In front of the pot whitish-green shapes resembling fragile plants. Behind the pot and the table something in Erko-orange. The background of the pot is a fence of beautiful thin black iron bars, behind it a lawn and shrubbery. Above, a yellowish-grey sky. 4/5 of the picture surface consists of intertwining shapes imitating metal and marble.

1471.d: Allservas esiplaanil peaaegu mustjashalli marmori imitatsioonis rinnatis. Rinnatisel vasakul ja paremal abstraktsed ruumilised kujundid. Keskel lööb marmorisse punane sakiline välk, löögikohast paiskub 90-kraadise nurga alt värviline kiirtevihk. Rinnatisel, umes 1/4 pildi laiuse kaugusel paremast servast väike taevasinine läikiv kuulike.
1471.de: In the foreground at the bottom a parapet imitating almost blackish-grey marble. On the parapet, to the left and right, abstract spatial forms. In the centre a red jagged flash strikes the marble, and from the point of impact a colourful bundle of rays bursts out at a 90-degree angle. On the parapet, at a distance of about 1/4 of the picture's width from the right edge, a small sky-blue glossy ball.

1472.d: Valgeid kahhelkiviplaate meenutavate pindade vahel realistlikult maalitud meremotiiv kõrge taeva all, mis paremalt 3/4 võrra kattub strontsiumkollase, punaste siksakjoontega piiratud ja läbitud kujundiga. Keskosas merest välja viskuv suur sinkjasvalge kala.
1472.de: Between surfaces resembling white tiles, a realistically painted sea motif under a high sky, three-quarters covered from the right by a strontium-yellow shape bordered and traversed by red zigzag lines. In the central part a large bluish-white fish leaping out of the sea.

1473.d: Maali allosas ühtlaselt valgel, keskjoonelt siksakservalisel pinnal hall vaal. Kala sabapoolt läbib tumepunane nooljas kujund. Ülemise poole valget ja selle all olevat rohekate horisontaaltriipudega halli tausta katab paremas ülemises neljandikus erkkollane ruudukujuline pind, mille alumine äär rebitud moega. Tumepunane teravnurkne kujund vaala pea kohal.
1473.de: In the lower part of the painting, on an evenly white surface with a zigzag edge along the midline, a grey whale. A dark red arrow-like shape passes through the tail end of the fish. In the upper part, the white area and the grey background with greenish horizontal stripes below it are covered, in the upper right quarter, by a bright yellow square-shaped surface with a torn-looking lower edge. A dark red sharp-angled shape above the whale's head.

1480.d: Suurema osa pildi pinnast katab valge sein, mille suurelt osalt pudenenud krohvi mustad ja punased jooned. Paremal ülalt alla kulgev riba värvilistest horisontaalsetest triipudest ning pastoosse värvi ülalt alla tõmmatud looklev joon. Vasakus servas tükike majast, mille alumisel korrusel on äri ning roheliste luukidega piirnevast ülemisest aknast paistab helesinise särgi ja sinise ülikonnaga figuur, pea kohal oranž täpp.
1480.de: Most of the picture's surface is covered by a white wall, whose plaster has largely flaked off, with black and red lines. On the right a strip running from top to bottom of coloured horizontal stripes and a winding line drawn from top to bottom in pastose paint. In the left edge a fragment of a house, with a shop on the ground floor, and from the upper window bordered with green shutters a figure in a light blue shirt and blue suit is visible, with an orange dot above the head.

1481.d: All vigastatud, paremas nurgas suure ripneva rebendiga maastikumaali kujutis, mille kohal raam sellesse löödud noa, lilla silindri ja puuklotsiga, mis otsast punane. Foon hallikas-valge.
1481.de: Below, damaged, in the right corner a depiction of a landscape painting with a large hanging tear, above which a knife struck into the frame, a purple cylinder and a wooden block, red at the end. Background greyish-white.

1483.d: Esiplaanil kolm hallist kivist postamenti kartuššide, ornamentide ja bareljeefidega. Vasakpoolsel postamendil ülalt järkjärguliselt ahenev torn (alt roheline, ülalt roosa), mille tipus väike punane vardake. Torni tipust vasakul ebamäärase kujuga sinine laik. Keskmisest postamendist kasvab välja heleroosa aatomipilve meenutav kujund. Paremal postamendil tükike maastikku rohelise puu, laternaposti ja muruga, ülal tumesinise taeva foonil kuusirp. Foon helehall. Postamendid maalitud liiva-värvi segatehnikas, mõjuvad väga pastoosselt.
1483.de: In the foreground three pedestals of grey stone with cartouches, ornaments and bas-reliefs. On the left pedestal a tower narrowing gradually from top (green at the bottom, pink at the top), with a small red rod at its tip. To the left of the tip of the tower an indeterminately shaped blue patch. From the middle pedestal grows a light pink form resembling an atomic cloud. On the right pedestal a piece of landscape with a green tree, a lamp post and grass, above, against a dark blue sky background, a crescent moon. The background is light grey. The pedestals are painted in a sandy-coloured mixed technique, with a very pastose effect.

1484.d: Esiplaanil kõrgemale ulatuvate postamentidega hall kivist rinnatis. Vasakpoolsel postamendil ebakorrapärase kujuga ülalt ahenev tumeroosat varju heitev kivisammas, mille all punastest joontest nelinurk. Parempoolse postamendi kohal roosa pilv, mille all postamendi ees rohelistest joontest nelinurk. Helehallil foonil rõhtsalt üle pildi ulatuv hall riba, geomeetriliste sisselõigetega. Rinnatis ja kivisammas segatehnikas, reljeefselt mõjuv.
1484.de: In the foreground, a gray stone parapet with pedestals rising higher. On the left pedestal an irregularly shaped stone column narrowing towards the top, casting a dark pink shadow, under which a rectangle of red lines. Above the right pedestal a pink cloud, under which, in front of the pedestal, a rectangle of green lines. On a light gray background a gray strip extends horizontally across the picture, with geometric incisions. The parapet and stone column in mixed media, with a relief effect.

1485.d: Esiplaanil kaks ebakorrapärase kujuga tipust murenenud kivi, mõlemad maalitud pastoosselt, kivi pinnale veetud lõikuvaid jooni. Vasaku kivi all pastoosne roheline triip ning kohal valge nr. 1. Parema kivi all punane triip ja kohal nr. 2. Numbrite kohal ülaservas valge horisontaalne triip üle kogu töö. Foon hall. Üle kogu pildi pinna kasutatud reljeefsuse saavutamiseks liiva.
1485.de: In the foreground two stones of irregular shape, weathered at the top, both painted pastosely, with intersecting lines drawn on the stone surface. Under the left stone a pastose green stripe and above it a white no. 1. Under the right stone a red stripe and above it no. 2. Above the numbers, at the upper edge, a white horizontal stripe across the whole work. Background grey. Sand used across the entire surface of the picture to achieve relief.

1486.dm: kõrgus: 130.0 cm (III osa   ); kõrgus: 130.0 cm (II osa    ); laius: 130.0 cm (I osa   ); laius: 65.0 cm (III osa   )
1486.d: I osa: klaasist seintega Tallinna mere-reisisadama ootepaviljon. Läbi klaasseinte paistab meri, valge laev, kai ja sadamahooned. Ülaservas tumesiniste pilvedega taevas, Oleviste kiriku torn ja kahe suurema maja katused vasakul ja paremal servas.
1486.de: Part I: the glass-walled waiting pavilion of Tallinn's sea passenger port. Through the glass walls the sea, a white ship, the quay and port buildings are visible. At the upper edge a sky with dark blue clouds, the tower of St. Olaf's Church and the roofs of two larger buildings at the left and right edges.

1492.d: Interjöörivaade segamini tööruumiga. Ruumi põrandal laiali pillutatud esemeid: esiplaanil helesinine poekott ja lauasahtel, nende taga lahtisi pabereid, vihikuid ja mängukaarte. Tagaplaanil kirjutuslaud, riiul, lahtise uksega kapp ja tool, kõikidel pindadel esemeid. Maal viimistletud aerosooltehnikas ja värvi tilgutades, vasakule ülevale äärde maalitud värvikaart.
1492.de: An interior view, mixed up with a work room. Objects scattered on the floor of the room: in the foreground a light blue shopping bag and a table drawer, behind them loose papers, notebooks and playing cards. In the background a writing desk, a shelf, a cabinet with an open door and a chair, objects on all surfaces. The painting finished in aerosol technique and by dripping paint, a colour chart painted in the upper left edge.

1494.d: Stseen alasti mehe ja musta olevusega öises tuulises meres. Stseeni ümbritseb roosakas maalitud raam, mille vasak- ja parempoolsel osal reljeefsed liivakarva püramiidid.
1494.de: A scene of a naked man and a black being in a windy night sea. The scene is surrounded by a pinkish painted frame, on the left and right parts of which are relief pyramids in a sand colour.

1496.dm: kõrgus: 70.0 cm; laius: 80.0 cm; kõrgus: 70.0 cm; laius: 80.0 cm
1496.d: I. Helesinisel foonil reljeefselt väljaulatuv töö autori kipsmask, mille ülemise osa roosa läheb lõuendil laia ribana allapoole kulgedes servas all üle erkpunaseks.
1496.de: I. On a light blue background a relief protruding work, the author's plaster mask, the upper part of which, pink, runs down the canvas as a wide band, turning bright red at the edge below.

1497.d: Töö alumine osa kollakashall, ülemine osa lillakashall, horisontaalsest keskjoonest pisut kõrgemal üks laiem ja teine kitsam hall triip. Kitsamat triipu läbib vertikaalteljel hele ristkülik. Koloriit erinevate hallide toonide gradatsioon.
1497.de: The lower part of the work is yellowish grey, the upper part purplish grey; slightly above the horizontal centre line there are two grey stripes, one wider and one narrower. The narrower stripe is crossed on the vertical axis by a light rectangle. The colour scheme is a gradation of different grey tones.

1498.d: Kaks lineaarperspektiivis antud teineteise taga asetsevat püsttahukat. Toonid elevandiluuvärvist helehalli ja -siniseni.
1498.de: Two upright rectangular blocks placed one behind the other in linear perspective. Tones ranging from ivory to light grey and blue.

1499.d: Altservast sinisel, edasi keskplaanis roosal ja ülal tasapisi taas siniseks mineval foonil kaks tumesinist, kergelt kaldu triipu.
1499.de: From the bottom edge blue, further in the middle ground pink and above gradually turning blue again, on this background two dark blue, slightly slanted stripes.

1501.d: Hallikassinisel foonil sööstab pildi paremast ülemisest kolmandikust, servast viltu vasakule alla algul erksinine, lõpuks valgeks muutuv juga.
1501.de: Against a greyish-blue background a waterfall shoots down from the upper right third of the picture, diagonally from the edge to the lower left, at first bright blue, finally turning white.

1502.d: Allosas õrnsinine pind, mis teravate, kuristiku serva meenutavate nurkadena lõikuvad ülemisse, roosasse ruumi.
1502.de: Pale blue surface at the bottom, cutting into the upper, pink area with sharp corners resembling the edge of a ravine.

1503.d: Alt paremast nurgast tõusevad ülespoole kaks teineteisega väikese nurga all asuvat halli pinda, mida ülalt, otsekui platoona katab teravalt ülejäänud heledasse ruumi lõikuv õrnsinine pind.
1503.de: From the lower right corner two grey planes rise upward at a small angle to each other, covered from above, as if by a plateau, by a delicate blue plane that cuts sharply into the remaining light space.

1506.d: Sinine, vasakult paremal pürgiv kolmnurk, mis algab servast valkjassinisena ja on tipus sügavsinine. Foon ülal ja paremal kahvatusinistes toonides.
1506.de: A blue triangle rising from left to right, beginning at the edge whitish-blue and deep blue at the tip. The background above and to the right in pale blue tones.

1507.d: Üksteisesse lõikuvatest geomeetrilistest pindadest kompositsioon: esiplaanil moodustavad tohutu tahuka helesinine ja sinakasroheline pind. Ülal läheb, vasakult alates sinakasvalge toon-toonilt üle siniseks ja sealt edasi kahvaturoosast parema serva tumeroosani.
1507.de: A composition of intersecting geometric planes: in the foreground a huge faceted block forms a light blue and bluish-green surface. Above, starting from the left, a bluish-white tone shifts gradually into blue, and further on from pale pink to dark pink at the right edge.

1509.d: 3/4 maali ülemisest osast kahvatusinine aimatav taevalaotus, all helelilla pind. Silmapiiril vasakul astmeliselt paigutatud helesinised nelinurksed kujundid.
1509.de: 3/4 of the upper part of the painting shows a pale blue suggested sky, below a light lilac surface. On the horizon at left, light blue rectangular shapes arranged in steps.

1510.d: 2/3 maali ülaosast kahvatusinine taevalaotus, mis liitub selgepiiriliselt alt tumedama sinakaslilla pinnaga. Silmapiirilt vasakult lõikub taevasse noolsirge kujund.
1510.de: 2/3 of the upper part of the painting is a pale blue sky, which merges at the bottom, with a clear boundary, with a darker bluish-purple surface. From the horizon on the left an arrow-straight form cuts into the sky.

1516.d: Kujutatud osa kaatri pardast mitmesuguste metalsete vaheseinte, ustega kahel pool torubarjääri taga. Kaatri kõrval paremal kõrgub suurema laeva külg. Roheks - mustjas koloriit, fotolikke võtteid kasutav laad.
1516.de: Depicted is a part of a boat's side with various metal partitions, doors on both sides behind a tube railing. Next to the boat on the right rises the side of a larger ship. Green-blackish colour scheme, style using photographic techniques.

1517.d: Esiplaanil lähedaltvaates osa neoonrekleemi tähest, roosal foonil helesinise gaasiga täidetud torud. Foon tume, kohati üleval ja eriti all vasakus nurgas tumehalli pastoosse värvi abstraktne mäng.
1517.de: In the foreground, in close-up, part of a neon sign letter, light blue gas-filled tubes on a pink background. Background dark, in places above and especially in the lower left corner an abstract play of dark grey pastose paint.

1518.d: Esiplaanil, kohati väga pastoosselt maalitud sinises teksajakis heledapäine noormees redelil töökindad käes akent pesemas. Paremal kaks akent, vasakul majasein ja vihmaveetoru. Kõik elusuuruses.
1518.de: In the foreground, painted at times very impasto, a fair-haired young man in a blue denim jacket on a ladder, wearing work gloves, washing a window. On the right two windows, on the left the house wall and a drainpipe. All life-size.

1519.d: Vaade ülalt kaubajaamale: esiplaanil tihedalt rööbasteid ja ronge, üksikuid vaguneid ja tsisterne. Tagaplaanil vaade Tallinna Toompeale. Ülal hallikas taevas. Koloriit tume, kasutatud peamiselt pruune ja tumerohelisi toone, kohati pastoosset valget värvi.
1519.de: A view from above of a freight yard: in the foreground densely packed rails and trains, individual wagons and tank cars. In the background a view of Toompea in Tallinn. Above, a greyish sky. Colouring dark, mainly browns and dark greens used, with pastose white paint applied in places.

1521.d: Pildi keskteljel vertikaalselt peaaegu üle kogu pildi pinna alt valge, ülalt hallikassinine tuletorn vilkuva helgiheitjaga tipus. Foon erinevatestoonides sinine ja hall, kohati valgeid pastoosseid triipe ja laike.
1521.de: On the picture's central vertical axis, extending almost across the entire picture surface, a lighthouse - white below, greyish-blue above - with a flashing beacon at its top. The background in various tones of blue and grey, in places white pastose stripes and patches.

1523.d: Esiplaanil keskel suurelt reisilaev "Georg Ots", üleni valge, sinine triip küljel. Laeva ees, tohutute tiibadega laeva osaliselt varjates, pikeerib väljasirutatud jalgade ja lahtise nokaga kajakas. Laeva ja kajakat ümbritsev vesi ja taevas ühtviisi rohekas - sinised. Kajaka sulestik ja vahused laineharjad on maalitud pastoosselt valge värviga.
1523.de: In the foreground, large in the centre, the passenger ship "Georg Ots", entirely white with a blue stripe on the side. In front of the ship, partly obscuring it with its enormous wings, a gull dives with outstretched legs and open beak. The water and sky surrounding the ship and the gull are alike greenish-blue. The gull's plumage and the foamy wave crests are painted pastosely in white paint.

1524.d: Ruumis paremal seina ääres avatud kohver riietega, kummuti nurk, millel pappkast, ümber kukkunud triikraud. Kummuti kohal paistab osa maalist etiketiga: "Naine peegli ees". Sellel kujutatud pikajuukseline noor naine peegli ees. Vasakul osa uksest varjab pilti.
1524.de: In the room, on the right by the wall, an open suitcase with clothes, a corner of a chest of drawers with a cardboard box on it, a fallen-over iron nearby. Above the chest of drawers, part of a painting with the label "Woman in Front of a Mirror" is visible. It depicts a young woman with long hair in front of a mirror. Part of a door on the left conceals the picture.

1526.d: Linnavaade sõitva kollase Ikarus-bussiga. Autoteest paremal asfalteeritud parkla maha joonistatud keksumängu ja maas lebavate prillidega. Taamal elektriliin, majad ja puud.
1526.de: Cityscape with a moving yellow Ikarus bus. To the right of the road, an asphalted parking lot with a hopscotch grid drawn on it and glasses lying on the ground. In the distance a power line, houses and trees.

1546.d: Madala, külmalt helenduva silmapiiriga avaruse foonil mustjas trapetsikujuline, vasakule üles suunduv pind, mis katab osaliselt vasakul ülal rohelise kumaga kera, paremal ääres uksepiita meenutavat kujundit. Allosas, sinkjast udust paistmas tume kujundi nurk. Vasakul ääres kitsas, alt üles ühtlaselt tumenev pind.
1546.de: Against the background of a low, coldly glowing horizon of open space, a blackish trapezoidal surface directed upward to the left, partly covering, at the upper left, a sphere with a greenish glow, and on the right edge a shape resembling a doorpost. In the lower part, the dark corner of a shape shows through bluish mist. On the left edge, a narrow surface, evenly darkening from bottom to top.

1547.d: Mustades, hallides, sinistes ja valgetes toonides metafüüsiline maastik: ees keskel neljakandiline sammas, mille taha jäävad suured üksteisesse lõikuvad hallid pinnad. Paremal servas valge muna, mille alt voolab välja hall riie. Silmapiiril, vertikaalsel keskteljel, suundub ülespoole suitsujuga meenutav hall joon.
1547.de: A metaphysical landscape in black, grey, blue and white tones: in the centre foreground a rectangular column, behind which lie large intersecting grey surfaces. On the right edge a white egg, from under which a grey cloth flows. On the horizon, on the vertical central axis, a grey line resembling a smoke trail rises upward.

1548.d: Geomeetrilistest kehadest koosnev metafüüsiline maastik hallides ja sinistes toonides. Foonil ülasuunas tumenev sinine taevas. Vasakul torniga kindlust meenutav hoone, mille ees horisontaalsel joonel suur muna. Muna vari langeb hallile maapinnale.
1548.de: A metaphysical landscape composed of geometric bodies in grey and blue tones. In the background a blue sky darkening upwards. On the left a building resembling a fortress with a tower, in front of it on a horizontal line a large egg. The egg's shadow falls onto the grey ground.

1550.d: Sinine taust muutub ülaltpoolt sujuvalt mustjaks. Tausta keskel nelinurkne metafüüsiline kujund-vaade: terashall ühtlane sein-pind all vasakul, üle selle heidetud siidise voldustikuga tumesinine draperii. Halli pinna paremal nurgal kollakasroheline kera, lummav valgus keral ja draperiivoldil. Tagapool sinkjashall avarus.
1550.de: The blue background gradually turns blackish toward the top. In the centre of the background a rectangular metaphysical shape-view: a steel-grey uniform wall-surface at the lower left, over which a dark-blue drapery with silky folds is cast. At the right corner of the grey surface, a yellowish-green sphere, a captivating light on the sphere and on the drapery fold. Behind it, a bluish-grey expanse.

1565.dm: kõrgus: 127.0 cm; sügavus: 30.0 cm; laius: 51.0 cm
1565.d: Roostetanud vanarauast kokku keevitatud piklik loomataoline kehand kolmel jalal. Esimese üksiku jala all saeketas, tagumiste jalgade all kummalgi kaks erineva suurusega hammasratast. Skulptuuri esiosas markeerib koonu piklik lame keevitis, tahaosas "saba" ümaralt painutatud raudarmatuur. Signatuur, peale- ja tahakirjutused puuduvad.
1565.de: An elongated animal-like body welded together from rusted scrap iron, standing on three legs. Under the single front leg a saw blade, under each of the rear legs two gear wheels of different sizes. At the front of the sculpture the snout is marked by an elongated flat weld, at the rear a "tail" made of a rounded bent iron reinforcement bar. No signature, no inscriptions on the front or back.

1577.dm: lehe kõrgus: 77.3 cm; kujutise laius: 44.4 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 72.0 cm; lehe laius: 49.5 cm
1577.d: kujutise pind tihedalt täidetud horisontaalsete joontega, mille vahel punktid. Nendest omakorda moodustumas vertikaalne, sümmeetriline ornament
1577.de: The surface of the image densely filled with horizontal lines, between which are dots. From these in turn a vertical, symmetrical ornament is formed

1587.d: Kaheosaline, sinisel pinnal olev kujund saab alguse ülalt vasakult. Ümarjas punane kujund evib poolkuu kujulist vasakut serva mis on valge. Punane ebaühtlane joon kulgeb kaarjalt maali keskossa kus paikneb keskteljest veidi paremal roosakas-valge kolmnurgasarnane kujutis, millest kasvavad välja kaks sinistes toonides jalgu meenutavat osa; mille vahelt väljub punane värv nõrguvate niredena. "Jalad" on põlvedest kõverdatud, kahele poole kõrvale väänatud.
1587.de: A two-part shape on a blue surface begins at the upper left. A rounded red form has a crescent-shaped left edge that is white. An uneven red line curves into the middle of the painting, where a pinkish-white triangle-like image is located, slightly to the right of the central axis, from which grow two leg-like parts in blue tones; between them red paint emerges in trickling drips. The "legs" are bent at the knees, twisted out to either side.

1588.dm: kõrgus: 290.0 cm; kujutise laius: 206.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 270.7 cm; laius: 206.0 cm
1588.d: Suur avatud suuga nägu, musta suuava ümbritsevad leekidest huuled. Näo alaosa rohekais-kollastes toonides, nina roosakais toonides. Nina meenutab ilma peata tagurpidi tordot. Rombilaadsed silmad on kollased ilma täpsema detailinguta. Laup sinine, laubal 4 lainjat, valget, lendavaid linde meenutavat kortsu. Oimud oranžid, ninajuurel reljeefsed värvitükid.
1588.de: A large face with an open mouth, the black mouth opening surrounded by lips made of flames. The lower part of the face in greenish-yellow tones, the nose in pinkish tones. The nose resembles an upside-down cake without a top. The rhombus-like eyes are yellow without more detailed articulation. The forehead is blue, with 4 wavy white wrinkles resembling flying birds. The temples are orange, with relief-like patches of paint at the root of the nose.

1595.d: Istuva naise poolfiguur otsevaates, käed risti rinnal. Valkjas-pruun kampsun, lühikesed juuksed, rohekate helkidega nägu. Laiad lopsakad pintslilöögid.  (eesti)
1595.de: A half-figure of a seated woman in frontal view, arms crossed on her chest. A whitish-brown cardigan, short hair, a face with greenish highlights. Broad, lush brushstrokes.

1604.d: Valdavalt kollakasrohelisel, kohati ekspressiivsete erksavärviliste tõmmetega, kohati voolavate värviniredega maalitud foonil kaks värvivines alasti naisfiguuri teineteise süles-embuses. Malbe, äraoleva ilmega näod pööratud vaatajale. Parempoolse pea kohal roheline, vasakpoolsel sinine värvilaik.
1604.de: On a predominantly yellowish-green background, painted in places with expressive bright-coloured strokes, in places with flowing streams of colour, two nude female figures in a colourful embrace, in each other's lap. Meek, absent-looking faces turned toward the viewer. Above the head on the right, a green colour patch, on the left one a blue colour patch.

1606.d: Heledal, värviliste vertikaalsete vööndite foonil, pea alaspidi alla paremale, jalad täisnurkselt vasakule, kollases rõivas üldistatult noore naise figuur rohekas-kollakate juustega; kõhu juures mesilane. Keskel horisontaalselt üle naise figuuri alasti selili inimese figuur, helerohekas toonis ja ilma peata, põlvist murtud jalad täisnurkselt alla vasakule.
1606.de: Against a light background of coloured vertical bands, head upside down toward the lower right, legs at a right angle to the left, a generalized figure of a young woman in yellow clothing with greenish-yellowish hair; a bee near her stomach. In the middle, horizontally across the woman's figure, a nude human figure lying on its back, in light greenish tones and without a head, legs bent at the knee at a right angle downward to the left.

1645.d: Valgel foonil vasakus servas suur, maalipinnast reljeefina eenduv hollandi ahi Kadrioru lossist. Ahju kahlid sinise koobaltmaalinguga, lillemustris. Ahju otsas kahvaturoheline lipp ja ees mänguautona mõjuv roheline kastmisauto, tohutu hallikasbeež suitsusammas taga.
1645.de: On a white background in the left edge a large Dutch stove from Kadriorg Palace, protruding as a relief from the paint surface. The stove's tiles with blue cobalt painting, in a floral pattern. On top of the stove a pale green flag and in front a green watering truck resembling a toy car, an enormous grey-beige column of smoke behind it.

1646.dm: kõrgus: 182.0 cm; sügavus: 4.0 cm; laius: 286.0 cm
1646.d: Ülaosas kujutatud kahte vaipa tsitaatidega vene maalikunstist (Kolm vene vägilast. Aljonuška) vaipkattele maalituna. Keskosas Viljandi kesklinna risttee heleda kahekorruselise hoonega nurgal, reljeefselt vormitud. Maja katusel tumepunane sametlipp. Hoone ees vasakul reljeefne tänavavalgustuspost, vasakult lähenemas veoauto musta sargaga. Maali allosas nurk kireva ornamendiga vaibast. Sellel karnevalikostüümis väike tüdruk kollase olevusega, kiri all: "Õ-JUTA". Paremas alumises nurgas alusel paiknev palmipuu ja lapsekäega joonistatud auto.
1646.de: In the upper part, two carpets are depicted with quotations from Russian painting (Three Bogatyrs, Alyonushka) painted onto the carpet coverings. In the central part, the crossroads of Viljandi town centre, at the corner of a light-coloured two-storey building, formed in relief. On the roof of the building a dark red velvet flag. In front of the building on the left a relief street lamp post, a truck with a black box approaching from the left. In the lower part of the painting, the corner of a carpet with colourful ornament. On it, a small girl in a carnival costume with a yellow creature, with the inscription below: "Õ-JUTA". In the lower right corner, a palm tree on a stand and a car drawn with a child's hand.

1647.d: Kompositsioon Tartu vana anatoomikumi ja lumememmega. Vasakul roheline kolmnurkse frontooni, pseudosammaste ja rõduga anatoomikumi keskosa, mille külge kinnitatud pärg ning mille ees seisab pruutpaar koos käivitatud auto ja ehitud kuusepuuga. Stseenile peale, anatoomikumi kohale lohakalt maalitud helesinine lumememm ja kaks loomade ja kuusepuudega pilti.
1647.de: Composition with the old Tartu Anatomicum and a snowman. On the left, the green central part of the Anatomicum with a triangular pediment, pseudo-columns and a balcony, to which a wreath is attached, and in front of which stands a bridal couple together with a running car and a decorated fir tree. Over the scene, above the Anatomicum, a carelessly painted light blue snowman and two pictures with animals and fir trees.

The women are in folk costume, a brooch on the chest, aprons in front, kerchiefs on their heads. Below the word Friedrich (mirror-image).
