4280.d: Esiplaanil laual läbipaistvas alt avarduvad vaasis kimp kuivanud kõrsi. Vaas ümaral madala servaga alusel, millest paremal õun ja väike uhmer uhmrinuiaga. Interjööri kollakaspruunil seinal fooniks maal, mille all roheline tugitool.
4280.de: In the foreground, on a table, a bunch of dried stalks in a transparent vase widening from the bottom. The vase stands on a round base with a low rim, to the right of which is an apple and a small mortar with a pestle. On the yellowish-brown wall of the interior, a painting serves as background, beneath which stands a green armchair.

4283.d: Peamiselt rohelistes ja roosakaspunastes toonides figuraalne kompositsioon, mille esiplaanil vasakul hallis ülikonnas mees, käed vaheliti rinnal ja paremal rohelises ülikonnas, sinises kampsunis, tugeva lõuaga mees, käed kõhul. Esiservas osa verandast. Foonil keskplaanis meeste vahel väike pink, marjakorvid ja pruun samovar. Tagaplaanil valge linaga kaetud laud, mille taga vasakul seisab hallis ülikonnas ja sinises lipsus vana kuivetu mees, kimp roosasid gladioole süles. Temast paremal istub laua taga, klaas käes, tumesinises ülikonnas mustade raamidega prillides mees. Laua vasakus otsas tüdruk - korv ühes ja lilled teised käes, kollastest lilledest pärg peas. Laua paremas otsas punane tabur
4283.de: A figural composition mainly in green and pinkish-red tones, in the foreground of which, on the left, is a man in a grey suit with his arms crossed on his chest, and on the right a man with a strong jaw in a green suit and blue jumper, hands on his stomach. In the front edge, part of a veranda. In the background, in the middle ground, between the men, a small bench, berry baskets and a brown samovar. In the background a table covered with a white cloth, behind which on the left stands an old, gaunt man in a grey suit and blue tie, holding a bunch of pink gladioli in his arms. To his right, seated at the table with a glass in hand, is a man in a dark blue suit and black-framed glasses. At the left end of the table a girl - a basket in one hand and flowers in the other, a wreath of yellow flowers on her head. At the right end of the table a red stool

4284.d: Maalipind jagatud digonaaljoontega kolmeks. Keskosas vanikuga auvärava vahelt läbi sõitmas kuldjuustega ehitud hobune kaarikuga, kus istuvad setu rõivais toekas naine ja mees. Taga ja kõrval paistmas inimesi, hobune. Paremal osa palkseinast, seisva setu mehe tinglik kujutis, vikat käes. Vasakul valge hobune tagantvaates, maas hobuseriistu.
4284.de: The painting surface is divided by diagonal lines into three parts. In the central section, a horse adorned with golden hair, pulling a cart through a garlanded honorary gate, in which sit a sturdy woman and man dressed in Setu costume. Behind and beside them, people and a horse are visible. On the right part of a log wall, a conventional depiction of a standing Setu man with a scythe in hand. On the left a white horse seen from behind, harness lying on the ground.

4287.d: Õuel, puu all linaga kaetud laual kolm kollast puuvilja. Ümber laua kolm meest vestlemas: vasakpoolne noormees kollases särgis, veinikann süles; keskel peakattes habemik vaataja suunas, klaas käes; paremal poolkiilaspäine mees selgvaates. Istujate kohal viljapuude võrad, taustal majanurk. Tagaplaanil vasakul kauged sinetavad mäed.
4287.de: In the yard, under a tree, on a table covered with linen, three yellow fruits. Around the table three men conversing: the man on the left in a yellow shirt, with a wine jug in his lap; in the middle a bearded man wearing headgear, facing the viewer, glass in hand; on the right a half-bald man in profile view. Above those seated the crowns of fruit trees, in the background the corner of a house. In the background on the left, distant bluish mountains.

4288.d: Hallikaslilla pilvevahus taeva all vaade metsaäärsele lagendikule. Ees samblarohekais toonides maapind, keskel pruunikad, kollakas lehtpuud, kohati tüved kollasega markeeritud.
4288.de: View of a clearing at the edge of a forest under a sky of grayish-purple cloud foam. Ground in mossy green tones in the foreground, brownish, yellowish deciduous trees in the middle, trunks in places marked with yellow.

4289.d: Pronksise läikega hõbedasel taustal murdunud puu tüvi üksikute roheliste võrsetega. Selle ees väike puupink, millel vaas õunapuuoksaga. Pingi ees hele linik õuntega ümberläinud korvist. Puutüve taga paremal korv puuviljadega, rohelisi vilju maas. Laotuses poolringi kujuline värviline pind.
4289.de: Against a silvery background with a bronze sheen, the trunk of a broken tree with a few green shoots. In front of it a small wooden bench, on which stands a vase with an apple-tree branch. In front of the bench a light-coloured cloth with apples spilling out of a tipped-over basket. Behind the tree trunk on the right a basket of fruit, with some fruit lying loose on the ground. The layout has a semicircular coloured area.

4290.d: Kuldse-hõbedase läikega fooni keskel avatud suuga kartulikott. Selle ees vasakul sangaga nõu, kartulid pillatud ümber. Paremal maas vartega peete, sibulaid, muid juurvilju. Pildi ülaservas osa loperguse äärega värvilisest pilvest.
4290.de: In the middle of a background with a golden-silvery sheen, an open-mouthed potato sack. In front of it on the left, a vessel with a handle, potatoes scattered around. On the right, on the ground, beets with stems, onions, other root vegetables. At the top edge of the picture, part of a colourful cloud with a ragged edge.

4291.d: Maalil kujutatud tumesinisel lainetaval merel draakonipeaga laev, mille moodustavad hallid kivid. Laeval keskel mänd, äärtel kadakad. Männi all kolm inimfiguuri ja hobuse seljas Kalevipoeg, mõõk puusal. Sinises taevas paremal pilved, vasakul lind.(eesti)
4291.de: The painting depicts a dragon-headed ship on a dark blue rippling sea, formed by grey stones. In the centre of the ship a pine tree, junipers at the edges. Under the pine three human figures and Kalevipoeg on horseback, sword at his hip. In the blue sky, clouds on the right, a bird on the left.

4295.d: Esiplaanil pruunide juustega naise rindkere ning kollaste jalgade ja pika sabaga pruuni linnu tagaosaga olevus hallil kaljunukil. Tagaplaanil erksinise veega lahesopp, liivarand ning mets. Ülal valgete pilvedega taevas.
4295.de: In the foreground the chest of a woman with brown hair and the rear part of a brown bird with yellow legs and a long tail, a creature on a grey rocky outcrop. In the background a bay inlet with bright blue water, a sandy beach and a forest. Above, a sky with white clouds.

4296.d: Otsekui külma sinise valgusega ülekallatud figuraalne kompositsioon: kivide, rohututtide ja üksikute põõsastega kaetud mereäärsel kaljuplatool vasakul erkroosa ihuga alasti naine, pikad punased juuksed lehvivad tuules, vaade üle õla vaataja poole, käte vahel valge lina. Paremal tõttab suurte sammudega naise poole hallides toonides maalitud musklis mees, juuksed tuules lehvimas. Foonil tumesinise veega lahesopp, ülal hõredalt pilvedega kaetud taevas. Pildi allservas keskel hülge pealuu.
4296.de: A figural composition as if drenched in cold blue light: on a seaside rocky plateau covered with stones, tufts of grass and solitary bushes, on the left a bright pink-bodied nude woman, long red hair fluttering in the wind, gaze over her shoulder toward the viewer, a white cloth between her hands. On the right, a muscular man painted in grey tones hurries toward the woman with great strides, his hair fluttering in the wind. In the background a bay inlet with dark blue water, above a sky sparsely covered with clouds. In the lower centre of the picture, a seal's skull.

4298.d: Mustjasrohekal taustal tumesinises pintsakus, sinises särgis musta lipsuga noore mehe poolfiguur, pea pööratud vasakule, käed süles. Mehel kõrge laup, tumedad juuksed, kulmud, vuntsid ja lõuahabe, kurvavõitu ilme.
4298.de: Against a blackish-greenish background, a half-figure of a young man in a dark blue jacket, blue shirt and black tie, head turned to the left, hands in his lap. The man has a high forehead, dark hair, eyebrows, moustache and chin beard, a somewhat sad expression.

4299.d: Kadakapuhmastega suvisel maastikul kahest tihedast põõsast ülakeha ulatuses välja kasvavat alasti figuuri: vasakul habeme ja lehvivate pikkade juustega mees, kerges pöördes paremale, elavas vestluses heledapäise pikajuukselise noore naisega. Viimasel žestideks tõstetud käed.
4299.de: In a summer landscape with juniper bushes, a nude figure grows out to the upper body from two dense bushes: on the left a man with a beard and long flowing hair, in a slight turn to the right, in lively conversation with a fair-haired, long-haired young woman. The latter's hands are raised in gestures.

4301.d: Kollastes ja mustades toonides kompositsioon Kalevipojaga maa-aluses koopas. Kompositsiooni keskmes alasti, lehvivate juustega Kalevipoja täisfiguur, käes põlev kadakaoks ja jalg loomapealuuga kivikuhilal. Taustal mustav koopasuu, stalaktiidid, paekivisein ja kivikuhilad.
4301.de: A composition in yellow and black tones with Kalevipoeg in an underground cave. At the centre of the composition, the full figure of the naked Kalevipoeg with flowing hair, holding a burning juniper branch and a foot on an animal skull on a pile of stones. In the background, the blackening mouth of the cave, stalactites, a limestone wall and piles of stones.

4340.d: Pehmetes beežides ja pruunides toonides maalitud teravajoonelise pika lõua, sirge nina ja sügaval asetsevate silmadega naise portree. Naisel kohevad poolpikad juuksed, seljas hall kleit, millel pitsäärisega valge krae, kleidil punakaspruun kolmnurkse kaelaaugu ja laia kraega mantel või jakk.
4340.de: A portrait, painted in soft beige and brown tones, of a woman with a sharp-lined long chin, straight nose and deep-set eyes. The woman has fluffy shoulder-length hair, wears a grey dress with a lace-edged white collar, and over the dress a reddish-brown coat or jacket with a triangular neckline and wide collar.

4341.d: Vaikelu suure vaskkastruli, väikese vaskkopsiku ja klaasist karahviniga tumedal laual. Suurest kastrulist paremal terrakotakarva draperii. Laua taga tume viini tool, laua ees põrandal kastrulikaas. Foon tumehall.
4341.de: Still life with a large copper saucepan, a small copper scoop and a glass carafe on a dark table. To the right of the large saucepan, a terracotta-coloured drapery. Behind the table a dark Vienna chair, in front of the table on the floor a saucepan lid. Background dark grey.

4342.d: Kollase valgusega ülekallatud vaikelu: valgel, pisut kortsus linal keskel suur, lahtilõigatud kõrvits. Kõrvitsa taga suur punane savipott; ees kaks sibulat, väljastpoolt kollane plekk-kruus, paremal pika kaelaga pruun savipudel sibulaga viimase ees. Vasakul nurgas kummuli plekist lehter (sibul selle taga) ja valge plekk-kruus, mille alt glasuur osaliselt pudenenud. Foon kuldpruun.
4342.de: A still life bathed in yellow light: on a white, slightly wrinkled cloth, in the middle, a large cut-open pumpkin. Behind the pumpkin a large red clay pot; in front two onions, a yellow tin mug seen from outside, on the right a long-necked brown clay bottle with an onion in front of it. In the left corner an upturned tin funnel (an onion behind it) and a white tin mug, from which the glaze has partly chipped off. Background golden brown.

4343.d: Pruunides toonides vaikelu heleda riidega kaetud laual: keskel kollane kõrvits pruunil riidel ja apelsin; kõrvitsa taga tumepruun kõhukas keraamiline nõu; vasakul äralibisenud kaanega vaskkastrul. Kõrvitsast ja apelsinist paremal veeklaas ja sangaga, alt laienev vasktoop. Foon ookerkollane.
4343.de: A still life in brown tones on a table covered with a light-coloured cloth: in the centre a yellow pumpkin on a brown cloth and an orange; behind the pumpkin a dark brown, bulbous ceramic vessel; on the left a copper saucepan with a slightly displaced lid. To the right of the pumpkin and the orange a water glass, and a copper jug with a handle, widening towards the bottom. The background is ochre-yellow.

4345.d: Pruunides toonides, otsekui roosa valgusega ülekallatud interjöör figuuridega. Ümarate otsapatjadega diivanil istub vasakul O. Maran - seljas pruun, kõrge kraega kampsun, lillakaspunane sall, hall mantel. Temast paremal täpilises seelikus ja sinises rüüsidega pluusis S. Liiberg, heegeldatud villane pitsrätik õlgadel. Figuuride taga seinal O. Marani valges raamis merevaade, viimase kohal tumedas raamis pildi serv. Paremal, poikvel ukse vahelt avaneb vaade kõrvalruumi pimedusse.
4345.de: An interior in brown tones with figures, as if overlaid with pink light. On a sofa with round end cushions, O. Maran sits on the left - wearing a brown, high-collared jumper, a lilac-red scarf, a grey coat. To his right, S. Liiberg in a spotted skirt and a blue blouse with frills, a crocheted woollen lace shawl on her shoulders. Behind the figures on the wall, O. Maran's seascape in a white frame, above the latter the edge of a picture in a dark frame. On the right, through a door ajar, a view opens into the darkness of an adjoining room.

4351.d: Sügavpruunil taustal lauaplaat esemetega: ees vasakul tume küünlajalg, kaks kookospähklit ja kaks sidrunit. Paremal kookospähkel ning üks koonusekujuline, teine roosa siseküljega spiraalikujuline merekarp. Tagapool vasakul vaskkann ja sangadega pott. Esemete vahel sinise ääretriibuga rätt ja kuivanud oks. Maalil hallikaspruunid summutatud toonid.
4351.de: On a deep brown background, a tabletop with objects: in front on the left a dark candlestick, two coconuts and two lemons. On the right a coconut and two sea shells, one cone-shaped, the other spiral-shaped with a pink interior. Behind on the left a copper jug and a pot with handles. Among the objects a cloth with a blue border stripe and a dried branch. The painting is in muted greyish-brown tones.

4362.d: Tumepruuni draperii taustal, tumedal laual klaasnõu lillakate väikeseõieliste krüsanteemidega, lillede kõrval vasakul vaskne kõrge jalaga kiriklik anum, millel on peal väikese ristiga kaas. Anuma kõrval tume, hallikas, savist madal vaas. Lilledest paremale jäävad kaks üksteise otsa asetatud paksemat raamatut, kompositsiooni ees, valgel linikul kolmas, väiksem raamat kolme õunaga.
4362.de: Against a background of dark brown drapery, on a dark table, a glass vessel with small purplish chrysanthemum flowers; beside the flowers, on the left, a tall-footed copper ecclesiastical vessel with a lid topped by a small cross. Beside the vessel a dark, greyish, low clay vase. To the right of the flowers are two thicker books placed one on top of the other, and in front of the composition, on a white cloth, a third, smaller book with three apples.

4381.d: Esiplaanil all keskel helepruunis mantlis või pintsakus, kirju salliga, punakaspruuni kaabuga mehe portree. Vasak õlg välja maalitud, parem tumeroosa punktiirjoonega markeeritud. Foon roosa, kaetud tooni võrra tumedamate väikesi kepikesi meenutavate pintslilöökidega. Fooni ülemises neljandikus kaks lillakasroosat jämedamat ning peenike punane rõhttriip.
4381.de: In the lower centre foreground, a portrait of a man in a light brown coat or jacket, with a patterned scarf and a reddish-brown hat. The left shoulder is painted in, the right marked with a dark pink dotted line. The background is pink, covered with brushstrokes resembling small sticks in a slightly darker tone. In the upper quarter of the background two thicker purplish-pink horizontal stripes and one thin red one.

4384.d: Valges kaunivormilises vaasis erinevat liiki ja värvitooni lopsakad kollased õied. Foon rohekashall.
4384.de: In a beautiful white vase, lush yellow flowers of different species and colour tones. Background greenish-grey.

4385.d: Kollaselt helklevas kampsunis ja punases särgis keskealise, halli habemega mehe rinnaportree erkpunase narrimütsiga, mille otsas kelluke, peas. Foon valkjassinistes ja roosades toonides.
4385.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged man with a grey beard in a shimmering yellow jumper and red shirt, wearing a bright red jester's cap with a bell at its tip. Background in whitish-blue and pink tones.

4386.d: Keskel ülalt tugevasti aheneva kaelaga suures pudelis sinised, punased, rohelised ja pruunid suled, antud peaaegu abstraktselt mõjuvate värvilaikude kombinatsioonina. Foon ooker-beežides ja sinakates toonides värvipindade sulam.
4386.de: In the middle, in a large bottle with a strongly narrowing neck at the top, blue, red, green and brown feathers, rendered as a combination of almost abstractly effective colour patches. Background a blend of colour areas in ochre-beige and bluish tones.

4387.d: Sinistes, hallides ja punastes toonides keskealise naise poolfiguurportree. Poolpikad vasekarva juuksed kergelt laines, vaade paremale, näoilme endassepööratult tõsine. Foon valkjashall. Otsmik ja riided maalitud kirevate, peaaegu abstraktselt mõjuvate värvilaikude kombinatsioonina. Kohati värvikiht pastoosne.
4387.de: A half-figure portrait of a middle-aged woman in blue, grey and red tones. Semi-long copper-coloured hair in a slight wave, gaze to the right, facial expression introspective and serious. Background whitish-grey. The forehead and clothing are painted as a combination of vivid, almost abstractly effective colour patches. In places the paint layer is impasto.

4388.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon, kus vasakul kirstus kaks verise valge linaga kaetud surnukeha. Esiplaanil paremal valgesse mässitud surnu valgesse rõivastatud leinava naisega vasakul ning valge turbani ja habemega vana mehega paremal. Paremal servas kaks seisvat figuuri raamijoonega otsekui läbi lõigatud. Foonil keskel kaartega valge ehitus. Paremal ülal värvilised abstraktsed laigud, vasakul ülal sinine taevas.
4388.de: A figurative composition in which two blood-covered bodies wrapped in white linen lie in a coffin on the left. In the foreground on the right a body wrapped in white, with a mourning woman dressed in white on the left and an old man with a white turban and beard on the right. On the right edge two standing figures seemingly cut through by the frame line. In the background at the centre a white building with arches. Upper right coloured abstract patches, upper left blue sky.

4389.d: Hallis ülikonnas, heledate juuste ja habemega, prillidega noore mehe täisfiguurportree. Prillidest vaatavad otse vaatajale hallikassinised silmad. Foon hall, parempoolses servas keskel kolm kollast ruutu ja sellest kõrgemal punastes toonides abstraktne värvilaikude kombinatsioon. Ülikond maalitud lopsakate pintslitõmmetega, eredate värvilaikudena.
4389.de: Full-length portrait of a young man in a grey suit, with light-coloured hair and beard, wearing glasses. Behind the glasses, grey-blue eyes look directly at the viewer. The background is grey, in the middle of the right-hand edge three yellow squares, and above that an abstract combination of colour patches in red tones. The suit is painted with lush brushstrokes, as bright patches of colour.

4390.d: Lopsakates eredates värvilaikudes komponeeritud portree. Noorel mehel hall ülikond, must ja bordoopunane lips valgel särgil, punane nina ja rohelised juuksed. Vasakul foon antud pruunikashallides toonides pikkade pintslitõmmete reana, ülal foon helepruun.
4390.de: A portrait composed in lush bright patches of colour. The young man wears a grey suit, a black and burgundy-red tie on a white shirt, a red nose and green hair. On the left the background is given in brownish-grey tones as a row of long brush strokes, above the background is light brown.

4391.d: Suurtest kirevatest värvilaikudest koosnev kompositsioon: vasakul profiilis noormehe pea, ninajoon kaardus, suu avatud. Paremal allnurgas otsevaates noormees, parem käsi kõrva juurde tõstetud, seljas sinise-valgetriibuline spordisärk.
4391.de: A composition consisting of large, vividly coloured patches of colour: on the left in profile a young man's head, the nose line curved, mouth open. In the lower right corner, seen head-on, a young man, right hand raised to the ear, wearing a blue-and-white striped sports shirt.

4392.d: Suurtest värvilistest laikudest koosnev jalalaba ühtlaselt hallil foonil.
4392.de: A foot consisting of large coloured spots on an evenly grey background.

4393.d: Vana mehe poolfiguurportree otsevaates: mehel hallid juuksed, tugev, pisut kühmus nina, lähestikku asetsevad silmad. Maalitud erksate värvilaikude dekoratiivse kombinatsioonina. Foon valge, sinakate ja roosade varjudega.
4393.de: A frontal half-figure portrait of an old man: the man has grey hair, a strong, slightly hooked nose, closely set eyes. Painted as a decorative combination of vivid patches of colour. The background is white, with bluish and pinkish shadows.

4396.d: Hallil taustal, tumedal alusel kaks pikasäärelist saabast, vasakpoolne avatud lukuga viltu vajunud. Laiade pintslitõmmetega lopsakas maalilaad, saapad värviliste laikudega modelleeritud.
4396.de: On a grey background, on a dark base two knee-high boots, the left one open with the buckle askew. Lush painting style with broad brushstrokes, the boots modelled with patches of colour.

4397.d: Ees heledalt valgustatud maariba, rohekaspruun tume aimatav puudemass taga, üksikud eredad laigud lehestikul. Puulatvade tagant paistab veidike pilvetupsudega kakaobeeži taevast. Hoogne, laiade pintslitõmmetega maal.
4397.de: In front, a brightly lit strip of land, behind it a dark greenish-brown mass of trees can be made out, isolated bright patches on the foliage. Beyond the treetops a slightly cocoa-beige sky with tufts of cloud is visible. A vigorous painting with broad brushstrokes.

4398.d: Beežikasroosa taeva taustal püramidaalselt paigutatud värvikad puud-põõsad, ees keskel väike lagendik. Laiade pintslitõmmetega lopsakas maalilaad.
4398.de: Against a background of a beige-pink sky, colourful trees and bushes arranged pyramidally, in the centre in front a small clearing. A lush painting style with broad brushstrokes.

4399.d: Hallikasbeežil taustal heledavärviliste laikudega modelleeritud keskealise naise poolfiguur veerandpöördes paremale. Naisel lühikesed juuksed, huuled kokku pigistatud, pilk otse suunatud. Lopsakas, laiade pintslitõmmetega maal.
4399.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged woman in three-quarter turn to the right, modelled with light-coloured patches on a greyish-beige background. The woman has short hair, lips pressed together, gaze directed straight ahead. A lush painting with broad brushstrokes.

4401.d: Erksate värvilaikudega lahendatud kompositsioon istuvast naisaktist otsevaates, jalad kõverdatult käärasendis, käed ees süles, roosa laiaäärne kübar silmadel. Valdavalt sinakasrohelised, lillakasroosad toonid.
4401.de: A composition rendered with vivid patches of colour, of a seated female nude in frontal view, legs bent in a crossed position, hands in her lap, a pink wide-brimmed hat over her eyes. Predominantly bluish-green, purplish-pink tones.

4406.d: Värvikas kompositsioon erinevas mastaabis inim- ja loomafiguuridega. Keskel valgel foonil Niguliste kiriku torn, eespool sinisetriibulise särgiga mehe poolfiguur profiilis, tema vastas rohelisega markeeritud jänes. Kaks naist, kaabu, prillide ja portfelliga mees paremal. Vasakul hallikasroosal laigulisel taustal elevandipeaga kuju, tagapool naise pea.
4406.de: A colourful composition with human and animal figures of varying scale. In the centre, against a white background, the tower of St Nicholas' Church; in front, in profile, the half-figure of a man in a blue-striped shirt, facing him a hare marked in green. Two women, a man with a hat, glasses and a briefcase on the right. On the left, against a greyish-pink mottled background, a figure with an elephant's head, behind it a woman's head.

4573.de: The illustration depicts Kalevipoeg sitting on a stone, sword on his lap and hands on his knees. Behind Kalevipoeg wild animals are peering out, at his feet his brothers are crouching before him.

4574.d: Illustratsioonil kujutatud Kalevipoeg, juuksed lehvimas, mõõk puusal. Kalevipoja ees lehvivate juuste ja habemega Tark, kes on tõstnud käed üles, peopesadel nõiakirjad. Tema ees trumm. Tagaplaanil ümmargune ukseava.
4574.de: The illustration depicts Kalevipoeg, hair flowing, sword at the hip. In front of Kalevipoeg the Wise Man with flowing hair and beard, who has raised his hands, magic signs on his palms. In front of him a drum. In the background a round doorway.

4575.dm: kõrgus: 17.9 cm (plaadimõõt   ); laius: 23.5 cm (valgusmõõt   ); laius: 17.5 cm (plaadimõõt   ); kõrgus: 26.7 cm (valgusmõõt   )

4575.de: The illustration depicts Kalevipoeg striding through the stormy Peipsi, carrying a load of planks on his back. He holds a sword clenched in his teeth. On the right a sorcerer blows, cheeks puffed out.

4576.dm: kõrgus: 17.8 cm (plaadimõõt   ); laius: 23.4 cm (valgusmõõt   ); laius: 17.4 cm (plaadimõõt   ); kõrgus: 25.9 cm (valgusmõõt   )

4576.de: The illustration depicts the Hell Maiden transformed into a giant maiden, who has lifted the tiny Kalevipoeg onto her palm. In the background, the vaults of the underworld and an opening from which bushes can be seen.

4577.dm: kõrgus: 17.8 cm (plaadimõõt   ); laius: 23.4 cm (valgusmõõt   ); laius: 17.4 cm (plaadimõõt   ); kõrgus: 25.9 cm (valgusmõõt   )
4577.d: Illustratsioonil Kalevipoja jõuproov Sarvikuga (Kuradiga). Kalevipoeg paljajalu, lehvivate juustega, on haaranud Kuradist kinni ja tõstnud ta kõrgele. Kurat sarvede ja sabaga, jalgadel neli pikka varvast. Paremal põrgupiiga.
4577.de: The illustration shows Kalevipoeg's trial of strength with Sarvik (the Devil). Kalevipoeg, barefoot, with flying hair, has grabbed the Devil and lifted him high. The Devil with horns and a tail, four long toes on his feet. On the right a devil-maiden.

4578.dm: kõrgus: 17.8 cm (plaadimõõt   ); laius: 23.4 cm (valgusmõõt   ); laius: 17.4 cm (plaadimõõt   ); kõrgus: 25.8 cm (valgusmõõt   )
4578.d: Illustratsioonil kujutatud Kalevipoega lebamas paadipõhjas, aerud peos. Taevas virmalised, paadi ümber viirastused: looma- ja sortsinägudega olendid, keskel Põrgupiiga. Peninukid on löönud oma hambad paadiserva.
4578.de: The illustration depicts Kalevipoeg lying in the bottom of the boat, oars in hand. In the sky, northern lights, around the boat apparitions: creatures with animal and sorcerer faces, in the middle the Maiden of Hell. The water-sprites have bitten their teeth into the edge of the boat.

4579.dm: kõrgus: 17.8 cm (plaadimõõt   ); laius: 23.7 cm (valgusmõõt   ); laius: 17.5 cm (plaadimõõt   ); kõrgus: 25.5 cm (valgusmõõt   )

4579.de: In the illustration men with raised beer jugs feasting behind a table, in the centre Kalevipoeg. Behind Kalevipoeg's back the figure of an old man. Further away a kannel player sits and plays the kannel. Above, the moon is showing.

4580.dm: kõrgus: 17.8 cm (plaadimõõt   ); laius: 23.6 cm (valgusmõõt   ); laius: 17.5 cm (plaadimõõt   ); kõrgus: 25.6 cm (valgusmõõt   )
4580.d: Illustratsioonil Kalevipoeg ratsul, mõõk pea kohale tõstetud. Hobuse jalge all hunnik inimluid. Tema ees kilpide ja mõõkadega raudrüüdes mehed.
4580.de: The illustration shows Kalevipoeg on horseback, sword raised above his head. Under the horse's legs a pile of human bones. In front of him men in armour with shields and swords.

4581.de: The illustration depicts Kalevipoeg taking his last step, arms spread wide upward. In the water his legs are reflected, with the sword that cut them off.

4613.d: Kolmelt plaadilt trükitud suur sümmeetriline kompositsioon. Keskmises osas sambalaadne kujund, tüvesel vertikaalselt kellamehahanismid, kummalgi pool sümmeetrilisetl käod, all hammasrattad. Külgosadel korduvad kolm raketilaadset kujundit, mida ümbritsevad käekellad ja kroonivad lehekimbud. Sammaste alune pind täidetud horisontaalsete rooma ja araabia numbrite ridadega. Kellade sihverplaadid ja mehhanismid fotosöövituses
4613.de: A large symmetrical composition printed from three plates. In the middle section a column-like figure, on its shaft vertically arranged clock mechanisms, on each side symmetrical cuckoos, below gearwheels. On the side sections three rocket-like figures repeat, surrounded by wristwatches and crowned with bunches of leaves. The surface beneath the columns is filled with rows of horizontal Roman and Arabic numerals. The clock faces and mechanisms are in photo-etching

4622.de: Two seven-storey building facades converging diagonally towards the centre with rows of windows, half-figures of people looking out of the windows, trees depicted on the walls between the windows. In the middle of the image seven rows of balconies, where laundry dries on lines. At the top centre, in a circle, a large letter "Ü", framed by ears of grain

4623.dm: lehe kõrgus: 70.4 cm; lehe laius: 88.7 cm; kujutise laius: 79.7 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 49.0 cm
4623.d: Kaks diagonaalis keskele koonduvat seitsmekorruselise maja fassaadi akende ridadega, akendel väljavaatavate inimeste poolfiguurid, seintel akende vahele kujutatud puud. Kujutise keskel kolm horisontaalset balustraadiga rõdude rida. Rõdude kohal, keskel, ringis suur "Ü" täht, mida raamivad tammelehed. Ülal keskel reljeeftrükis kaks "!" taolist kujundit
4623.de: Two rows of windows of a seven-storey building façade converging diagonally toward the centre, half-figures of people looking out of the windows, trees depicted on the walls between the windows. In the centre of the image, three horizontal rows of balconies with balustrades. Above the balconies, in the centre, a large letter "Ü" within a circle, framed by oak leaves. At the top centre, in relief print, two shapes resembling "!".

4624.dm: lehe laius: 74.5 cm; kujutise laius: 64.5 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 48.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 58.3 cm
4624.d: Lehe ülemisel poolel vertikaaljoontega kolmeks osaks jagatud sinine poolring kaarega ülal. Vasak- ja parempoolses osas, ülal, pealtvaates kilpkonnataoline kujund. Keskmises osas kaare all vihmavarjud, sokid, võtmed, lipsud, kindad, prillid. All, valgel pinnal vasakul ja paremal sümmeetriliselt prillid, lips, võti, sokid, vihmavari ja lind reljeeftrükis. Keskmisel osal sümmeetriliselt kilpkonna, msk, kepp, kindad, võti, lips, prillid, süda

4948.de: A symmetrical grey-black shape in abstract curved forms, framed at the bottom by a black-and-white edge. Background grey

4957.d: Paremal servas teineteist hoidev paar: lillakashallis ülikonnas mees ja pruunis sviitris ja rohelises seelikus tumedajuukseline naine seisavad käest kinni hoides. Vasakul foonil veel üks ähmane naisefiguur kollases. Foon ülalt ookrikarva, alt punane. Näod antud peaaegu valgete laikudena.
4957.de: In the right edge, a couple holding onto each other: a man in a lilac-grey suit and a dark-haired woman in a brown sweater and green skirt stand holding hands. In the left background another blurred female figure in yellow. Background ochre-coloured above, red below. Faces given as almost white patches.

4958.d: Erkrohelisel foonil laua taga kaks figuuri: hallis kuues habeme ja harjasjuustega mees toetub vasaku küünarnukiga lauale. Tema süles heledamas hallis sviitris tumedate juustega poiss, kes, parem põlv laua vastu tõstetud, istub isa süles, käsi ümber isa kaela ning paremas käes väike tops.
4958.de: On a bright green background, two figures behind a table: a man in a grey coat with a beard and bristly hair leans with his left elbow on the table. In his lap a dark-haired boy in a lighter grey sweater, his right knee raised against the table, sits on his father's lap, arm around his father's neck, and a small cup in his right hand.

4959.d: Helesinise taeva taustal otsekui alt sügavikust vaadatuna ähmaselt antud figuurid pildi keskpunkti poole perspektiivselt koondumas. Selgemini eristatavad üks embav paar ja rohelises pearätikus ning pruunis rüüs naine. Helesinistes, hallides ja rohelistes toonides.
4959.de: Against a background of light blue sky, figures given hazily as if seen from a depth below, converging in perspective towards the centre point of the picture. More clearly distinguishable are one embracing couple and a woman in a green headscarf and brown robe. In light blue, grey and green tones.

4960.d: Esiplaanil keskel hallis riides ebamääraselt antud inimene maalimispuki taga. Valkjashallil foonil üksikud suured tumehallid laigud.
4960.de: In the centre foreground a vaguely rendered person in grey clothing behind a painting easel. Individual large dark grey patches on a whitish-grey background.

4961.d: Hallil foonil tumedate silmadega noor naine. Keha osa külgvaates, pea pööratud näoga vaataja poole. Naise seljal pikk tume pats, peas valge, rohelise lõngaga kirjatud kootud müts.
4961.de: Against a grey background, a young woman with dark eyes. Part of the body in side view, head turned with the face towards the viewer. On the woman's back a long dark braid, on her head a white knitted cap patterned with green yarn.

4962.d: Hallikasrohelisel foonil keskel pruun hallikasmusta lakaga hobune kõrvalseisva poisi pihust midagi nosimas. Poisi vasak käsi hobuse kaelal, ülakeha paljas, jalas hallid püksid. All vasakus nurgas sadul, rakmed ja valge rätik.
4962.de: Against a greyish-green background in the centre a brown horse with a greyish-black mane eating something out of the lap of a boy standing beside it. The boy's left hand is on the horse's neck, his upper body bare, wearing grey trousers. In the lower left corner a saddle, harness and a white towel.

4963.dm: kõrgus: 30.0 cm; sügavus: 38.5 cm; laius: 33.0 cm
4963.d: naise pea ülalpool kaela ära lõigatud, juuksed suunduvad taha, kaarjad kulmud, silmalaud suletud, pikem sirge nina, tundlik suu. Tugev üldistus
4963.de: the woman's head cut off above the neck, hair going backwards, arched eyebrows, closed eyelids, longer straight nose, sensitive mouth. Strong generalisation

4964.dm: kõrgus: 34.5 cm; sügavus: 30.0 cm; laius: 25.0 cm

4964.de: Stylised head of a young man with a narrow face, strong nose, wreath of hair, cut off above the neck

4965.d: Esiplaanil kaks sinkjasmusta sulestikuga, pika noka ja koheva kuklatutiga marabuud. Vasakpoolsel linnul jalad põlvist kõverdatud (kükitab), parempoolne seisab püsti. Foon esiplaanil keskel heleroheline, paremal lillakas, ülalt helesinine.
4965.de: In the foreground two marabou storks with bluish-black plumage, long beaks and fluffy crests at the back of the head. The left-hand bird has its legs bent at the knee (crouching), the right-hand one stands upright. The background is light green in the centre foreground, purplish on the right, light blue above.

4967.d: Hallides-sinistes toonides foonil, pildi vertikaalsel keskteljel veinpunases särbiga seelikus ja sussides naine. Silmad pruunid, peas suur tumepruun juuksepahmakas. Rinna kohale tõstetud käte vahel hoiab püstloodis halli kahe teraga mõõka.
4967.de: Against a grey-blue background, on the vertical central axis of the picture, a woman in a wine-red apron-skirt and slippers. Brown eyes, a large dark brown mass of hair on the head. Between the hands raised to chest level she holds a grey double-edged sword upright.

4968.d: Kolm figuuri allservas asuva vee ääres: vasakpoolsel seljas kollane särk ja hallid püksid; parempoolsel lilla pluus ja sinine pikk seelik, kingad näpus. Äärmiste figuuride silmist suunduvad kollased kiired keskel seisva, pildist välja vaatava mehe suunas. Foon ähmane, kollakas rohelistes ja helelillades toonides.
4968.de: Three figures near water at the bottom edge of the picture: the one on the left wears a yellow shirt and grey trousers; the one on the right wears a purple blouse and a long blue skirt, holding shoes in her hand. Yellow rays extend from the eyes of the outer figures towards the man standing in the middle who looks out of the picture. Background blurred, in yellowish green and light purple tones.

4970.d: Ülalt ööhall kuusirbiga vasakul, alt sügavroheline, keskelt pruunika kumaga taust, millel neli erinevas poosis kiitsakat meesfiguuri. Parem ülemine ja vasak alumine valgesse mässitud sigaretiga kuju, lummav valgus näol. Parem alumine erepunastes pükstes vaataja suunas astumas. Vasak ülemine figuur eelmisega samas suunas, pruunikas rõivas, rohekas kuma näol.
4970.de: At the top, a night-grey background with a crescent moon on the left, at the bottom dark green, in the middle a background with a brownish glow, on which four lanky male figures in different poses. Upper right and lower left figure wrapped in white with a cigarette, alluring light on the face. Lower right figure in bright red trousers stepping toward the viewer. Upper left figure moving in the same direction as the previous one, in brownish clothing, greenish glow on the face.

4971.d: Valkjashall rand üksikute põõsatuttidega, vasakul osake merest kollakashalli taeva all. Ees, keskjoonest veidi paremal pikas tumedas mantlis prillidega mees seismas külgvaates vasakule. Mehel üks käsi taskus, teine rinnal. Tagapool paremal paistab astuv figuur.
4971.de: A whitish-grey shore with isolated tufts of bushes, on the left a small piece of sea under a yellowish-grey sky. In front, slightly right of the centre line, a man in a long dark coat with spectacles standing in profile facing left. The man has one hand in his pocket, the other on his chest. Behind, on the right, a walking figure is visible.

4972.d: Alt kollase, ülalt halliga markeeritud ruumis neli istuvat meest: vasakul profiilis kollaste juustega mees, jalad välja sirutatud, temast paremal otsevaates lillas särgi mees, vuntsidega mees (lõug käele toetatud), lõpuks punastes üleriietes õrnalt antud näoga mees. Vorme hajutav maalimislaad.
4972.de: In a room marked yellow below and grey above, four seated men: on the left in profile a man with yellow hair, legs stretched out, to his right in frontal view a man in a purple shirt, a man with a moustache (chin resting on hand), and finally a man in red outer clothing with a softly rendered face. A form-diffusing painting style.

5000.d: Kollasel taustal kompositsioon ülikondades meesterühmaga, kelle vahelt ja läbi paistavad kaks pääsukese asendis last, ühel jalas rulluisud.
5000.de: Composition on a yellow background with a group of men in suits, between and through whom two children in swallow-dive pose are visible, one wearing roller skates.

5068.d: Keskosas noor pikkade tumedate lokiliste juustega naine külgvaates paremale mustas pükskostüümis ja laia äärega kübaras. Figuur lõigatud põlvede kohalt. Pea kergelt pööratud vasakule, pilk suunatud ette. Naisel säravad silmad, naerumuiges suu. Parema käega hüpitab valget, väikest palli. Tema selja taga vasakul sinistes pükstes poolakt veerandpöördes vasakule, vasak käsi tõstetud kukla juurde. Kroomrohelisel foonil vasakul aimatav figuur, postamendil seisev valge vaas taimemotiividega. Foonil allpool valkjad säpsud, allääres kirevad, energilised pintslitõmbed. Maalitud kohati pastoosselt lühikese pintslilöögiga, kohati laiade siledate spaatlitõmmetega.
5068.de: In the centre, a young woman with long dark curly hair, in profile facing right, in a black trouser suit and a wide-brimmed hat. The figure is cropped at knee level. The head is turned slightly to the left, the gaze directed forward. The woman has sparkling eyes, a smiling mouth. With her right hand she is bouncing a small white ball. Behind her, on the left, in blue trousers, a semi-nude figure in a three-quarter turn to the left, left hand raised to the back of the neck. On the chrome-green background, on the left, a figure can be discerned, a white vase with plant motifs standing on a pedestal. Below in the background whitish flecks, at the lower edge colourful, energetic brushstrokes. Painted at places pastosely with short brushstrokes, at places with broad smooth palette-knife strokes.

5069.d: Esiplaanil keskel, heledate seintega ruumis, pruunides pükstes ja tumedas jakis sirgete juustega poiss viiulit mängimas. Poisi viiulit hoidval käel pika saba ja hallikaspruuni sulestikuga lind. Poisi ees valge kolmnurkne taburet, millel avatud kunstialbum, poisi selja taga avaus rahutusse, kirevasse asjade maailma. All vasakus nurgas ümberläinud värvipurgist värv voolamas.
5069.de: In the foreground centre, in a room with light walls, a boy with straight hair, wearing brown trousers and a dark jacket, playing the violin. On the boy's hand holding the violin a bird with a long tail and greyish-brown plumage. In front of the boy a white triangular stool on which lies an open art album, behind the boy's back an opening into a restless, colourful world of objects. In the lower left corner paint pouring from an overturned paint can.

5070.d: Ülaservas panoraamselt antud osa Tallinna vanalinnast Niguliste ja Toomkirikuga. Esiplaanil pastoossete värviplekkide spontaanne segadus. Ülal helesinine taevas.
5070.de: In the upper edge, a panoramic view of part of Tallinn's Old Town with St. Nicholas' Church and the Cathedral. In the foreground, a spontaneous jumble of pastose patches of colour. Above, a light blue sky.

5072.d: Keskel all valge juga, millest vasakul ja paremal ookrikarva ja pruunid pinnad. Ülal tume, halli-mustakirju, tiiba meenutav kaar hallikasvalgel foonil.
5072.de: In the centre below a white waterfall, to the left and right of which ochre-coloured and brown surfaces. Above, a dark, grey-black mottled, wing-like arch on a greyish-white background.

5073.d: Kolmest naisfiguurist koosnev, ringile ülesehitatud figuraalne kompositsioon (grupiportree?). Naiste käed ühendatud. Riietuse konkreetsete reaalide (sinine ring vasakul, pintsak ja lips, hõbesõlg) kõrval on enamus rõivastusest antud abstraktsete, ekspressiivsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonina. Paremas alumises neljandikus mustafiguuriline kreeka vaas. Foon ülalt sinine, servas värvilaikude riba.
5073.de: A figural composition consisting of three female figures, built up in a circle (a group portrait?). The women's hands are joined. Besides the concrete realia of the clothing (a blue circle on the left, a jacket and tie, a silver brooch), most of the clothing is rendered as a combination of abstract, expressive patches of colour. In the lower right quarter a black-figure Greek vase. Background blue at the top, a strip of colour patches at the edge.

5074.d: Horisontaalselt üle pildi pinna kohev punakaspruun rebasenahk. Rebase saba, ninots ja kõrvaotsad süsimustad, nina ja laup kollased. Paremal puhkab nahal otsekui foonist väljakasvav erkpunaseks lakitud küüntega käsi. Foon rebase taga roosa, ülaserva hallile fooniosale voolavad kollased värvijoad. Vasakul servas peene punase joogega eraldatud valge triip.
5074.de: A fluffy reddish-brown fox fur lies horizontally across the picture surface. The fox's tail, nose tip and ear tips are jet black, the nose and forehead yellow. On the right, resting on the fur, as if growing out of the background, is a hand with nails lacquered bright red. The background behind the fox is pink, yellow streaks of paint flow into the grey part of the background at the upper edge. On the left edge a white stripe separated by a thin red line.

5075.d: Abstraktsest punase-sinise-rohelise värvi ollusest ümbritsetud kummargil naisakt, heledatest juustest ümbritsetud kirsspunase suuga nägu vaataja poole pööratud. Vasak käsi silitab allservas lamavat, mustade kõrvadega helebeeži siiami kassi. Paremale, taha sirutatud käele, laskub mustade tiibadega, sinise kõhualusega lind. Foon allosas mereroheline, ülal lillakashall. Kohati väga pastoosne, pahtlabidaga maalitud.
5075.de: A female nude bent forward, surrounded by an abstract substance of red-blue-green colour, her face, framed by light hair with a cherry-red mouth, turned towards the viewer. Her left hand strokes a light beige Siamese cat with black ears lying in the lower edge. Onto her right hand, stretched out backward, descends a bird with black wings and a blue underside. The background is sea-green in the lower part, lilac-grey above. In places very pastose, painted with a palette knife.

5079.d: Heledatest kujunditest peaaegu abstraktne kompositsioon. Ülaservas laialiaetud tiibadega kajakas, pea pööratud vaateks selja taha. Kajaka punaste jalgade vahel valge roos. Umbes horisontaalse keskjoone kohal nurgeliseks stiliseeritud heleroosad kalad. Vasakul ja paremal servas keskel tumedad suured laigud. Maalitud paiguti hõredalt, krunti vabaks jättes, kohati väga pastoosselt.
5079.de: An almost abstract composition of light-coloured shapes. At the top edge a seagull with outspread wings, its head turned to look back over its shoulder. Between the seagull's red legs a white rose. Just above the approximately horizontal centre line, pale pink fish stylised into angular forms. In the middle of the left and right edges, dark large patches. Painted in places sparsely, leaving the ground bare, in places very impasto.

5083.d: Poolabstraktne kompositsioon valges pluusis noore naisega. Heledal taustal tume kirju abstraktne maalipind, millest tulevad esile naise nägu, rind ja käed. Pastoosselt teostatud abstraktne maalipind moodustab maali keskel vertikaalse samba.
5083.de: A semi-abstract composition with a young woman in a white blouse. On a light background a dark, mottled abstract painted surface, from which the woman's face, chest and hands emerge. The pastose abstract painted surface forms a vertical column in the middle of the painting.

5085.d: Poolabstraktne kompositsioon nelja naisega. Kolme seisva ja ühe istuva naise näod, õlad ja osaliselt ka käed välja maalitud, alakehad sulavad kokku abstraktsete säbruliste värvipindadega. Abstraktsetest värvipindadest moodustub kompositsiooni keskel sammas, taust helesinine.
5085.de: Semi-abstract composition with four women. The faces, shoulders and partly also the hands of three standing women and one seated woman are painted out, their lower bodies merge with abstract wrinkled colour surfaces. The abstract colour surfaces form a column in the centre of the composition, background light blue.

5104.d: Peata naise figuur tekstiilist pealsetega platvormkingadega. Keha on kaetud ribadena mähitud pruuni tekstiiliga (värvitud tüllkardina ribad), sellele kleebitud kummeeritud tekstiilist mõõdulindi ribad (ready-made) jaotavad keha, käed ja jalad osadeks, nagu lihakeha (omaaegsetes lihapoodides rippusid seintel veiste ja sigade pildid selliselt jaotatuna erineva kulinaarse väärtusega osadeks); kehale on valge värviga kaetud mõõdud ning kleebitud baberist numbrid
5104.de: A headless female figure with platform shoes with textile uppers. The body is covered with brown textile wrapped in strips (strips of dyed net curtain), onto which strips of gummed textile measuring tape (ready-made) are glued, dividing the body, arms and legs into parts, like a carcass of meat (in butcher shops of the time pictures of cattle and pigs hung on the walls divided in this way into parts of different culinary value); onto the body measurements are applied in white paint and numbers cut from wrapping paper are glued on

5113.d: Kolmeosalisel maalil kujutatud ühtlastest punakaspruunidest aialippidest plank, mille kohal eresinine taevatriip. Keskosal, plangu vastas rohelise kattega pruun lauaplaat, sellel paremal karikakujuline sinine vaas kitsaleheliste lilledega, vasakul püramiidi-taoline ažuurne kujund. Keskel, puuduva plangulaua vahelt avaneb vaade heleda maja nurgale puude vahel.
5113.de: A three-part painting depicting a fence of uniformly reddish-brown pickets, above which a bright blue strip of sky. In the central section, opposite the fence, a brown tabletop with a green covering, on which, on the right, a chalice-shaped blue vase with narrow-leaved flowers, on the left a pyramid-like openwork form. In the centre, through the gap of a missing picket, a view opens onto the corner of a light-coloured house among trees.

5114.d: Kolmeosalise kompositsiooni keskmisel tahvlil hallikassinine ekraan, millel väike kollane ring ja kollased-rohelised joonekesed. Ekraani taga pruun laudadest plank, mille tagant ülal paistavad üksteisest läbipõimunud geomeetrilised kujundid. Pruun plank ja helesinine taevas jätkuvad ka vasak- ja parempoolsel tahvlil. Kummagi tiiva planguosa taga paistavad hallides ja kollakaspruunides toonides geomeetrilised konstruktsioonid. Nii vasak- kui parempoolse tiiva välisservades roheline niit ja põõsastik tagaplaanil.
5114.de: In the middle panel of the three-part composition a greyish-blue screen with a small yellow circle and yellow-green lines. Behind the screen a brown wooden plank fence, behind which, above, interwoven geometric shapes appear. The brown fence and the pale blue sky continue also on the left and right panels. Behind the fence part of each wing, geometric constructions in grey and yellowish-brown tones appear. Along the outer edges of both the left and right wings, green thread and bushes in the background.

5115.d: Interjööri nurk õrnkollaste seinte ja roostepruuni põrandaga. Ülaosas, seina taustal sinisel torul rippuv oranžide vabakäejoontega must tahvel. Ees avatud sahtliga tumepruun laud, millel roheline alus peene triibulise varrega sinise kolmnurkse lipukesega. Kahel pool põrandal kõverdatud torujad kujundid.
5115.de: A corner of an interior with pale yellow walls and a rust-brown floor. In the upper part, against the wall, a black board with orange freehand lines hanging on a blue pipe. In front, a dark brown table with an open drawer, on which stands a green stand with a thin striped shaft and a blue triangular flag. On both sides on the floor, curved pipe-like shapes.

5116.d: Kompositsiooni vertikaalsel keskteljel üle pildi hele, punaste triipudega ääristatud pind, mis on fooniks suurele pruunis potis kasvavale kaktusele. Pott koos kaktusega seisab kolmejalgsel sinkjasmustal taburetil. Kaktusest vasakul ja paremal asuvad rohelised pinnad, millel peentest punastest joontest kompositsioon.
5116.de: On the vertical central axis of the composition, running across the picture, a light surface bordered with red stripes, which serves as background to a large cactus growing in a brown pot. The pot with the cactus stands on a three-legged bluish-black stool. To the left and right of the cactus are green surfaces on which a composition of fine red lines is placed.

5117.d: 2/5 maali vasakust poolest kujutab punast tellisseina. Paremal, tara taga paiknevad punastest tellistest vabrikuhooned: kandiline torn kahe viilkatusega ja paljude akendega madalama ehituse vahel. Ees, vaataja pool teedest ümbritsetud muruplats, kaks lehtpuud aia ääres.
5117.de: 2/5 of the left side of the painting depicts a red brick wall. On the right, behind a fence, are factory buildings of red brick: a square tower with two gable roofs and many windows between a lower structure. In front, on the viewer's side, a lawn surrounded by paths, two deciduous trees along the fence.

5139.d: Kompositsioon suure roostevärvi tsisterniga. Tsisterni ees mustade varbadega metallaed ja lauake papkasti ja abstraktsete vooklevate vormidega, taustaks sinine taevas.
5139.de: Composition with a large rust-coloured cistern. In front of the cistern a metal fence with black bars and a small table with a cardboard box and abstract flowing forms, against a blue sky background.

5142.d: Kompositsioon interjööris, mille keskmes vaikelu taburetile toetuva jala, väikese aia, kinnise karbi, nööritud paki ja väikese lauakesega. Väikesele lauakesele asetatud õhku pihustav deodorandi pudel ja lauapeeglit meenutav ese. Mõlemal pool vaikelu harkjalal oks, mille külge kinnituvad pildifragmendid, traadijupid, taimeleht ja abstraktne element.
5142.de: A composition in an interior, at the centre of which is a still life leaning on a stool leg, a small garden, a closed box, a corded package and a small table. On the small table a deodorant bottle spraying into the air and an object resembling a table mirror. On both sides of the still life, a branch on a forked leg, to which are attached picture fragments, bits of wire, a plant leaf and an abstract element.

5145.d: Kompositsioon jaotub üheksaks ebavõrdseks ristkülikuks - keskmine hall nelinurk asetseb vertikaalselt ning selle all on erinevate objektidega aknalaud. Paremalt ja vasakult piiravad seda hoogsate rohekas-pruunikate pintslilöökidega kaetud osad. Ülejäänud maalipinnast on valge.
5145.de: The composition is divided into nine unequal rectangles - the central grey quadrangle is positioned vertically, and below it is a windowsill with various objects. It is bordered on the right and left by areas covered with vigorous greenish-brown brushstrokes. The rest of the painted surface is white.

5235.de: A street scene depicted in a grotesque manner, in the centre a large woman in a hat, with a huddled figure in her lap. On the left a tank, in the lower right a little man holding a sickle and a hammer

5236.d: Groteskses võtmes kujutatud tänavastseen. Koomiksilaadne kompositsioon eraldatud kastideks, milles visandlikult inimfiguurid erinevates askeldustes, juurde lisatud tekst
5236.de: A street scene depicted in a grotesque manner. Comic-strip-like composition divided into separate boxes, in which human figures are sketchily engaged in various activities, with added text.

5237.dm: lehe laius: 58.8 cm; lehe kõrgus: 61.5 cm
5237.d: Groteskses võtmes kujutatud tänavastseen, koomiksilaadne kompositsioon visandlike inimestega. Ülal paremal alasti naine duši all, temast vasakul stseen kolme mehega laua taga. Esiplaanil seisvad naised. Teose parem alumine nurk diagonaalselt tühjaks jäetud
5237.de: A street scene depicted in a grotesque manner, a comic-like composition with sketchy figures. Above right a naked woman under a shower, to her left a scene with three men at a table. Standing women in the foreground. The lower right corner of the work left diagonally blank

5304.d: Ülemises osas geomeetrilistest motiividest ornament. Alumises osas kahel pool kujutatud noort puutaime, keskel stiliseeritud puukujutis.
5304.de: In the upper part, an ornament of geometric motifs. In the lower part, young tree saplings depicted on both sides, a stylised tree image in the middle.

5371.d: Mustvalgel kolmeks horisontaalseks kaadriks jaotatud säbrulisel fotokujutisel kordub istuv alasti naine, kätega peast hoidmas, juuksed sassis, taustal vasakul hele ristkülik. Keskmisel kaadril all paremal punase tindiga pealkiri "Ühtki piiska pärast sadu", alumisel kaadril all vasakul punase tindiga signatuur ja daatum.
5371.de: In a black-and-white photographic image divided into three horizontal frames, with a crumpled surface, a seated naked woman is repeated, holding her head with her hands, hair dishevelled, with a light rectangle at left in the background. In the middle frame, lower right, the title "Ühtki piiska pärast sadu" ["Not a Drop After the Rain"] written in red ink; in the bottom frame, lower left, a signature and date in red ink.

5697.d: Pruunikasbeežil foonil allveelaeva veepealse osa mustjas siluett, selle ümber paremal ja all hele pind. Laeva kuju kordab maali ülemises osas paiknev hallikaspruun kujund. Maalitud ühtlaste pikisuunaliste, õhukeste, krundil läbi paista laskvate pintslitõmmetega.
5697.de: On a brownish-beige background, the blackish silhouette of the above-water part of a submarine, surrounded on the right and below by a light surface. The shape of the vessel is echoed by a greyish-brown form in the upper part of the painting. Painted with even, lengthwise, thin brushstrokes that let the ground show through.

5724.d: Oranžides, kollakasroosades toonides õhtumaastik vaatega kummis mäenõlvale, mille külge piirab varjus olevate puukroonide tume triip. Eespool, orust tõusmas külmroheline udu. Kauguses vasakul roosakad mäed kollaka taeva taustal.
5724.de: Evening landscape in orange, yellowish-pink tones with a view of a rubber-coloured mountain slope, bordered by a dark strip of tree crowns in shadow. In front, cold green mist rising from the valley. In the distance on the left, pinkish mountains against a yellowish sky.

5727.d: Maali keskel sihvaka tüvega kasepuu, õrnad oksad kiirehõrvus lehtedega katavad terve pinna, okste vahelt paistab uduvines taevalaotus. Pehme, udune maalilaad, hallikasroheline üldkoloriit.
5727.de: In the middle of the painting a slender-trunked birch tree, delicate branches with fast-hatched foliage cover the whole surface, through the branches a hazy expanse of sky is visible. Soft, hazy painting style, greyish-green overall colour scheme.

5728.d: Keskel haraliste käharate okstega lehtpuu võra katab tervet maali, sinkjas udune taevas puu tagant paistmas. Valdavalt sinkjas-rohelised, pruunikad toonid, ülal heledamad, all tumedamad. Pehme udune maalimisviis, toonid üksteise sisse sulanduvad.
5728.de: In the middle the crown of a deciduous tree with sprawling curly branches covers the whole painting, a bluish hazy sky showing through behind the tree. Predominantly bluish-green, brownish tones, lighter above, darker below. A soft, hazy painting manner, tones merging into one another.

5729.d: Maali keskel suure kuuse tüvi, tugevad tumedad oksad lainjalt rohekashalli taeva taustal, katavad tervet pinda. Tumedad rohelised toonid, ülalt heledam ookerhallikas joon. Pehme, udune maalilaad, värvid üksteise sisse sulanduvad.
5729.de: In the middle of the painting the trunk of a large spruce, strong dark branches wavily against a greenish-grey sky background, covering the entire surface. Dark green tones, from above a lighter ochre-grey line. Soft, hazy painting style, colours merging into one another.

5730.d: Maali keskel veidi kaardus hallika tüvega haavapuu, peente okste ja helerohekate lehtedega puukroon heleda taeva taustal täidab ülemist pinda. Keskel tüve taga kollakas, allpool hallikas maastiku taust. Pehme udune maalilaad, rohekad-hallikad toonid üksteise sisse sulanduvad.
5730.de: In the middle of the painting, a slightly curved aspen with a greyish trunk, its crown of fine branches and light greenish leaves filling the upper surface against a light sky background. In the middle, behind the trunk, a yellowish landscape background, greyish further below. A soft, hazy painting style, greenish-greyish tones merging into one another.

5782.d: Esiplaanil üksikud valgetüvelised raagus puud, silmapiiril tihe võsa. Maapind kollakaspruun, kohati kaetud lumega, lumelaikude piirjooni on tugevasti sinisega rõhutatud.
5782.de: In the foreground solitary white-trunked bare trees, dense scrub on the horizon. The ground yellowish-brown, in places covered with snow, the outlines of the snow patches strongly emphasised with blue.

5993.d: Suurtest värvilistest maalilistest värvilaikudest maastik, vaid kaudselt motiivile vihjav. Domineerivad külmad sinised ja rohelised toonid üksikute ookrilaikudega.
5993.de: A landscape made of large, colorful, painterly patches of color, only indirectly hinting at the motif. Cold blue and green tones dominate, with occasional ochre patches.

5994.d: Abstraktsetest värvilaikudest koosneval foonil (kujutatud stiliseeritud maastikku) esiplaanil, pildi vertikaalsel keksteljel alasti naisfiguur, käed pisut kehast eemal. Ihul erinevad kirevad värvitsoonid, otsekui langeks figuurile mitut erinevat värvi valgust.
5994.de: Against a background of abstract patches of colour (depicting a stylised landscape), in the foreground, on the vertical central axis of the picture, a nude female figure, arms slightly away from the body. On the body various vivid colour zones, as if light of several different colours were falling onto the figure.

5996.d: Poolabstraktne põllusiilude ja metsatukkadega panoraame maastikuvaade. Keskel selgvaates seisva naisakti 3/4 figuur, parem tõstetud käsi lebab pealael. Figuurist vasakul maastikule langev tume vari lõikub esiplaanil pastelsetesse pindadesse.
5996.de: A semi-abstract panoramic landscape view with strips of fields and stands of forest. In the middle, a clearly rendered 3/4 figure of a female nude, the raised right hand resting on the top of the head. To the left of the figure a dark shadow falling onto the landscape intersects with pastel-toned surfaces in the foreground.

5997.d: Eredavärviline abstraktne kompositsioon omavahel põimuvatest, kattuvatest, osalt ruumilistest, osalt pinnalistest kujunditest. Allääres meresinisel sinakasvalge loperdava servaga pind, millesse tungib ülalt diagonaalsuunaline tumeroosa vööt, beežikas tahukas, sirgeid ja kõveraid torude motiive. Vasak ülemine neljandik tumerohelise-oranži-valge kombinatsioonis.
5997.de: A brightly coloured abstract composition of intertwining, overlapping forms, partly three-dimensional, partly flat. Along the lower edge, a sea-blue surface with a bluish-white loose edge, into which a diagonal dark pink band penetrates from above, a beige block, and motifs of straight and curved tubes. The upper left quarter is in a combination of dark green, orange and white.

5998.d: Heledal linal lamav aktifiguur: parem käsivars õla kohale kõverdatud, vasak pea all; vasak jalg tugevasti, parem kergelt põlvest kõverdatud. All- ja ülaservas abstraktsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonist foon. Domineerivad sinakad ja pruunid toonid.
5998.de: A nude figure lying on a light-coloured sheet: right arm bent above the shoulder, left hand under the head; left leg strongly bent at the knee, right leg slightly bent. At the lower and upper edges a background made of a combination of abstract colour patches. Bluish and brown tones dominate.

5999.d: Suvemaastiku fragmentide ja abstraktsete värvipindade keskel jäme männitüvi, millest paremal seisev naisakt veerandpöördes vasakule, käed tõstetud. Figuuri taga ja ees all lokkav hall draperii. Ülal vasakul sirge veekanal silmapiiri suunas ahenemas, õhtuvalgus peegeldumas vette. Ülal paremal valgete majade rida, telefonipost.
5999.de: In the midst of fragments of a summer landscape and abstract colour surfaces stands a thick pine trunk, to the right of which a female nude in a quarter-turn to the left, arms raised. Behind and in front of the figure below, a billowing grey drapery. Upper left, a straight water canal narrowing towards the horizon, evening light reflecting in the water. Upper right, a row of white houses, a telephone pole.

6044.d: Ühtlasel helesinisel taustal erksavärvilised, 3 uduroosat, 1 kollane, 1 tumeroheline, 2 helerohelist, 1 must, 1 punane, 2 valget, ooker, abstraktsetest kujunditest lülid üksteisega ketilaadselt läbi põimunud. Lülid ebakorrapärased - ümarad, kandilised, siksak servadega pinnaliselt kujutatud. Dekoratiivne, hoogne maalilaad, kohati pastoosne.
6044.de: On an even light blue background, brightly coloured links of abstract shapes — 3 dusty pink, 1 yellow, 1 dark green, 2 light green, 1 black, 1 red, 2 white, ochre — interwoven with one another chain-like. The links are irregular — round, angular, depicted flatly with zigzag edges. Decorative, vigorous painting style, in places impasto.

6056.d: Sume udune veepind: esiplaanil pikkade kollaste lehtedega kõrkjad, tagapool tumeroheline kõrkjamets.
6056.de: A hazy, misty water surface: in the foreground reeds with long yellow leaves, behind them a dark-green forest of reeds.

6057.d: Peaaegu kogu pildi pinda katab erinevates rohelistes toonides metsamassiiv, millest ähmaselt eristuvad üksikud kased ja kuused. Ülaservas ja vasakus ülanurgas jupike halli taevast.
6057.de: Almost the entire surface of the picture is covered by a forest massif in various shades of green, from which individual birches and spruces can be faintly distinguished. In the upper edge and upper left corner a patch of grey sky.

6058.d: Panoraamne vaade üksikule roogu täis kasvanud lahesopile. Ülal ribake kollast taevast. Maalitud hallikasrohelistes ookri- ja lillades toonides.
6058.de: A panoramic view of a solitary bay overgrown with reeds. Above, a strip of yellow sky. Painted in greyish-green, ochre and purple tones.

6093.d: Arhitektuurimotiivide taustal-vahel kuuest noorest inimesest grupp, väike puu keskel. Vasakul sinkja tellismüüri ja sinise draperii ees, sepisaiaga müürinurgal istub heledas suvekleidis ja kübaraga naine poolpöördes paremale, käed süles, pilk suunatud ette, ilme tõsine. Temast paremal, aimataval künkal kasvab noor raagus lehtpuu. Pildil paremal, Väravaorja ja torniga linnamüüri osa taustal poolselgvaates naine tüdrukuga, lapse pilk vaatajal. Nende taga lillesülemiga naise ja kahe mehe kujud, suunaga puul, istujal. Kahvatud pastelsed toonid, suure üldistuse, valdavalt pahtliga maalitud.
6093.de: Against a background of architectural motifs, a group of six young people, a small tree in the middle. On the left, before a bluish brick wall and a blue drapery, at the wrought-iron corner of the wall sits a woman in a light summer dress and a hat, turned half-way to the right, hands in her lap, gaze directed forward, expression serious. To her right, on a suggested hillock, grows a young bare deciduous tree. On the right of the picture, against the background of part of the town wall with the Gate Servant's Tower [Väravaorja tower], in half-view, a woman with a girl, the child's gaze directed at the viewer. Behind them the figures of a woman with an armful of flowers and two men, facing the tree and the seated figure. Pale pastel tones, executed with great generalisation, mostly painted with a palette knife.

6159.d: Lail aknalaual arvukal hulgal mitmesuguse kujuga värvilisi klaasnõusid lilledega, toataimi. Vasakul kolm kõrgemat vaasi ja kauss nupuliste kaunistustega, täis õielilli ja väikeselehelisi oksi. Keskel ja paremal pudelid, väiksemad vaasid, okkalised toalilled, silindriline sinine vaas kahe närbunud roosiga. Taustal aknal roosakad, sinised peegeldused. Maal rohekassinises koloriidis.
6159.de: On a wide windowsill, a large number of variously shaped coloured glass vessels with flowers, potted plants. On the left three taller vases and a bowl with knobbed decorations, full of flowering plants and small-leaved branches. In the middle and on the right, bottles, smaller vases, spiky houseplants, a cylindrical blue vase with two wilted roses. In the background, on the window, pinkish, blue reflections. The painting in a greenish-blue colour scheme.

6164.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon lippudega marssivast rahvahulgast. Esiplaanil vasakul kaks pearätikutes naist, paremal vanem lippu kandev meestööline. Külmades rohelistes, sinistes ja punastes toonides.
6164.de: Figural composition of a crowd marching with flags. In the foreground on the left two women in headscarves, on the right an older male worker carrying a flag. In cold green, blue and red tones.

6166.d: Peente, kuid teravate näojoontega noore naise pea ja keha poolpöördes paremale, tumedate silmade pilk aga suunatud vasakule. Naisel pikad tumedad juuksed, sinakasroheliste kividega kõrvarõngad ja sinakashall kleit. Foon erinevates sinistes toonides, kohati maalitud pikkade hoogsate pintslilöökidega.
6166.de: The head and body of a young woman with fine but sharp facial features, in a half-turn to the right, while the gaze of her dark eyes is directed to the left. The woman has long dark hair, earrings with bluish-green stones, and a bluish-grey dress. The background in various shades of blue, painted in places with long, vigorous brushstrokes.

6167.d: Lillakaspunasel foonil profiilis antud neegritari poolfiguur. Juustes ja kaelas rohkesti ehteid. Paremal servas laual karahvin veega, klaas ja kaks suurt oranži vilja.
6167.de: On a purplish-red background, in profile, the half-figure of a black woman. Many ornaments in her hair and around her neck. On the right edge, on a table, a carafe with water, a glass and two large orange fruits.

6168.d: Taevasinisel foonil esiplaanil keskel pikki tumedaid juukseid palmitsev poolakt. Paremal servas mustas frakis ja kaabus mehefiguur profiilis, pea ja pilk naise poole pööratud. Allservas vabade värviliste pintslitõmmete vöönd.
6168.de: Against a sky-blue background in the centre foreground a half-nude figure braiding long dark hair. On the right edge a male figure in a black tailcoat and top hat, in profile, head and gaze turned toward the woman. Along the lower edge a band of free coloured brushstrokes.

6169.d: Kunstniku kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates: juuksed laubalt taandunud, terane pilk läbi prilliklaaside, kulm kortsus. Seljas sinine särk ja töökittel, vasakus, küünarnukist kõverdatud, käes pintsel. Pildi allservas ateljeelaud värvituubide ja pudelitega. Vasakus servas profiilis, pildi servaga läbilõigatud aktifiguur. Foon sinine, ülanurkades tumenev. Pildi pind on tihedasti värviliste pintslilöökidega läbi maalitud. Kohati on värvikiht pastoosne.
6169.de: A three-quarter figure of the artist, frontal view: hair receded from the forehead, a sharp gaze through spectacle lenses, brow furrowed. Wearing a blue shirt and a work smock, holding a brush in his left hand, bent at the elbow. At the bottom of the picture, a studio table with paint tubes and bottles. On the left edge, a nude figure in profile, cut off by the edge of the picture. The background is blue, darkening in the upper corners. The surface of the picture is densely covered with colourful brushstrokes. In places the paint layer is impasto.

6170.d: Räigete punaste, siniste ja roheliste veiklevate värvilaikude foonil keskel on punaste juustega, kübaras, poolpalja rinnaga daam üles tõstnud oma valge õhulise kleidi seelikuosa. Vasakul alumises nurgas punaste juustega ja terava lõuaga naise pea kerges pöördes paremale.
6170.de: Against a background of glaring flickering patches of red, blue and green, in the centre a red-haired lady in a hat, with a half-bare bosom, has lifted the skirt part of her white airy dress. In the lower left corner, the head of a red-haired woman with a sharp chin, turned slightly to the right.

6171.d: I. Vasakpoolsel osal tihedalt kirgastes toonides läbimaalitud naisfiguurid. Vasakul esiplaanil dekolteeritud õhulises punases kleidis naine kõrvarõngastega. Temast kõrgemal lilledega kaunistatud valges ja mustas kübaras daamid.
6171.de: I. On the left-hand part, female figures densely painted through in bright tones. On the left in the foreground a woman in an airy red dress with a décolleté, wearing earrings. Above her, ladies in white and black hats decorated with flowers.

6189.d: Kõhuli lamav noore alasti naise kolmveerandfiguur külgvaates. Kõverdatud käte all kõrgem padi, pea puhkab kätel, nägu pööratud vaatajale. Foonil rikkaliku voldistikuga türkiissinistes, roosades pastelsetes toonides draperii. Keha maalitud helebeežides toonides, vorme pehmelt modelleerides, piirjooni hajutavalt.
6189.de: A three-quarter figure of a young naked woman lying on her stomach, seen from the side. A higher pillow lies beneath her bent arms, her head rests on her hands, her face turned toward the viewer. In the background a richly draped fabric in turquoise-blue, pink pastel tones. The body is painted in light beige tones, its forms softly modelled, with diffused contours.

6276.d: Pastelsetes toonides 4 figuurist koosnev kompositsioon. All paremas nurgas punakaspruunis seelikus ja pluusis istuv noor naine, paberisse mähitud lillekimp kõrval. Naisel lühikesed sirged juuksed, ristatud jalad paljad. Vasakus servas valged särgis profiilis mehefiguur, käed taskutesse surutud. Tema ees palja ülakehaga poolprofiilis mees, nägu otsevaates, käes rõivas. Meestest paremal, selgvaates heleda patsiga väike tüdruk, kaelas kroogitud valge krae ja jalas sinakad püksikesed. Foonil valge lehviv draperii.
6276.de: A composition in pastel tones consisting of 4 figures. In the lower right corner a young woman sitting in a reddish-brown skirt and blouse, a bouquet of flowers wrapped in paper beside her. The woman has short straight hair, crossed bare legs. In the left edge a man figure in a white shirt in profile, hands pressed into pockets. In front of him, a bare-chested man in three-quarter profile, face in frontal view, holding a garment. To the right of the men, in frontal view, a small girl with a light-coloured braid, a white gathered collar around her neck and bluish shorts. In the background a white billowing drapery.

6301.d: Eredavärviliste pastellidega tihedalt läbi töötatud portreepea veerandpöördes paremale. Tütarlapsel seljas kirju pluus, rõhutatult punaste põskedega. Foon tumedam, kohati hõõguvpunane.
6301.de: A portrait head worked densely in bright-coloured pastels, in a quarter-turn to the right. The girl is wearing a colourful blouse, with emphatically red cheeks. The background is darker, in places glowing red.

6350.d: Peamiselt punastes ja rohelistes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon: keskel ja ülal punane, tihedalt puäntillistlikus pintslitehnikas täppidega kaetud laialivalguv kujund. Viimase all, üksteisesse sulavad toonid, mida elustavad kollased ja oranžid valgussähvatused.
6350.de: Abstract composition mainly in red and green tones: in the centre and above a red, spreading form covered with densely pointillist brushwork dots. Below it, tones merging into one another, enlivened by yellow and orange flashes of light.

6351.d: Tumepruunil foonil allservas, vertikaalsest keskjoonest pisut paremal punakate krässus juustega, pisut kumera ninajoone ja etteulatuva suupartiiga, väikeste silmadega tütarlapse portree profiilis. Tütarlapsel seljas ookrikarva ümara kraega kleit või pluus.
6351.de: On a dark brown background at the lower edge, slightly to the right of the vertical centre line, a portrait in profile of a girl with reddish curly hair, a slightly curved nose line and a protruding mouth area, small eyes. The girl is wearing an ochre-coloured dress or blouse with a round collar.

6355.d: Pastelsel sinakasrohelisel foonil kolmest 3/4-figuurist grupp. Paremal, punakas udus kaks vastakuti seisvat kuju, vasakul üksik figuur.
6355.de: On a pastel bluish-green background a group of three 3/4-figures. On the right, in a reddish haze, two figures standing facing each other, on the left a single figure.

6376.d: Peamiselt punastes, mustades, valgetes ja kollastes toonides, ekspressiivse värvikasutusega peaaegu abstraktselt mõjuv kompositsioon. Keskosas on aimata toolil istuvat musta, siniste silmade ja ninaga figuuri.
6376.de: A composition in predominantly red, black, white and yellow tones, with expressive use of colour, appearing almost abstract. In the central part one can discern a black figure with blue eyes and nose, sitting on a chair.

6377.d: Sarllakpunaste seinte ja pruuni põrandaga ruumis, siniste käetugedega toolil konutab kollaste jalgade ja kätega, sinise-punasetriibulisse vesti mähitud mehike, kelle halli näo nina ja silmad on märgitud mustade kriipsudega.
6377.de: In a room with scarlet-red walls and a brown floor, on a chair with blue armrests crouches a little man with yellow legs and arms, wrapped in a blue-and-red-striped waistcoat, whose grey face has its nose and eyes marked with black strokes.

6378.d: Läbilõige bussitaolisest sõidukist. Paremal, rooli juures seisab kollakas meesolevus, tema selja taga istuvad ridamisi sinine naisolend ja veel kaks väiksemat aimatavat kuju. Bravuurne-ekspressiivne maalikäsitlus. Valdavalt mustjashallil pinnal erksad värvilaigud, laia pintsliga maalitud kuldsed, hõbedased siksakjooned, voolava värvi nired.
6378.de: Cross-section of a bus-like vehicle. On the right, at the wheel, stands a yellowish male figure, behind him sit in a row a blue female figure and two more smaller, indistinct figures. Bravura-expressive painting technique. Bright patches of colour on a predominantly blackish-grey surface, golden and silver zigzag lines painted with a broad brush, streaks of flowing paint.

6405.d: Poolenisti fantaasiamaastik realistlike motiividega. Ülaosas koobaltsinine aimatav meri sakilise rannajoonega. 2/3 maali pinnast kujutab rannaäärset. Esiplaanil vasakul kuivama pandud võrgud, aiad. Tagapool vasakul osmikud, lagunenud paat. Paremal kose, silla motiive. Maal rohekashallide, punakate, beežikate üleminekutega.
6405.de: A partly fantastical landscape with realistic motifs. In the upper part, a cobalt-blue sea suggested with a jagged coastline. 2/3 of the picture's surface depicts the coastal area. In the foreground on the left, nets hung out to dry, fences. Further back on the left, huts, a dilapidated boat. On the right, motifs of a waterfall, a bridge. The painting is in greenish-grey, reddish, beige transitional tones.

6458.d: Õhtune linnavaade: esiplaanil suunduvad pildi sügavusse sõidutee ja peenikeste raagus puudega ääristatud rahvarohke kõnnitee, puude ümber lumevallid. Tagaplaanil tuledesäras suured majad, ülal tumesinine ja pimenev taevas. Maalitud pruunides ja sinistes toonides.
6458.de: An evening cityscape: in the foreground a roadway and a crowded pavement lined with thin bare trees extend into the depth of the picture, snowbanks around the trees. In the background large buildings ablaze with light, above a dark blue and darkening sky. Painted in brown and blue tones.

6478.d: Pahtliga maalitud valkjale taustale võrdsete vahedega põikijooned sisse kraabitud. Sellel foonil kaks üksteise kohal olevat hallikat keha, mis jätavad taustale aimatava varju ja mille vastas olevad küljed on sarnase lainelise joonega. Piki paremat äärt hallikas pind. Maal kohati tugeva faktuuriga, kasutatud pahtlit, aerograafi.
6478.de: Crosswise lines scratched at equal intervals into a whitish background painted with putty. On this background two greyish bodies one above the other, which leave a suggested shadow on the background and whose opposite sides have a similarly wavy line. Along the right edge a greyish surface. The painting has a strong texture in places, using putty and an airbrush.

6479.d: Geomeetrilistest kujunditest kombineeritud abstraktne kompositsioon: sinine, roosa, valge nelinurk lõikuvad pildi keskel hallides toonides foonil. Paremas ülanurgas punane nelinurk, millest jooksevad alla paralleelsed valged triibud. Samasugune triipude riba all vasakul. Värvilised pinnad musta-halli-laigulised.
6479.de: Abstract composition combined from geometric shapes: a blue, pink, white quadrangle intersect in the middle of the picture against a grey-toned background. In the upper right corner a red quadrangle, from which parallel white stripes run down. A similar strip of stripes below on the left. Coloured surfaces black-grey-spotted.

6481.d: Tihke, läikiva, helepruuni värvikihina antud seina foonil esiplaanil vasakul käsisaag, seina vastu toetuv plaat, balloon ja liistujupp. Maalitud sinistes ja pruunides toonides.
6481.de: Against a background of a wall rendered in a dense, glossy, light brown layer of paint, in the foreground on the left a handsaw, a board leaning against the wall, a balloon and a piece of moulding. Painted in blue and brown tones.

6521.d: Hallides toonides akvarellilikult maalitud järvemaastik: vasakul järvesopp kividega rannal, paat, võrguvaiad ja -kuurid. Paremal hele veepind. Ülal hele, kergelt roosalt kumav taevas.
6521.de: A lake landscape painted in a watercolour-like manner in grey tones: on the left a bay of the lake with rocks on the shore, a boat, net poles and sheds. On the right a light water surface. Above, a light sky with a faint pink glow.

6531.d: Helesinisel taustal vöödiline, tumeda rohekaspruuni äärega, keskel valkjas, allpool roheline pind pikisuunaliselt pooleks lõigatud. Poolte vahel kiiluna helesinine tagapõhi.
6531.de: On a light blue background, a striped area with a dark greenish-brown edge, whitish in the middle, below a green surface cut lengthwise in half. Between the halves, a light blue background wedges in.

6532.d: Pildi keskel hall kanditud servadega kiviplaat, millel horisontaalselt jooksev loogeline punane triip. Vasakus ja paremas servas tumepruun, punase servaga triip. Vasakus ülanurgas tume triip otsekui laiali pühitud. Foon hallikas, roosalt kumav.
