6532.de: In the centre of the picture a gray, bordered stone slab, on which a horizontally running wavy red stripe. On the left and right edges, a dark brown, red-edged stripe. In the upper left corner a dark stripe as if smeared out. Background grayish, with a pink glow.

6533.d: Keset pildi pinda tume nelinurk, alt paremast nurgast punakaspruun, vasakult horisontaalse keskjoone kohalt hallid udused triibud. Tumeda nelinurga taga helesinine nelinurk. Foon ülalt tuhmroheline, alt servast helepruun.
6533.de: In the middle of the picture surface a dark quadrangle, from the lower right corner reddish-brown, from the left above the horizontal centre line grey hazy stripes. Behind the dark quadrangle a light blue quadrangle. Background dull green at the top, light brown at the bottom edge.

6586.d: Heledal laual triibulises vaasis kimp kirjusid lilli. Foon kirevate abstraktsete värvilaikude kombinatsioon. Vasakul ülanurgas koobaltsinine liblikas.
6586.de: On a light table, in a striped vase, a bunch of colourful flowers. The background is a combination of vivid abstract patches of colour. In the upper left corner a cobalt-blue butterfly.

6587.d: Keskplaanis suurtest massiivsetest roosakashallidest horisontaalsetest ja vertikaalsetest plokkidest monument, vasakul langetatud peaga pronksist sõdur. Monumendil lilled. Esiplaanil valges puhvis varrukatega kleidis sammuv noor naine, punane nelgiõis käes. Foonil hallikasroheline maastik ja tume taevas.
6587.de: In the middle ground a monument of large massive pinkish-grey horizontal and vertical blocks, on the left a bronze soldier with bowed head. Flowers on the monument. In the foreground a young woman walking in a white dress with puffed sleeves, a red carnation flower in her hand. In the background a greyish-green landscape and a dark sky.

6596.d: Beežikashallides, -sinakais toonides poolabstraktne kompositsioon: kahel pool kulissidena murtud tüvede motiivid, nende vahel olevat lagedust läbib vasakult must, alt selgepiiriline kujund, mis ühineb tumeda aimatava silmapiiriga. Pastelltoonis ülaosa keskel krhämuliste joontega kujund.
6596.de: A semi-abstract composition in beige-grey, bluish tones: on both sides motifs of broken tree trunks like coulisses, between them an open space crossed from the left by a black, sharply outlined form at the bottom, which joins the dark, suggested horizon. In the pastel-toned upper part, in the centre, a form with crumbly lines.

6597.d: Valdavalt roostepruunides toonides abstraktne kompositsioon maastikumotiividega.Ees vasakul mäeveeru kujund lillakassinisel taustal, paremal katuse-taoline pind, lõhede-pragude tumedad jooned läbimas.
6597.de: Predominantly rust-brown toned abstract composition with landscape motifs. In the foreground on the left the shape of a mountain slope against a purplish-blue background, on the right a roof-like surface, crossed by dark lines of cracks and fissures.

6712.d: Lopsakate pintslilöökidega maalitud suvemaastik, mille esiplaanil paremal põõsad, allservas rohi ja roosad lilled. Keskel punakaspruun põld, mis tagaplaanil läheb üle järk-järguliselt silmapiirini tõusvaks põõsastikuks ja metsamassiiviks. Taevas helesinine, üksikute pilvetuttidega.
6712.de: A summer landscape painted with lush brush strokes, in the foreground on the right bushes, at the bottom edge grass and pink flowers. In the middle a reddish-brown field, which in the background gradually turns into shrubbery and a forest mass rising towards the horizon. The sky light blue, with a few tufts of clouds.

6751.d: Esiplaanil jõesopp, mille kallas upub pisut nagu mäkke tõusvaisse põõsastesse ja puudesse. Puude kollakaspruunid toonid peegelduvad vees. Ülaservas helesinine taevas. Maalitud tuhmides, soojades rohelistes toonides, kohati pikkade pintslilöökidega.
6751.de: In the foreground a river bend, whose bank is somewhat submerged, as it were, in bushes and trees rising up a hill. The yellowish-brown tones of the trees are reflected in the water. At the upper edge, a pale blue sky. Painted in muted, warm green tones, in places with long brushstrokes.

6782.d: Esiplaanil roosal laual üleskerkinud servaga avaldus, mille all sinine pliiats. Vasakul pruun, punase servaga meeste rahatasku dokumentidega. Osalt viimase all teine avaldus. Sinisel foonil keskel metallist, kollase helgiga konstruktsioon. Ruum pime, kogu kompositsiooni valgustab vasakult tulev valgus.
6782.de: In the foreground on a pink table, a document with an upturned edge, under which a blue pencil. On the left, a brown men's wallet with a red edge, containing documents. Partly under the latter, another document. In the centre against a blue background, a metal construction with a yellow gleam. The room is dark, the whole composition is lit by light coming from the left.

6783.d: Keskosas potsakas triikraud, mida ümbritseb reaalsuse elementidest kombineeritud sürrealistlik kaos. Esiplaanis ja vasakus servas kirkatooniliste, spontaanselt pinnale kantud värvilaikude stiihia. Ülaosas beež foon.
6783.de: In the central part a squat flatiron, surrounded by surrealist chaos composed of elements of reality. In the foreground and along the left edge an elemental play of brightly toned, spontaneously applied patches of colour. Beige background at the top.

6784.d: Ülaosas punase-, all siniselaigulisel foonil üle lõuendi allosa kalligraafilises sinises kirjas tekst: "Elamine on mitteelamine kriisiperiood.Pleyn". Teksti taga fotorealistlikult maalitud terase vaatega kortsus vana mehe nägu.
6784.de: In the upper part on a red-, below on a blue-patched background, across the lower part of the canvas, text in calligraphic blue writing: "Elamine on mitteelamine kriisiperiood.Pleyn". Behind the text, the photorealistically painted, sharp-gazed face of a wrinkled old man.

6785.d: Tihedalt rahutute pintslilöökidega risti-rästi läbimaalitud foonilt eraldub valgates lühikestes spordipükstes, oranžis särgis ja hallides botastes jooksja, lihased pingul. Foon alt vasakult sinine, ülalt vasakult sinepikollane, paremast ülanurgast lillakashall.
6785.de: From a background densely painted with restless crisscrossing brushstrokes emerges a runner in white short sports trunks, an orange shirt and grey boots, muscles taut. The background is blue from the lower left, mustard-yellow from the upper left, purplish-grey from the upper right corner.

6786.d: Mitmesuguste värviliste kujundite taustal kaks väikest tüdrukut: vasakpoolne poolselgvaates väikeste patsijuppidega, rohekas mantlis laps ust avamas, seljas avatud roheline ranits. Parempoolne tüdruk istumas, vaatab üle õla, käe all avatud vihik. Nende vahel hüppav kass.
6786.de: Against a background of various coloured shapes, two small girls: the one on the left, seen in semi-profile with small pigtail ends, in a greenish coat, opening a door, wearing an open green backpack. The girl on the right sitting, looking over her shoulder, an open notebook under her arm. Between them a leaping cat.

6881.d: Süngetes sinistes-rohelistes toonides Lõuna-Eesti kuppelmaastik. Ees keskel sinine, taevast peegeldav veekogu. Taga sinavate kuplite vahel rohetamas siin-seal põllud.
6881.de: Sombre blue-green tones of a South Estonian hilly landscape. In the centre foreground a blue body of water reflecting the sky. Behind, among bluish hills, fields showing green here and there.

6882.d: Laiade pintslitõmmetega maalitud järvevaade tagapool piirava kaldaga, mille kohal rasketes hallikas-sinistes toonides taevas peegeldub veepinnal. Vastaskallas tumerohelise koloriidiga.
6882.de: A lake view painted with broad brush strokes, with a bounding shore behind, above which a sky in heavy greyish-blue tones is reflected on the water's surface. The opposite shore is in a dark green colouring.

6883.d: Vaikne panoraamne järvevaade sinakas-tumedale kaldale, mis peegeldub siledal veepinnal. Taevas hallikas-helesinine, keskel üksik väike pilvetomp, mille kujutist on näha ka järvepinnal.
6883.de: A quiet panoramic view of a lake with a bluish-dark shore, reflected on the smooth water surface. The sky is greyish-light blue, with a single small tuft of cloud in the centre, whose image can also be seen on the lake's surface.

6884.d: Rohelises glasuuritud savivaasis kolm valget gladiooli. Lopsakad, veidi jämedalt maalitud õied on kergelt hallikad. Taust vaarikapunane, paremal kitsam laid puhas punane. Vaas asetatud helehallile pinnale.
6884.de: In a green glazed clay vase three white gladioli. The lush, somewhat coarsely painted flowers are slightly grayish. The background is raspberry red, on the right a narrower strip pure red. The vase is placed on a light gray surface.

6887.d: Pastoosselt maalitud maastik. All ees järv mis peegeldab kõrget metsaga kaetud kallast. Markeeritud puud on kirjud - punased, kollased, rohelised, pruunikad. Metsa kohal sinakas-hallikas pilvine sügistaevas. Nii mets kui taevas peegelduvad järves.
6887.de: A landscape painted in a pastose manner. In the foreground below a lake reflecting a high forested bank. The marked trees are variegated - red, yellow, green, brownish. Above the forest a bluish-grey cloudy autumn sky. Both the forest and the sky are reflected in the lake.

6968.d: Dekoratiivsete, peaaegu geomeetriliselt mõjuvate pindadega maastik: esiplaanil künkale viiv tee, keskplaanis põõsapuhmad küngastega vaheldumisi, ülal hall taevas. Ülemine serv valge. Koloriit hele ja pastelne.
6968.de: A landscape with decorative, almost geometrically effective surfaces: in the foreground a road leading up a hill, in the middle ground bushes alternating with hillocks, above a grey sky. The upper edge is white. The colouring is light and pastel.

6969.d: Valkjashalli ja kahkjaskollase pinna piiril siluetselt lahendatud pikajuukseline istuv naisakt. Jalad istmiku all, parem käsi toetub jalale, vasak olematule alusele. Pastelsed beežid toonid, selgepiiriliselt jälgitud vormid, valguslaigud kehal.
6969.de: Reclining nude woman with long hair, rendered as a silhouette on the boundary of a pale grey and pale yellowish surface. Legs beneath the seat, right hand resting on the leg, left hand on a non-existent support. Pastel beige tones, sharply outlined forms, patches of light on the body.

7091.d: Sinise, punase ja valge kominatsioonis abstraktne kompositsioon. Keskel helesinise ja valkjasroosaga laialivalguva risti motiiv laiade pintslitõmmetega maalitud. Vasak ülemine neljandik valdavalt ühtlane meresinine, parem alumine tumeroosa pind.
7091.de: An abstract composition in a combination of blue, red and white. In the centre, a motif of a spreading cross in light blue and whitish pink, painted with broad brush strokes. The upper left quarter predominantly uniform sea-blue, the lower right a dark pink surface.

7092.d: Vaade poolelioleva maja kahte ruumi läbi ukseavade, milles seisavad sinistes tööriietes mehed: vasakpoolsel punakaspruunid juuksed ja habe, tööriiete taskust paistab kruvikeeraja pea; parempoolsel mehel kergelt krässus juuksed ja vuntsid. Mõlemad mehed töötavad ukse kõrval asuvate lülitite kallal. Taga, pooleliolevates tubades, pukk, mitmes toonis juhtmepuntraid. Maalitud slaidimaali võttmestikku kasutades sinistes toonides.
7092.de: View through doorways into two rooms of an unfinished house, in which men in blue work clothes are standing: the one on the left has reddish-brown hair and beard, a screwdriver head visible from his work clothes pocket; the man on the right has slightly curly hair and a moustache. Both men are working on switches located beside the door. In the back, in the unfinished rooms, a trestle, coils of wire in several colours. Painted in blue tones using the visual vocabulary of painted slide art.

7154.d: Kuuest inimesest grupp sinakasrohelises maastikus. Vasakul, õitsva põõsa ees seisab noor naine kolmveerandpöördesvasakule, sinakas seelik-pluus seljas, õlgade ümber roosa jakk. Tema kõrval koer. Keskel kaks pingil istujat, patsijuppidega tüdruk vasakul ja vanem naine üle õla kiikamas. Pildil paremal seisev noormees otsevaates, käsi taskus. Tema taga paremal noormees ja helesinises suvekleidis neiu noormehe vastu nõjatumas. Figuurid suure üldistusega maalitud, kohati kontuurjoonega vorme rõhutades.
7154.de: A group of six people in a bluish-green landscape. On the left, in front of a flowering bush, stands a young woman turned three-quarters to the left, wearing a bluish skirt-blouse with a pink jacket around her shoulders. A dog beside her. In the centre, two people sitting on a bench, a girl with braid ends on the left and an older woman glancing over her shoulder. On the right of the picture a young man stands facing forward, hand in pocket. Behind him on the right a young man and a girl in a light blue summer dress leaning against him. The figures are painted with great generalisation, in places emphasising forms with a contour line.

7157.d: Samblarohekast, roostepruunist foonist eradlub vasakul lillekimbu kujutis, paremal pikajuukselise seisva noore prillidega naise poolfiguur, pilk vaataal, käed vaheliti rinnal. Figuur ja selle ümbrus maalitud kirevate diagonaalsuunaliste pintslitõmmetega.
7157.de: From a moss-green, rust-brown background emerges on the left the image of a bouquet of flowers, on the right the half-figure of a young, long-haired standing woman wearing glasses, her gaze on the viewer, hands crossed on her chest. The figure and its surroundings are painted with vivid diagonal brushstrokes.

7158.d: Maali ülapoolel, helesinisel taustal suur värvitriibuline kala lennus. Allosas värvipindadega, -triipudega markeeritud hoonetegrupp kirikutorniga keskel. Hoogsa laadiga maal. Kohati pind pastoosne, kohati (kala kujul) katmata lõuend.
7158.de: In the upper part of the painting, against a light blue background, a large multicoloured striped fish in flight. In the lower part, a group of buildings marked with colour surfaces and stripes, with a church tower in the centre. A painting of a vigorous manner. In places the surface is impasto, in places (in the shape of the fish) the canvas is left uncovered.

7243.d: Ees pruunikate põldude vaheline tee veeloikude ja lumelaikudega selle ääres. Tagapool metsaveerg roosakaspruunide põõsastega tumeda kuusemetsa taustal. Puude kohal kollakas õhtukumas taevas.
7243.de: In front, a road between brownish fields with puddles of water and patches of snow along it. Further back the edge of a forest with pinkish-brown bushes against the background of a dark spruce forest. Above the trees a yellowish evening glow in the sky.

7244.d: Ülalt vaade metsaga piiratud lumisele lamedale nõlvale, millel punaste viilkatustega majade grupp. Vasakul õues kaks kuuske, õunapuud, jupike roigasaeda. Päikesest kirgas lumi kõikjal, külmsinised varjud nõgudes.
7244.de: View from above of a snowy flat slope enclosed by forest, with a group of houses with red gabled roofs. On the left in the yard two spruces, apple trees, a piece of pole fence. Sun-bright snow everywhere, cold-blue shadows in the hollows.

7269.d: Laiade ekspressiivsete pintslilöökidega maalitud abstraktne kompositsioon. Allosas rohekaspruun varjundirikas pind, millesse tungib paremalt hele kolmnurk ja üksikud mustad-valged pintslitõmbed. Ülemine maaliosa heledas gammas, tumedamad risti-rästi jooned läbi kumamas.
7269.de: An abstract composition painted with broad expressive brushstrokes. In the lower part a greenish-brown surface rich in nuance, into which a light triangle intrudes from the right along with isolated black-and-white brushstrokes. The upper part of the painting in a light range, with darker criss-crossing lines shining through.

7270.d: Ruudukujulistel, erivärvilistel alustel, ajalehtedest välja lõigatud ja riidele kleebitud kujundid siluettidena: 1. Kollasel foonil, keskel, vertikaalselt nool, teravikuga ülesse.
7270.de: On square bases of various colours, shapes cut out of newspapers and glued onto fabric as silhouettes: 1. On a yellow background, in the centre, a vertical arrow, point upwards.

7295.d: Keskealise mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule. Istuva mehe lühikesed juuksed on hallid, seljas kollakaspruun pintsak ja erksinine särk, käed põlvel ristatud, vasakus käes kaks pintslit. Foon sinine, vasakust servast rohelistes toonides.
7295.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man in half-turn to the left. The seated man's short hair is grey, he wears a yellowish-brown jacket and a bright blue shirt, his hands crossed on his knee, two brushes in his left hand. The background is blue, in greenish tones from the left edge.

7297.d: Kõrgest vaatepunktist antud rannamaastik, kus esiplaanil liivariba üksiku põõsapuhmaga keskel ning taamal tumesinine meri. Ülal sinakasrohelistes ja kollastes toonides taevas. Maaliline, pintslilöök lopsakas ja selgesti eristatav.
7297.de: A coastal landscape given from a high viewpoint, with a strip of sand with a single bush in the middle of the foreground and the dark blue sea further away. Above, sky in bluish-green and yellow tones. Painterly, the brushstroke lush and clearly distinguishable.

7300.d: Väikestest põimuvatest ja üksteist katvatest värvilaikudest (sinised, kollakad ja punased toonid) koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon.
7300.de: An abstract composition consisting of small interweaving and overlapping patches of colour (blue, yellowish and red tones).

7301.d: Hämaras interjööris Vana-Egiptuse vaaraoskulptuuride ees kaks keskealist meest seismas-vestlemas. Näitusesaalis vasakul kaks istuvas asendis vaaraofiguuri poolkülgvaates paremale. Nende kohal, taustast joonistub välja kolme skulptuuri pead. Skulptuuride ees paremal kahe prillidega mehe kolmveerandfiguurid:vasakpoolne külgvaates, süvenenult vaatlemas skulptuure, käed püksitaskus, tema kõrval veidi lühem habemik mees pöördunud vaataja poole, žestiks tõstnud vasaku käe. Rohekashallid, ookertoonid, markeeriv laad.
7301.de: In a dim interior, in front of Ancient Egyptian pharaoh sculptures, two middle-aged men standing and conversing. In the exhibition hall on the left two seated pharaoh figures in semi-profile facing right. Above them, against the background, the heads of three sculptures stand out. In front of the sculptures on the right, three-quarter figures of two bespectacled men: the left one in profile, engrossed in observing the sculptures, hands in trouser pockets, beside him a slightly shorter bearded man turned towards the viewer, raising his left hand in a gesture. Greenish-grey, ochre tones, sketchy style.

7335.d: Hallides ja pruunides toonides maastik: esiplaanil pisut künklik maapind pooleldi raagus põõsaste ja puudega tuule käes. Keskplaanis kahvatusinine meri, mis ülal läheb üle kollaseks, valkjas-siniste, kohati pastoosselt antud pilvedega taevaks.
7335.de: Landscape in gray and brown tones: in the foreground somewhat hilly ground with half-bare bushes and trees in the wind. In the middle ground a pale blue sea, which above turns into a yellow, whitish-blue sky with clouds rendered at places impasto.

7336.d: Esiplaanil keskel setu rahvarõivais (sõba ja suure rinnasõlega) vana naine, kass süles, istumas. Naisest vasakul esiplaanil tormilatern, 5 lehmakella ja nöörile aetud kalad. Naisest paremal kimp lillasid ja valgeid lilli. Taamal lattidest aiad, karjamaad ja taluhooned puudega vaheldumisi. Ülal roosakashall taevas.
7336.de: In the centre foreground an old woman in Setu folk costume (with a sõba shawl and a large breast brooch), a cat in her lap, sitting. To the left of the woman in the foreground a storm lantern, 5 cowbells and fish strung on a string. To the right of the woman a bunch of purple and white flowers. Beyond, fences of poles, pastures and farm buildings alternating with trees. Above, a pinkish-grey sky.

7347.d: I. Vasakpoolsel tiival must nikerdatud jalgadega laud, mille ees suur sangadega vaskkatel ja vitstest korv valge palakaga paremal. Laual mitut sorti puust ja maalitud sihverplaadiga vanaaegseid kelli ja kellade osi. Paremas ülanurgas kimp kirjuid õielilli.
7347.de: I. On the left wing a table with black carved legs, in front of it a large copper kettle with handles and a wicker basket with a white cloth on the right. On the table various old clocks made of wood with painted dials, and clock parts, of several kinds. In the upper right corner a bunch of colourful flowers.

7348.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon, mille esiplaanil vasakul seisavad kaks vana kihnu rõivastes naist ja nende ees istub blond neiu punasetriibulises seelikus, kass süles. Paremal, poidest ja võrkudest ümbritsetud, rehavarrele toetuv seisev naine. Vasakul servas, keskplaanis, valges rätikus naine, reha õlal. Fooniks Kihnu maastik üksikute puude, põõsaste ja kadakatega, taga kahvatusinine meri ja roosakas taevas. Roosakaspunane ja hall üldkoloriit.
7348.de: A figural composition, in the foreground on the left two old women in Kihnu costume are standing, and in front of them a blonde girl in a red-striped skirt is sitting, with a cat in her lap. On the right, a standing woman surrounded by buoys and nets, leaning on a rake handle. On the left edge, in the middle ground, a woman in a white headscarf, with a rake on her shoulder. The background is the Kihnu landscape with solitary trees, bushes and junipers, behind it a pale blue sea and a pinkish sky. Overall pinkish-red and gray colouring.

7349.d: Paremas servas neljast vanast ja ühest nooremapoolsest naisest koosnev figuuride grupp kihnu rahvarõivastes (triibulistes seelikutes, tumedates jakkides ja pearättides). Kahel naisel käes roosade õitega õunapuuoksad. Vasakul nurgas all, triibulistel kihnu tekkidel, klaaspoid võrgus, tormilatern, sump, poi, puust kalakühveödamise labidas. Foon roosakasoranž.
7349.de: In the right-hand part, a group of figures consisting of four old women and one younger woman in Kihnu folk costumes (striped skirts, dark jackets and headscarves). Two women hold apple-tree branches with pink blossoms. In the bottom left corner, on striped Kihnu blankets, glass floats in netting, a storm lantern, a fish trap, a buoy, a wooden fish-scooping shovel. The background is pinkish-orange.

7350.d: Maali vasak pool ja parem neljandik kujutab valdavalt sinkjaid, hallikaid, rohekaid, beeže ühtlaselt maalitud geomeetrilisi pindu, jooni. Nende vahel interjööri motiiv kraanikausi, ukse, aknavaatega, silindrilise heleda valgustiga ülal.
7350.de: The left half and right quarter of the painting depict predominantly bluish, greyish, greenish, beige, evenly painted geometric surfaces and lines. Between them an interior motif with a view of a sink, a door, a window, and a cylindrical light-coloured lamp above.

7351.d: Tinglikult lahendatud uste-akende, interjööri motiividesse lõikuvad mustad geomeetrilised pinnad. Vasakul aimatav aknavaade aeda raagus puu kujutisega. Keskel püstne, all paremal ühtlaselt must kaldpind. Paremal klaasuste, akende kujutisi, peegeldusi neis. Kollakasooker, sinkjashallid segatud toonid.
7351.de: Black geometric surfaces intersecting conventionally rendered motifs of doors, windows and interiors. On the left a suggested window view into a garden with the image of a bare tree. In the centre an upright, below right a uniformly black sloping surface. On the right images of glass doors, windows, and reflections in them. Yellowish ochre, bluish-grey mixed tones.

7433.d: Esiplaanil suur kollakasroheline kast, mille kohal vasakul värvilised laigud ja jooned, paremal avatud raamat reprodukstioonidega. Silmapiiril Tallinna panoraami, sadamaga esiplaanil, kujutav maal. Foon allosas tumesinine valgete pastoossete laikudega, ülal ühtlaselt helesinine. Maalitud kohati pritsimistehnikat kasutades, kohati pastoosselt.
7433.de: In the foreground a large yellowish-green box, above which on the left coloured patches and lines, on the right an open book with reproductions. On the horizon a painting depicting a panorama of Tallinn, with a harbour in the foreground. The background in the lower part is dark blue with white pastose patches, above it uniformly light blue. Painted in places using a splattering technique, in places pastosely.

7452.d: Parkettpõrandaga toa nurk, kus vasakul valge taburet, millel avatud pappkast (siniste triipudega) ja rohelist ning halli värvi termoskann. Taburetist paremal maalimispukk valgeks krunditud lõuendiga, viimase ees kaht meest (üks neist kunstnik I. Torn) kujutav foto ja must fotoümbrik. Maalimispuki all beež pappkast, mille kaanel sinine triip. Lõuendi paremast ülanurgast diagonaalis üle lõuendi ja edasi põrandale jooksev punane niit. Ruumifragment kõigist külgedest piiratud lillakashallide pindadega.
7452.de: The corner of a room with a parquet floor, on the left a white stool with an open cardboard box (with blue stripes) and a green and grey thermos flask. To the right of the stool, an easel with a canvas primed white, in front of it a photograph depicting two men (one of them the artist I. Torn) and a black photo envelope. Under the easel a beige cardboard box with a blue stripe on the lid. From the upper right corner of the canvas a red thread runs diagonally across the canvas and further onto the floor. The room fragment is bounded on all sides by lilac-grey surfaces.

7507.d: Roosal foonil rebitud servadega rohelised värvilaigud. Keskel ebakorrapärane kujund, mis jaguneb erinevates toonides pindadeks.
7507.de: Green patches of colour with torn edges on a pink background. In the middle an irregular shape divided into surfaces of various tones.

7568.d: Mustades toonides abstraktne kompositsioon, mis koosneb mustast foonist eristuvast kolmest, üksteisega külgnevast, eri tooninüanssides nelinurgast.
7568.de: A black-toned abstract composition consisting of three adjoining quadrangles in various shades, standing out from a black background.

7569.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon üksteisele vasakult paremale liidetud ebakorrapärastest nelinurkadest erinevates valgetes, hallides ja mustades toonides. Siin-seal pisut kollast ja punast. Foon valge.
7569.de: An abstract composition of irregular quadrangles joined from left to right in various white, grey and black tones. Here and there a little yellow and red. Background white.

7686.d: Tumeda kontuuriga piiritletud looklev veekogu erkpunase õhtutaeva ja hõõguva päikesekettaga ülal mustal taustal. All paremas neljandikus rattakujuline punase kaldtriibuga valge keelumärk. Ekspressiivne laad, mustad-punased kontrastid.
7686.de: A winding body of water bounded by a dark contour, with a bright red evening sky and a glowing solar disc above on a black background. In the lower right quarter a wheel-shaped white prohibition sign with a red diagonal stripe. Expressive style, black-red contrasts.

7735.d: Ülaltvaade järvede ja metsatukkadega kuplilisele maastikule. Esiplaanil punakad põllud, vasakul ja paremal kääruliste kallastega järved. Tagapool keskel poolenisti metsaga kaetud ümar mägi, selle taga paistmas majad. Silmapiir kõrgel. Maal sinakas-hallikasrohelises koloriidis.
7735.de: A bird's-eye view of a hilly landscape with lakes and clumps of forest. In the foreground, reddish fields, lakes with winding shores on the left and right. Further back in the middle, a round mountain half-covered with forest, with houses visible behind it. The horizon is high. The painting is in a bluish-greyish-green colouring.

7767.d: Vanema mehe rinnaportree poolpöördes paremale, pilk otse vaatajale suunatud. Mehel hallid juuksed ja lühikesed vurrud, seljas roheline kuub. Näo ja kaela paremale poolele langeb valgus. Foon tumedates toonides. Maalitud pikkade lopsakte pinstlilöökidega.
7767.de: Bust portrait of an older man in a half-turn to the right, gaze directed straight at the viewer. The man has grey hair and short moustaches, wearing a green coat. Light falls on the right side of his face and neck. Background in dark tones. Painted with long, lush brushstrokes.

7769.d: Sinistes toonides geomeetrilistest kujunditest taustal paremalt keskmest vasakule mõlemasse nurka koonduv hall sõrestik-konstruktsioon. Paremal keskmes must-valgega kujutatud pundar noori inimesi. Üle pinna musti ja valgeid pritsmeid.
7769.de: Against a background of geometric shapes in blue tones, a grey trellis-like construction converging from the right centre towards both corners on the left. In the right centre a cluster of young people depicted in black and white. Black and white splashes across the surface.

7774.d: Tumesinisel laual esiplaanil valge lina, mille taga vasakul tumelilla potsakas keraamiline nõu ja kolm granaatõuna. Tagaplaanil tumeroosa piklik, kaanega pott. Foon ülal mustjaspruun.
7774.de: On a dark blue table in the foreground a white cloth, behind which on the left a dark purple squat ceramic vessel and three pomegranates. In the background a dark pink elongated pot with a lid. The background above is blackish-brown.

7796.d: Helesinistes toonides geomeetrilistest kujunditest taustal vasakul keskmest paremasse üla- ja alanurka suunduvad teravatipulised hallid sõrestik-konstruktsioonid. Vasakul keskel must-valge puntrana kujutatud kaks lapsefiguuri. Üle maalipinna musti ja valgeid pritsmeid.
7796.de: Against a background of light-blue geometric shapes, grey pointed lattice-like constructions extend from the centre-left towards the upper and lower right corners. In the middle left, two child figures depicted as a black-and-white tangle. Black and white splashes across the surface of the painting.

7858.d: Erksates punastes, sinistes ja rohelistes toonides lendav objekt. Foonil vasakul kollane kaar, millel hulk roosasid ovaalseid laike.
7858.de: A flying object in vivid red, blue and green tones. In the background on the left a yellow arc with a number of pink oval spots on it.

7864.d: Hallikate rünkpilvedega kaetud taeva all pruunikasroheline lagendik, selle taga käharate, tuuled kooldunud kroonidega lehtpuud. Vasakul, rohelusest paistab kaks majakatust. Maalitud hoogasalt, taeva osas vineer kohati värviga katmata.
7864.de: Under a sky covered with greyish cumulus clouds, a brownish-green clearing, behind it curly deciduous trees with wind-bent crowns. On the left, two house roofs are visible through the greenery. Painted vigorously, in the sky area the plywood is in places left uncovered by paint.

7943.d: Otsekui lavale, dekoratsioonide vahele on asetatud kaks jalutut (puujalgadega) karnevalikostüümides figuuri. Vasakpoolsel punase põhjaga müts, kellukesed servas, must mask, lai pitsiline krae, punane hõlst, valge põll, kaelas must rätik, käes puust mõõk. Parempoolsel kuldkollane parukas, näo asemel tohutu suu, valge pitsiline krae, sinine pluus, punane kuub ja püksid. Kuue varrukas suure haaknõelaga dekoratsiooni külge kinnitatud. Paremas nurgas vineerist välja lõigatud valge hani ratastel; keskel dekoratsiooni serval seemnetega kaetud sai.
7943.de: As if placed on a stage, among the scenery, are two legless (with wooden legs) figures in carnival costumes. On the left one, a hat with a red base, bells on the edge, a black mask, a wide lace collar, a red doublet, a white apron, a black scarf around the neck, a wooden sword in hand. On the right one, a golden-yellow wig, an enormous mouth instead of a face, a white lace collar, a blue blouse, a red coat and trousers. The sleeve of the coat is attached to the scenery with a large safety pin. In the right corner, a white goose on wheels cut out of plywood; in the centre, at the edge of the scenery, a loaf of bread covered with seeds.

7946.d: Keerulise pinna- ja ruumistruktuuriga abstraktne geomeetriline kompositsioon, mille peamisteks elementideks erinevas suuruses nelinurgad ja triibud. U. vertikaalse kesktelje kohal ülal vaba käega tõmmatud hall spiraaljoon. Töö keskel, must-hall abstraktne kujund. Värviline, hoolikalt omavahel tasakaalustatud värvipinnad.
7946.de: An abstract geometric composition with a complex surface and spatial structure, whose main elements are rectangles and stripes of varying sizes. Above the approximately vertical central axis, a freehand-drawn grey spiral line. In the centre of the work, a black-and-grey abstract shape. Colourful, carefully balanced colour surfaces.

7970.d: Peaaegu abstraktsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonina mõjuv rannavaade: esiplaanil rohttaimedega kaetud luited, keskel kergelt lainetav meri. Ülal sinine, üksikute valgete pilvedega taevas, mis silmapiiril merega kokku puutudes roosalt kumab. Erksates toonides, lopsakate pintslilöökide ja kohati spaatliga maalitud.
7970.de: A beach view that appears as an almost abstract combination of colour patches: in the foreground dunes covered with grass, in the middle a slightly rippling sea. Above, a blue sky with individual white clouds, glowing pink where it meets the sea at the horizon. In bright tones, painted with lush brushstrokes and in places with a palette knife.

7986.d: Esiplaanil keskel kirsipunases kleidis naise kolmveerandfiguur. Naise nägu ja käed lubivalged, silmad suletud, sõrmede vahel hoiab täiskasvanu olemisega väikest last. Vasakul hallikasrohelise, avara kaelaväljalõikega kleidis, kollakate juuste ja rohelise näoga naine, laps paremal käsivarrel.
7986.de: In the foreground, a three-quarter figure of a woman in a cherry-red dress. The woman's face and hands are chalk-white, eyes closed, holding a small child with an adult-like presence between her fingers. On the left, a woman in a greyish-green dress with a wide neckline, with yellowish hair and a green face, the child on her right arm.

8010.d: Valdavalt rohelistes-oranžides toonides taluõue motiiv. Paremal majanurk, ees keskel aed, selle taga paistmas hoonete viilkatused. Vasakul piiravad õue kõrged puud.
8010.de: A farmyard motif predominantly in green-orange tones. On the right the corner of a house, in the front centre a garden, behind it the gable roofs of buildings visible. On the left tall trees border the yard.

8016.d: Tumesinise kardina taustal pruun lauaplaat linikuga. Sellel paremal klaasvaagen kollakasoranzide õuntega. Tagapool karikakujuline vaas. Õhuline maalilaad.
8016.de: Against a dark blue curtain backdrop, a brown tabletop with a cloth. On it, on the right, a glass dish with yellowish-orange apples. Further back a jug-shaped vase. Airy painting style.

8018.d: Tihedalt lillakaspruunides, sinistes, ookritoonides läbimaalitud kompositsioon keskel tumesinistes pükstes, tumepunases kampsunis, beežis särgis ja lillas lipsus vanem mees kirjul toolil, käed süles, istumas. Juuksed tumedad, hallisegused, oimu kohalt kahelt poolt juuksepiir taandunud, pilk suunatud vaatajast mööda, vasakule. Foon kirju, paremal ristuvatest taladest konstruktsioon.(eesti)
8018.de: A composition painted densely in purplish-brown, blue, ochre tones, in the centre an older man in dark blue trousers, a dark red jumper, a beige shirt and a purple tie, sitting on a patterned chair, hands in his lap. His hair is dark, greying, receding at the temples on both sides, his gaze directed past the viewer, to the left. The background is patterned, on the right a construction of crossing beams.

8079.d: Suurte värviliste abstraktsete värvilaikudega antud panoraamne maastik. Paremal servas erksinine järvesilm, esiplaanil ja silmapiiril on aimata künkaid ja metsatukki. Ülal kitsas riba sinistes ja lillades toonides maalitud taevast.
8079.de: A panoramic landscape given in large coloured abstract patches. On the right edge, a bright blue patch of a lake; in the foreground and on the horizon, hillocks and small groves can be discerned. Above, a narrow strip of sky painted in blue and purple tones.

8119.d: Lineaarperspektiivi reeglite järgi üles ehitatud kompositsioon, mis koondub silmapiiril asuvate punaste koonuste suunas. Kahe heleda horisontaalse tasapinna vahel keskel asuv konstruktsioon koosneb erksates toonides silindritest, pindadest ja torudest. Keskel kollastest kumavatest ruutudest koosnev tasapind. All hall, otsekui ukseava moodustav nelinurk. Ülaservas foon sinine ja lilla.
8119.de: A composition built according to the rules of linear perspective, converging towards red cones located on the horizon. Between two light horizontal planes, the construction in the centre consists of cylinders, surfaces and pipes in bright tones. In the middle, a plane composed of glowing yellow squares. Below, a grey quadrangle forming what looks like a doorway. At the top edge the background is blue and purple.

8120.d: Õunapuuridadega taluaia vaade õrnroosades, mürkrohelistes toonides. Taga, helenduva taeva taustal paistab taluhoone katus.
8120.de: View of a farm garden with rows of apple trees, in delicate pink and poisonous green tones. Behind, against the background of a glowing sky, the roof of a farmhouse is visible.

8161.d: Terve maali ulatuses tõsise ilmega habemiku täisfiguur, pikk rüü seljas, peakattega, paljad jalad. Käte vahel hoiab raamatut. Punakaspruunid toonid, foon allosas tume, pea taustal heledam punane.(eesti)
8161.de: Over the entire extent of the painting a full figure of a serious-looking bearded man, wearing a long robe, with a headdress, bare feet. Holding a book between his hands. Reddish-brown tones, the background dark in the lower part, lighter red behind the head.

8169.d: Väga pastoossete, peaaegu reljeefina mõjuvate esemetega vaikelu: keskel hõõguvpruun potsaka vormiga vaas suurte punaste moonide ja valgete liiliatega. Esiplaanil kolm apelsinikarva vilja. Foon soojades pruunides toonides. Kõik viljad ja õied on maalitud otsekui seestpoolt helendavatena.(eesti)
8169.de: A still life with very pastose, almost relief-like objects: in the centre a glowing brown vase of a squat form with large red poppies and white lilies. In the foreground three orange-coloured fruits. The background in warm brown tones. All the fruits and flowers are painted as if glowing from within.

8178.d: Esiplaanil pruunil laual suures klaaspurgis kuivanud lilledest ja rohtudest bukett, millest vasakul väike klaasist pudel kuivanud lillega. Paremal rohelisest klaasist puuviljavaas punase roosiga; taga pikk, kandiline, ülalt ahenev pudel kuivanud kõrrega. Allservas klaasnõu ja punane roos. Foon rohekas-sinine paremal, pruunikas vasakul.
8178.de: In the foreground on a brown table, in a large glass jar, a bouquet of dried flowers and grasses, to the left of which a small glass bottle with a dried flower. On the right a green glass fruit vase with a red rose; behind it a tall, angular bottle narrowing at the top, with a dried stalk. At the bottom edge a glass vessel and a red rose. Background greenish-blue on the right, brownish on the left.

8192.d: Inimtühi maastik tumeda mere kaldal. Vasakul servas valge, mustendavate aknaavade ja ukseauguga torn, millel punakaspruun katus ja selles kaarjad aknaavad. Keskmisest aknast vaatab välja kahkjas naisefiguur. Keskplaanis, otsekui klaasist künka otsas, väiksem torn. Esiplaanil üksikud väikesed nuditud puud. Taevas hall, ülaosas ähvardavalt sinakasmust.
8192.de: An uninhabited landscape on the shore of a dark sea. On the left edge, a white tower with blackened window and door openings, with a reddish-brown roof and arched window openings in it. From the middle window a pale female figure looks out. In the middle ground, as if atop a glass hill, a smaller tower. In the foreground, a few solitary pollarded trees. The sky grey, threateningly bluish-black at the top.

8193.d: Valgele foonile paigutatud värvilistest sakiliste servadega kujunditest koosnev kompositsioon: vasakul ülal katavad üksteist kollane, sinine ja lilla laik, keskel punane ja roheline ning viimastest välja kasvav suur oranž kujund, all paremas nurgas must ja lilla laik.
8193.de: A composition of colourful jagged-edged shapes placed on a white background: upper left, a yellow, blue and lilac patch overlapping one another, in the center a red and green patch with a large orange shape growing out of them, lower right corner a black and lilac patch.

8199.d: Kireval taimemotiiviga foonil hallipäise prillidega mehe poolfiguur otsevaates, barett peas. Mehel tugev nina, näos sügavad kortsud. Ülakeha valkjate toonidega markeeritud taustale. Mehe käed toetuvad aimatavale toolileenile. Maalitud lühema nõtke pintslilöögiga.(eesti)
8199.de: Against a colourful background with a plant motif, a half-length figure of a grey-haired, bespectacled man in frontal view, wearing a beret. The man has a strong nose, his face marked by deep wrinkles. The upper body marked against a whitish-toned background. The man's hands rest on a barely discernible chair arm. Painted with short, supple brushstrokes.

8214.d: Leegitsevates kollastes, punastes ja sinakasrohelistes toonides maastik rukkihakkidega esiplaanil ja madalate pikkade talumajadega taamal. Vasakul ja paremal servas aimata puudegruppe. Taevas läheb majade katuste kohal olevast kollasest ülaservas üle ähvardavaks tumesiniseks.
8214.de: In blazing yellow, red and bluish-green tones, a landscape with rye stooks in the foreground and low, long farmhouses further back. Groups of trees can be discerned on the left and right edges. The sky, yellow above the roofs of the houses, turns into a menacing dark blue at the upper edge.

8215.d: Esiplaanil keskel ja paremal tihe tumedates toonides antud teravatipuliste taimede rägastik roostikku meenutamas. All paremas nurgas roostikku tõugatud paadi nina. Vasakul servas elektrisinine meri, kivid ja rannaliiv. Töö keskel õrnalt maalitud sinistes ja rohelistes toonides suur põõsas. Taevas peamiselt valkjaskollane, rahutute pilvedega.
8215.de: In the foreground, centre and right, a dense thicket of sharp-tipped plants in dark tones reminiscent of reeds. In the lower right corner the bow of a boat pushed into the reeds. On the left edge electric blue sea, stones and beach sand. In the middle of the work a large bush painted delicately in blue and green tones. The sky mainly whitish-yellow, with restless clouds.

8252.d: Mustad, sinised, punased ja valged üksteisega ristuvad geomeetrilised pinnad.
8252.de: Black, blue, red and white geometric planes intersecting one another.

8256.d: Sinisel taustal sopilise kuklapoolega mustjas pea profiilis vasakule. Erkpunaste huultega suu paokil, punane silmatera. Punaserombilisel kostüümil roosa kroogetega krae.(eesti)
8256.de: Against a blue background, a blackish head in profile facing left, with a bulging back of the head. Mouth ajar with bright red lips, red iris. Pink pleated collar on a costume with red rhombuses.

8263.d: Esiplaanil kollakaspruun trepiosa, mille väikesel lillal platvormil kükitab roosa olevus, kummaski käes lilla hantlit meenutav ese. Tema taga erinevates sinistes toonides trepid ja hambulised müüriosad. Intensiivselt sinises taevas ülemises paremas servas kolm sinist tuututaolist objekti.(eesti)
8263.de: In the foreground a yellowish-brown section of stairs, on whose small purple platform a pink being crouches, in each hand an object resembling a purple dumbbell. Behind it, stairs and toothed wall sections in various shades of blue. In the intensely blue sky in the upper right corner, three blue horn-like objects.

8287.d: Peamiselt hallides toonides maalitud kompositsioon: esiplaanil paremal noore, kahkjas valguses naise aktifiguur toolil istumas. Vasakul all laud pudelite, värvituubide ja tuhatoosiga. Laua taga profiilis musta-valgetriibulises ürbis mehefiguur (A. Hoidre?). Fooniks abstraktsetest värvilaikudest kujundatud pindadega interjöör. Vertikaalse keskjoone kohal ülalt lilla, alt roosa väikest kuradit meenutav figuur. Paremal servas kaks perforatsiooniauku.
8287.de: Composition painted mainly in grey tones: in the foreground on the right, a young woman's nude figure sits on a chair in pale light. On the lower left, a table with bottles, paint tubes and an ashtray. Behind the table, in profile, a male figure in black-and-white striped attire (A. Hoidre?). The background is an interior formed of abstract colour patches. Above the vertical centre line, a figure resembling a small devil, purple at the top and pink at the bottom. Two perforation holes on the right edge.

8293.dm: kõrgus: 381.0 cm (+ raam); laius: 160.5 cm (+ raam)
8293.d: Ülestikku asetatud kaheosaline kompositsioon, vasakul äärel lai mustade siksak lõigetega valge raam. Alasti naise kolmveerandfiguur veerandpöördes paremale. Naise pea kuklas, ülakeha pisut tahapoole kallutatud, silmad suletud. Parem käsi hoiab rinna alt rohekat rõivast koomale, vasak rippu küljel. Figuuri jalad lõigatud sääremarja kohalt. Taust ülalt tuhmhall, punakas, alt rohekas markeeritud laia pintslilöögiga.(eesti)
8293.de: Two-part composition placed one above the other, with a wide white frame with black zigzag cuts on the left edge. Three-quarter figure of a nude woman in a quarter-turn to the right. The woman's head is turned back, the upper body leaning slightly backwards, eyes closed. The right hand holds a greenish garment together under the breast, the left hangs at the side. The figure's legs are cut off at the calf. Background pale grey and reddish at the top, greenish at the bottom, marked with broad brushstrokes.

8299.d: Seadeldise keskel ülalt ahenev pruun, tumeda dekooriga keraamiline vaas kolme roosaõielise lillega. Vasakul korvpudel ja tume tops. Paremal punaste lehtedega potilill ja osa mingist esemest. Taustal sinisekirju kangas vertikaalsete täppidena maalitud, ees roosakaspunane draperii.
8299.de: In the centre of the arrangement a brown ceramic vase with dark decoration, narrowing towards the top, with three pink-flowered blooms. On the left a wicker basket and a dark cup. On the right a potted plant with red leaves and part of some object. In the background a blue-patterned fabric painted as vertical dots, in front a pinkish-red drapery.

8333.d: Valgel pinnal valdavalt all ja paremal sakiliste servadega hõbehall pinnaline kujund. Sellel paiknevad omakorda värvilised, justkui paberist välja lõigatud dekoratiivsed laigud. Vasakult alates kahvatuhall, väiksem must, küpskollane, millel koobaltsinine ja paremal ülal punane kujund.
8333.de: On a white surface, mostly at the bottom and on the right, a silver-grey planar shape with jagged edges. On this in turn lie coloured decorative patches, as if cut out of paper. Starting from the left a pale grey, a smaller black, cadmium yellow, on which a cobalt blue, and on the upper right a red shape.

8407.d: Paremas servas seisab küljega alasti naisefiguur, pikkade tumepunaste küüntega käed allservaga paralleelselt välja sirutatud. Naisel tugevasti mingitud nägu, mustad lühikesed juuksed hoiavad laubal siilisoengusse. Naise ümber hall, siniste säpsivate pintslilöökidega kaetud foon. Maali vasakus servas otsekui aimatav mehefiguur: must ülikond, valge frakisärk, punane lips ja kaabu. Mehe ümber must, väikesi valgeid kolmnurki täispikitud foon. Mustale raamile on kleebitud kolm- ja nelinurksed peegiltükid. Maalipind kohati paksu värvikihi tõttu reljeefne.
8407.de: On the right edge stands a nude female figure seen from the side, hands with long dark red nails stretched out parallel to the lower edge. The woman has a heavily made-up face, black short hair held in a hedgehog-style hairdo on the forehead. Around the woman a grey background covered with jagged blue brushstrokes. In the left edge of the painting, as if only suggested, a male figure: black suit, white dress shirt, red tie and a top hat. Around the man a black background densely filled with small white triangles. Triangular and quadrangular pieces of mirror are glued onto the black frame. The painting surface is in places relief-like due to the thick layer of paint.

8464.d: Peamiselt rohelistes, hallides ja punastes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon. Kohati musta ja valge värviga tõmmatud pintslilööke ja pritsmeid. Foon üleservast valge, altservast must.
8464.de: Abstract composition mainly in green, grey and red tones. Here and there brushstrokes and splashes drawn with black and white paint. Background white along the top edge, black along the bottom edge.

8465.d: Kahkjates sinistes, hallides ja roosades toonides kompositsioon: esiplaanil pingil lebav, hallis kerges rüüs, vasekarva juustega naine, vasak põlv kõverdatud, pea toetumas küünarnukist kõverdatud käele. Parem, erksinises sukas jalg on välja sirutatud. Tagapool kolm erinevates poosides seisvat alasti naisfiguuri. Foon tumehall, vasakul üleni lehvivasse valgesse rüüsse mässitud kõndiv figuur.
8465.de: A composition in pale blue, grey and pink tones: in the foreground, lying on a bench, a copper-haired woman in a light grey robe, left knee bent, head resting on an arm bent at the elbow. The right leg, in a bright blue stocking, is stretched out. Behind, three standing nude female figures in different poses. Background dark grey, on the left a walking figure entirely wrapped in a fluttering white robe.

8494.d: Valdavalt valgel taustal värvilistest siksak-, vabakäejoontest, sakiliste servadega pinnalistest kujunditest, täppidest, triipudest kombineeritud abstraktne maal. Töö ülemisel poolel kulgeb kaarjalt koobaltsinine, värviliste täppidega sakiline riba, sellega paralleelne punane lint. All sini-puna-mustavärvilistest kujunditest nurk mustade täppidega valges raamistuses.
8494.de: An abstract painting predominantly on a white background, composed of coloured zigzag and free-hand lines, flat shapes with jagged edges, dots and stripes. In the upper half of the work runs a curving cobalt-blue jagged band with coloured dots, parallel to it a red ribbon. Below, a corner of blue-red-blackish shapes with black dots in a white frame.

8526.d: Tumedate prilliraamidega vanema mehe kolmveerandfiguur interjööris. Mehel seljas valge särk, must lips ja liivakarva püksid. Paremas käes sõrmus, mõlema käega hoiab lipsust kinni. Fooniks laud, millel vasakul kollane vaas ja paremal lillepott roosaõielise toataimega. Ruumi sein hallikasroheline, ülaserva aken.
8526.de: Three-quarter figure of an older man with dark eyeglass frames in an interior. The man wears a white shirt, black tie and sand-coloured trousers. A ring on his right hand, holding the tie with both hands. In the background a table with a yellow vase on the left and a flowerpot with a pink-flowered houseplant on the right. The wall of the room is greyish-green, a window at the top edge.

8573.d: Esiplaanil paremal naine kahe lehmaga, vasakul jalgrada. Tagaplaanil hooned ja lehtpuu.
8573.de: In the foreground on the right a woman with two cows, on the left a footpath. In the background buildings and a deciduous tree.

8627.d: Kahest poolest koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon: vertikaalsest keskjoonest vasakul on oranžile foonile maalitud must, valge, sinine, heleroosa ja roheline laik. Roheline kujund jätkub paremal, punasel foonil mustana. Parempoolsel osal, punasel foonil tumepunane, viimasega horisontaalne kollane, sinine ja külmroheline laik.
8627.de: A composition in two halves: to the left of the vertical centre line, black, white, blue, light pink and green blotches are painted on an orange background. The green shape continues on the right, as black on a red background. On the right-hand part, on a red background, a dark red blotch, alongside a horizontal yellow, blue and cold-green blotch.

8660.d: Kaheosaline värvikas abstraktne kompositsioon. Ülemise maaliosa helesinisel taustal mustad, hallid konstruktsioonid segunevad valgete horisontaaljoonekeste, pilvevahu tortide, täpikeste, vabakäejoontega. Keskosa valdavalt ookerpruunide, bravuurselt maalitud pindade, joonte kombinatsioon, mis allosas kollakale taustale moodustab värviniresid, plekke.
8660.de: A two-part colourful abstract composition. In the upper part of the painting, against a light blue background, black and grey constructions mix with white horizontal little lines, cloud-foam cake shapes, dots, and freehand lines. The middle section is predominantly a combination of ochre-brown, boldly painted surfaces and lines, which in the lower part form colour streaks and stains against a yellowish background.

8672.d: Lopsakate pintslilöökidega maalitud suureleheline toataim roosakas potis punasel taburetil. Foonil on aimata akna ja toa kontuure. Külmades sinistes ja kollakates toonides.
8672.de: Large-leaved houseplant in a pinkish pot on a red stool, painted with lush brushstrokes. In the background the contours of a window and a room can be discerned. In cold blue and yellowish tones.

8704.d: Erksates sinistes, punastes ja rohelistes toonides antud maastik, mis mõjub peaaegu abstraktsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonina. Esiplaanil kõrget paljast kaljurüngast meenutav küngas, mille taga vasakul samasugune rohelusega kaetud kõrgendik. Kõrge silmapiir jätab vaid ülaosas pisut ruumi erksinisele ja roosale taevale.
8704.de: A landscape in vivid blue, red and green tones, which reads almost as a combination of abstract colour patches. In the foreground, a high bare rocky knoll resembling a hillock, behind which, at left, a similar elevation covered with greenery. The high horizon leaves only a little room at the top for the vivid blue and pink sky.

8706.d: Värviplahvatusena mõjuva värvikäsitluse ja pintslitööga maastik. Keskel metsalagendik üksiku kelpkatusega talumajaga. Majast vasakul ja maja taga puud ja põõsastik. Sama võib aimata ka esiplaanil paremal. Taevas ülal sinine, kaetud rahutute kollaste ja punakasroosade pilvetriipudega.
8706.de: A landscape with a colour treatment and brushwork that has the effect of a colour explosion. In the middle a forest clearing with a lone farmhouse with a hipped roof. To the left of the house and behind the house, trees and shrubbery. The same can also be sensed in the foreground on the right. The sky above is blue, covered with restless streaks of yellow and pinkish-red clouds.

8717.dm: laius: 212.6 cm (koos raamjalgadega); kõrgus: 79.0 cm (puidust pind); kõrgus: 112.0 cm (koos raamjalgadega); laius: 212.6 cm (puidust pind)
8717.d: Puidu pinda uuristatud ning värvidega kaetud horisontaalselt lebav profiilne naisakt. Pea paremal, pisut kuklasse painutatud. Vasak jalg põlvest kõverdatud, parem jalg sirge. Taiese alumine pool on punane, ülemine must. Naise koloriidis domineerivad roosad, kollased, helesinised sähmud. Naise kohal kolmnurksete sakkidega pilvelaadne kujund.(eesti)
8717.de: A horizontally lying female nude in profile, carved into the surface of the wood and covered with paint. The head on the right, tilted slightly backward. The left leg bent at the knee, the right leg straight. The lower half of the work is red, the upper black. In the woman's colouring, pink, yellow and light blue flecks dominate. Above the woman, a cloud-like form with triangular jagged edges.

8721.d: Intensiivsetes sinistes, punastes ja kollastes toonides panoraammaastik, maalitud peaaegu abstraktsete ekspressiivsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonina. Paremal, horisontaalsest keskjoonest kõrgemal erksinine veekogu. Taevas tumesinine.
8721.de: A panoramic landscape in intense blue, red and yellow tones, painted as a combination of almost abstract expressive patches of colour. On the right, above the horizontal centre line, a bright blue body of water. The sky dark blue.

8731.d: Ümaral laual tumesinine vaas lopsaka kimbuga. Lillakashallid, punakad, küpsed ookertoonid. Hoogne, väga pastoosne maal.
8731.de: On a round table, a dark blue vase with a lush bouquet. Lilac-grey, reddish, ripe ochre tones. Vigorous, very pastose painting.

8732.d: Telliskivipunasel taustal kahvatulillade õitega sirelikimp kitsas vaasis. Laiade pintslitõmmetega, suure üldistusega maalitud.
8732.de: Against a brick-red background, a bouquet of lilac-coloured flowers in a narrow vase. Painted with broad brushstrokes, with great generalisation.

8773.d: Esiplaanil all kollastes ja rohelistes toonides säpsivate pintslilöökidega antud veepind. Taamal sadamakai, mille ääres seisab neli kalalaeva. Kail paremal bordoopunased, ookritoonis katusega sadamahooned. Laevade taga vasakul lõiguke suvemaastikku. Ülaservas helesinine, roosakas pilvesäbrus taevas.(eesti)
8773.de: In the foreground below a water surface rendered in yellow and green tones with choppy brushstrokes. Further back a harbour quay, by which four fishing boats are moored. On the quay on the right, burgundy-red, ochre-roofed harbour buildings. Behind the boats on the left a strip of summer landscape. At the top edge a light blue, pinkish curly-clouded sky.

8775.d: Vanema mehe rinnaportree veerandpöördes paremale. Mehel peas rohekas, pisut kuklasse lükatud kaabu, seljas punakaspruun pintsak, valge särk ja tumesinine, värviliste triipudega lips. Mehel pikk, tõsine nägu, ninajuurel ja suu ümber tugevad kortsud. Ninal tumedate raamidega prillid.
8775.de: Bust portrait of an older man, three-quarter turned to the right. The man wears a greenish hat, pushed slightly toward the back of his head, a reddish-brown jacket, a white shirt, and a dark blue tie with coloured stripes. The man has a long, serious face, with strong wrinkles at the bridge of the nose and around the mouth. On his nose, glasses with dark frames.

8804.d: Esiplaanil paremal on aimata suurt, kaarduvajunud okstega puud, mille fooniks abstraheeritult antud künklik ja puudesaludega kaetud maastik. Erksates sinistes, punastes, kollastes toonides. Maalitud laia ekspressiivse pintslilöögiga.
8804.de: In the foreground on the right one can discern a large tree with drooping, curving branches, against a background of an abstractly rendered hilly landscape covered with groves of trees. In bright blue, red and yellow tones. Painted with broad, expressive brushstrokes.

8832.d: Punastest, sinistest ja kollastest väljavenitatud kolmnurkadest jt. geomeetrilistest kujunditest moodustunud keeristest abstraktne kompositsioon.
8832.de: An abstract composition formed of whirls of elongated triangles and other geometric shapes in red, blue and yellow.

8877.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon, mille vasak pool erkpunane, paremal pool mustades, roosades, sinistes toonides pinnad. Väga pastoosne maalifaktuur, kohati on maalikihti vormitud.
8877.de: Abstract composition, the left side bright red, on the right side surfaces in black, pink, blue tones. Very pastose painting texture, in places the paint layer has been shaped.

8882.d: Neljavärviline geomeetriline kompositsioon põigiti üksteise alla paigutatud kahest ühesuurusest ristkülikust. Vaarikapunasel foonil ülaosas pisut paremale nihutatud lillakassinine, selle all rohekassinine nelinurk veidi vasakul. Kujundite taga heledam punane, vahel peen triip.
8882.de: A four-coloured geometric composition of two rectangles of equal size placed diagonally one below the other. On a raspberry-red background, a purplish-blue quadrangle shifted slightly to the right at the top, below it a greenish-blue quadrangle slightly to the left. Behind the shapes, a lighter red, with a thin stripe in between.

8903.d: Ülaltvaade lillakas ööhämaruses tänavale. Eespool kõrged puud, nende all vasakul punakad kioskid, kuulutustepost, üksikute jalakäijate siluetid kõnniteel. Tagapool paremal suure heleda hoone ees autoteel kolm sõiduautot. Kaugemal tumelillad katused, linna tuledekuma. Maal rohekaslillas gammas, ühtlaselt sile pintslikäsitlus. (Vaade Kunstihoone aknast Pärnu maanteele).
8903.de: A view from above onto a street in purplish nightfall dusk. In front, tall trees, under them on the left reddish kiosks, an advertising post, silhouettes of solitary pedestrians on the pavement. Further back on the right, in front of a large light-colored building, three cars on the road. Further away, dark purple roofs, the glow of city lights. The painting is in a greenish-purple range, with an evenly smooth brush handling. (View from the window of the Art Hall onto Pärnu maantee).

8905.d: Kõrge taeva taustal astumas kollase juuksepahmakuga sinisilmne mees, paremas käes vilepill, vasakus kelluke. Mehel seljas lopsaka kraega ooker-oranž arlekiinikuub, jalas põlvpüksid, peas tuttmüts. Paremal tema ees lõvi poolfiguur, pilk vaatajal. Silmapiiril paistmas helesinised mäed. Dekoratiivsed sinised-oranžid toonid.(eesti)
8905.de: Against a background of high sky, a blue-eyed man with a shock of yellow hair is striding forward, a pipe in his right hand, a small bell in his left. The man wears an ochre-orange harlequin coat with a lavish collar, knee breeches, and a tasselled cap. On the right, a half-figure of a lion faces the viewer with its gaze. Light blue mountains are visible on the horizon. Decorative blue-orange tones.

8936.d: Erksavärviline abstraktne kompositsioon. Ühtlaselt erekollast alumist osa läbib keskelt sinine, punakasoranzide krähmudega kaarjas vööt, mis laieneb ülalpool peene pintslikirjaga maalitud aimatavaks maastikuks. Ülal vasakul arvatavad heledad mäetipud rohekal, paremal roosakaspunasel taustal.
8936.de: A vividly coloured abstract composition. The uniformly bright yellow lower part is crossed in the middle by a blue, arching band with reddish-orange scrawls, which widens above into a suggested landscape painted with fine brushwork. At upper left, presumed light mountain peaks against a greenish background, at right against a pinkish-red background.

8965.d: Lopsakalt maalitud kollastes, mustades, punastes ja sinistes toonides peaaegu abstraktsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonina antud kaks figuuri valgel, roosa ja halliga varjutatud foonil.
8965.de: Painted luxuriantly in yellow, black, red and blue tones, two figures given as a combination of almost abstract patches of colour, on a white background shaded with pink and grey.

8980.d: Beežides ja pruunides toonides pikkade sirgete juustega neiu rinnaportree. Neiu näoosa otsekui helendaks seestpoolt, silmad suletud, tugevad huuled ja nina. Neiu vasak käsi tõstetud õla kohale. Värvipind tugeva faktuuriga.(eesti)
8980.de: A bust portrait of a girl with long straight hair, in beige and brown tones. The girl's face seems to glow from within, eyes closed, strong lips and nose. The girl's left hand is raised above shoulder level. The paint surface has strong texture.

8981.d: Keskel seisab terrakotakarva pikas kuues habemega mees. Mehel süles pruunide, pea- ja kaelaosas hallide sulgedega kull. Fooni ülaosa must, allosa tihedate värviliste pintslilöökidega läbi maalitud.(eesti)
8981.de: In the centre stands a bearded man in a long terracotta-coloured coat. The man holds in his lap a hawk with brown feathers, grey on the head and neck. The upper part of the background is black, the lower part is painted through with dense colourful brushstrokes.

9030.d: Kahel (sinisel ja punasel) teibal kõndiv fantastiline neljajalgne elukas: kere eestpoolt sinine ja tagant punane, nahk laiguline, tugev saba otsast rullis. Peas sarvetaoline moodustis, suured pungis silmad, pikk punane keel ripub suust välja. Foon alt lillakassinine, ülalt tume, erinevates toonides lilla.(eesti)
9030.de: A fantastic four-legged creature walking on two stilts (blue and red): the body blue in front and red behind, the skin spotted, a strong tail curled at the end. On its head a horn-like formation, large bulging eyes, a long red tongue hanging out of its mouth. Background purplish-blue below, dark above, in various shades of purple.

9051.d: Pastelsetes sinistes, kollastes, tumepunastes toonides rangelt ühesuurusteks ruutudeks jaotatud maalipind. Iga ruudu üks serv otsekui läbikumavalt heledamaks maalitud.
9051.de: In pastel blue, yellow, dark red tones, a painting surface strictly divided into equally sized squares. One edge of each square is painted as if lighter, shining through.

9118.d: Peaaegu abstrakteste värvilaikude kombinatsioonina antud värvilistest puudest ja kolletavast rohust koostatud sügismaastik. Paremal sügavhall, valgete ja roosade viirgudega taevas.
9118.de: An autumn landscape composed of coloured trees and yellowing grass, given as an almost abstract combination of colour patches. On the right a deep grey sky with white and pink streaks.

9126.d: Paljufiguuriline kompositsioon, mille esiplaanil pruunis rüüs sõrmeni väljasirutatud vasaku käega küljetsi figuur, parem käsi all otsevaates mehe pealael. Alumise ja seisva figuuri taga mitu nägu. Foonil maastik punastest tellistest müüri, küngaste ja künkail asuvate kindlusemüüridega ülaservas. Taevas roosakaspunased pilved. Paremas ülanurgas leegid. Mitmes pruunis toonis üldkoloriit.(eesti)
9126.de: Multi-figure composition, in the foreground a figure in a brown robe seen from the side with the left hand outstretched to finger's length, the right hand below in frontal view on a man's crown. Behind the lower and the standing figure several faces. In the background a landscape with a wall of red bricks, hills and fortress walls situated on hills at the upper edge. The sky with pinkish-red clouds. In the upper right corner flames. Overall colouring in several shades of brown.

9199.d: Kolmefiguuriline grupp lahesoppide, jõesuudme, kanalitega ülaltvaates nähtud maastiku taustal. Ees keskel Maad sümboliseeriv alasti naise kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates, käed tema kõrval seisva kahe külgvaates noore mehe õlal, kaelal. Vasakpoolsel mehel pea püsti, käed vaheliti kõhul, parempoolsel pea langetatud, käed seljal. Figuuride lahendus tinglik. Peade kohal üksikute helenduvate pilvedega roosakas kumas taevas. Maalil ühtlaselt kahvatusinakas, helerohekas koloriit.
9199.de: A three-figure group against the background of a landscape with bays, a river mouth, and canals seen from above. In front, in the centre, a three-quarter figure of a naked woman symbolising the Earth, seen frontally, her hands on the shoulder and neck of two young men standing beside her, seen in profile. The man on the left has his head upright, hands crossed on his stomach, the one on the right has his head lowered, hands behind his back. The treatment of the figures is conventional/stylised. Above the heads, a pinkish glowing sky with solitary luminous clouds. In the painting, a uniformly pale bluish, light greenish colouring.

9284.d: Abstraktne ekspressiivne kompositsioon musta ja valge erinevaid tooninüanssides. Kahel teineteisele asetatud nelinurgal domineerib vasemas servas valge, paremas must. Keskosas roosa nelinurkne kujund, alumises paremas neljandikus kumab siin-seal sinist värvi. Kohati maalifaktuur pastoosne.
9284.de: Abstract expressive composition in various tonal nuances of black and white. Of the two rectangles placed one against the other, white dominates the left edge, black the right. In the middle section a pink rectangular shape, in the lower right quarter blue colour shimmers here and there. In places the painting texture is impasto.

9289.d: Esiplaanil erksinine merepind, taamal vees peegelduvad sadamahooned, paadid ja kraanad. Ülaservas sinine, ekspressiivselt maalitud valgete pilvedega taevas. Kohati maalipind pastoosne, valdavalt sinistes, pruunides ja valgetes toonides.
9289.de: In the foreground a bright blue sea surface, further away harbour buildings, boats and cranes reflected in the water. At the top edge a blue, expressively painted sky with white clouds. In places the paint surface is pastose, predominantly in blue, brown and white tones.

9323.d: Alt must taust muutub ülasuunas sujuvalt halliks. Sellel sinisest, ülespoole järk-järgult heledamaks, valgeks muutuv ja ahenev patsitaoliselt põimitud kujund, milles nii lainjaid kui nurgelisi diagonaalsuunalisi pindu.
9323.de: The black background at the bottom smoothly turns grey towards the top. On it a braid-like interwoven form, blue at first and gradually becoming lighter upwards, turning white and narrowing, containing both wavy and angular diagonal surfaces.

9329.d: Siksakiliste ja kaarjate servadega, musta ja valge ühtlase kontuuriga ümbritsetud pinnalised, üksteisega haakuvad värvilised kujundid. Vasakul ülalt alla järjestades kollane, heleroheline, helehall, punane, paremal roosa, must, tumeroheline, helekollane, tumesinine pind. Nende vahel-peal astmeliselt paigutatud musta kontuuriga valge kujund.
9329.de: Zigzag and curved-edged, flat, interlocking coloured shapes surrounded by an even black and white outline. From top to bottom on the left, in order: yellow, light green, light grey, red; on the right pink, black, dark green, light yellow, dark blue surface. Between and above them, arranged in steps, a white shape with a black outline.

9330.d: Valgete ja mustade kontuurjoontega geomeetriliste kujundite mosaiigiks jaotatud maalipind. Keskel kollane, roheliste joontega jaotatud värvilaik, millest aimub naisakt. Sellest ülalpool sinisevalgetriibuline, all valge, paremal punane ning vasakul - alt ülespoole liikudes vastavalt pruun, sinine, must, roheline ja kollane pind.
9330.de: A painting surface divided into a mosaic of geometric shapes with white and black contour lines. In the centre, a yellow colour patch divided by green lines, from which a female nude can be discerned. Above it a blue-and-white striped area, below white, on the right red, and on the left, moving from bottom to top respectively, brown, blue, black, green and yellow surfaces.

9346.d: Pikkade pinstlilöökidega maalitud puusild esiplaanilt paremalt vasakule sügavusse suundumas. Sillal, pildi vasakus nurgas, mustades pükstes, vanaroosas jakis ja kollases mütsis inimene, seljaga vaataja poole. Tagapool peaaegu abstraktselt antud puudekroonid ja majad. Ülal roosa, hallide viirgudega taevas.
9346.de: A wooden bridge painted with long brush strokes, leading from the foreground on the right into the depth on the left. On the bridge, in the left corner of the picture, a person in black trousers, an old-rose jacket and a yellow cap, back to the viewer. Behind, almost abstractly rendered treetops and houses. Above, a pink sky with grey streaks.

9350.d: Vasakul: altpoolt kuldkollasel, viljarõuke markeerival, ülalt hallikal ookertoonis siksakjoontega taustal seisev naisakt otsevaates, suletud silmad, käed sirutatult all kehast eemal. Temast vasakul hõbedane looreha, paremal sirbi kujutis. Maalil paremal mustjast siksakjoontega, kollaste täppide, punaste joonekestega foonist kumab läbi hele naisfiguur külgvaates, pea kummargil.
9350.de: On the left: a female nude standing frontally against a background that is golden-yellow below, marking sheaves of grain, and greyish ochre-toned with zigzag lines above, eyes closed, arms stretched out away from the body below. To her left a silvery scythe, to the right a depiction of a sickle. On the right of the painting, from a blackish background with zigzag lines, yellow dots and small red lines, a light female figure shines through in profile, head bowed.

9454.d: Sinisel, tumelillal, all paremal roosakal foonil, kolmnurkne, abstraktne kompositsioon teravikuga alla, sinistest, punastest, roosakatest, valgetest diagonaalsetest ja kaarjatest joontest.
9454.de: On a blue, dark violet, at the bottom right pinkish background, a triangular, abstract composition with the point downward, made of blue, red, pinkish, white diagonal and curving lines.

9464.d: Naivistlikus-realistlikus laadis maalitud vaade läbi avatud ukse taraga piiratud hoovi. Heledas päikesesäras mängib keksu sinises kleidis pruunijuukseline tüdruk. Tüdruk külgvaates, seisab ühel jajal, samal ajal kummardudes ette kivikest haarama. Tüdruku taga ripub nöörile kuivama pandud pesu.
9464.de: A view painted in a naivistic-realistic manner through an open door into a yard enclosed by a fence. In bright sunshine a brown-haired girl in a blue dress plays hopscotch. The girl is seen in profile, standing on one leg, while bending forward to grab a small stone. Behind the girl laundry hangs drying on a line.

9553.d: Lipu- ja vaarikapunasest, omavahel lõikuvast püstkülikust koosnev kompositsioon. Lõikumiskohal jookseb viltu üle pildi pinna erksinine joon. Foon must.
9553.de: Composition consisting of flag-red and raspberry-red intersecting upright rectangles. At the intersection a bright blue line runs diagonally across the surface of the picture. Background black.

9557.d: Lillades ja rohelistes toonides, valgega lahjendatud abstraktne kompositsioon, spontaanselt pildipinnale kantud värviolluse stiihia. Väga pastoosse, peaaegu reljeefitaoliselt mõjuva pinnafaktuuriga.
9557.de: Abstract composition in purple and green tones, diluted with white, the spontaneous elemental force of color matter applied to the picture surface. With a very pasty, almost relief-like surface texture.

9566.d: Pruunides toonides suures plaanis naisepea, pealagi pildi ülaservaga ära lõigatud, näovormid reljeefselt esile tungivad, valuline ilme, juuksed ümber näo. Foon kollakates toonides krobelise faktuuriga.(eesti)
9566.de: A large-scale woman's head in brown tones, the top of the head cut off by the upper edge of the picture, facial forms emerging in relief, a pained expression, hair framing the face. Background in yellowish tones with a rough texture.

9576.d: Vasakule poole diagonaalselt tõusev ultramariinsinine, erksate ja mustade krähmudega veeväli kuldse paadiga, aerud vees, vari langeb ette. Esiplaanil vasakul seisev pikajuukseline naisakt otsevaates vasaku tõstetud käega hoiab kuldset vikatit lõiketera kohalt. Paadist paremal seisev naisakt otsevaates, tõstetud käed kuklal. Vett piirab ere kollakasoranz ülaltpoolt sakilise äärega kuma, mille kohal sinine, ülaääres must, kuldsete aimatavate tähtedega laotus.
9576.de: An ultramarine blue expanse of water rising diagonally to the left, with bright and black ripples, with a golden boat, oars in the water, casting a shadow forward. In the foreground on the left a standing long-haired female nude in frontal view, with the raised left hand holding a golden scythe by the cutting blade. To the right of the boat a standing female nude in frontal view, raised hands on the nape. The water is bordered from above by a bright yellowish-orange glow with a jagged upper edge, above which a blue expanse, black at the upper edge, with dimly discernible golden letters.

9596.d: Peamiselt hallides ja sinistes toonides värvilaikudest kujundatud abstraktne kompositsioon. Osa kompositsiooni kuuluvatest värvilaikudest ja -pritsmetest on kantud klaasile ja raamile.
9596.de: An abstract composition formed mainly of grey and blue tone patches. Some of the colour patches and splashes belonging to the composition have been applied to the glass and the frame.

9597.d: Tihedalt läbimaalitud, üksteisesse sulavates kollastes, pruunides ja sinistes toonides peaaegu abstraktse pildina mõjuv, vaid aimatavate viidetega reaalsusele komponeeritud maastik. Ülal keskel kollase plahvatusena mõjuv kujund.
9597.de: A densely painted landscape, appearing almost as an abstract picture in yellow, brown and blue tones merging into one another, composed with only barely perceptible references to reality. At the top centre a shape resembling a yellow explosion.

9606.d: Poolabstraktne värvikas kompositsioon figuuridega. Ülalpool sinakasroheliste, kollaste geomeetriliste kujundite taustal lendlevad rahvariides figuurid, pead, pasun, lillekimp, sini-must-valge lipu motiive. Allosas paremal hulk pasunatorusid, vasakul juubeldav-tantsiv rahvamass.
9606.de: A semi-abstract colourful composition with figures. Above, against a background of bluish-green, yellow geometric shapes, figures in folk costume floating, heads, a trumpet, a bouquet of flowers, motifs of the blue-black-white flag. Below on the right a number of trumpet horns, on the left a jubilant, dancing crowd.

9608.d: Sügavates sinistes toonides natüürmort: esiplaanil raamatud, tiigripilt, joonistused. Nende keskel tohutusuur lillekimp, millest eristuvad erksate laikudena valged ja punased õied.
9608.de: A still life in deep blue tones: in the foreground books, a tiger picture, drawings. In their midst an enormous bouquet of flowers, from which white and red blossoms stand out as bright patches.

9635.d: 2/5 ülemisest maaliosast ühtlane kirsipunane, alumine vaarikapunane taust, millel paikneb lilla ristkülik.
9635.de: 2/5 of the upper part of the painting is a uniform cherry-red, the lower part a raspberry-red background, on which a purple rectangle is placed.

9637.d: Pruunikal taustal punaserombilises kostüümis poolfiguur otsevaates. Pisut külgede poole hajuv nägu, üksteisest eemal asetsevad silmad. Peas kahe kuljusega narrimüts.(eesti)
9637.de: Half-figure in frontal view wearing a red-rhombus-patterned costume against a brownish background. Face slightly diffused towards the sides, eyes set apart from each other. On the head a jester's cap with two bells.

9638.d: Punakaspruuni lauaplaadi ümber lillakasinistes riietes kolm inimest: keskmine otsevaates, pikkade juustega, käte vahel pooleks murtud leivatükk. Külgmistel pottmütsi taolised peakatted, parempoolsel käed laual, pilk leival, vasakpoolsel pilk suunatud jagajale. Taustal erksinine taevas, sinetav maastik.(eesti)
9638.de: Around a reddish-brown tabletop three people in purplish-blue clothing: the middle one in frontal view, with long hair, a piece of bread broken in half between the hands. The ones on the sides wear pot-hat-like headwear, the one on the right has hands on the table, gaze on the bread, the one on the left has gaze directed at the one dividing it. In the background a bright blue sky, a bluish landscape.

9639.d: Vertikaalsest keskteljest pisut vasakule nihutatud ümar vaas suure, peaaegu abstraktse värvilaikude kombinatsioonina antud lillekimp. Domineerivad külmad sinised ja rohelised toonid. Foon lillakashall. Maaliline, kogu pildi ulatuses tihedalt pintsliga läbi töötatud.
9639.de: A round vase, shifted slightly to the left of the vertical central axis, with a large bouquet of flowers given as an almost abstract combination of colour patches. Cool blue and green tones dominate. Background purplish-grey. Painterly, worked densely with the brush throughout the entire picture.

9643.d: Pärnu peatänav kõnniteelt piki tänavat nähtuna. Ees keskel laternapost, tee äärde parkinud sõiduautod. Vasakul, üle tee tellistest hoone, selle ees inimesi. Paremal, vaataja suunas astumas naine, võrk käevangus, laps kükakil.
9643.de: Pärnu's main street seen from the pavement along the street. In front in the centre a lamp post, cars parked along the roadside. On the left, across the street, a brick building, with people in front of it. On the right, a woman stepping toward the viewer, a net bag on her arm, a child crouching.

9677.d: Tumedal, maailmaruumi markeerival foonil vasakul, otsekui hallil kaljul või pilverüngal seisev figuur külgvaates, kapuutsi- ja juusteosa maaliliselt fooni hajutatud.(eesti)
9677.de: Against a dark background marking the expanse of the universe, on the left a figure in side view standing as if on a grey rock or cloud mass, the hood and hair area painterly blended into the background.

9710.d: Halli taustaga maali keskpinda täidab suur valge, mustade piirjoontega spiraalne kujund. All ja üleval valged, mustade joontega detailid, mis meenutavad kannelüüringut. Spiraalsel kujundil vasakul kollane, paremal punane vööt, paremal ülasfääris paikneb must ebakorrapärane kera.
9710.de: The middle of the painting, against a grey background, is filled with a large white spiral form with black outlines. Below and above, white details with black lines resembling a kannel's tuning pegs. On the spiral form, yellow on the left, a red band on the right, and in the upper right sphere a black irregular sphere is placed.

9741.d: Realistlikus laadis maalil suures plaanis laudpingil suudlevad noored. Prillidega pruunide juuste ja pruuni pintsakuga noormees istub ning hoiab paremas käes avatud punast vihmavarju. Teine käsi on ümber poisi süles lebava noore naise kaela. Noormehe jalad on põimitud ümber neiu keha. Jalas sinised teksad ning mustad ketsid. Neiu pea on 3/4 pöördes üles, pilk silmanurgast piidlemas vaatajat. Tema juuksed on heledad, seljas tume kleit ja valkjas-hallikas mantel. Kleit on eest avatud, paljastades osaliselt rinna, ka reied on katmata. Taustaks on tumehall kivimüür, pruunikas maapind. Tüdruku kõrval pingil on väike valge udusulg.
9741.de: In a realistic style, the painting shows in close-up a young couple kissing on a wooden bench.
